这次演讲旨在煽动听众采取行动反对不公正。

words.def_en: Including all the things you can think of. That can be thought of or conceived.
words.mnemonic: imaginable 由 imagine（想象，源自拉丁语 imaginari）和后缀 -able（能够）构成，意思是可被想象出来的，强调潜在可能性。
example: They offer a service for every imaginable need.
他们提供满足各种想象得到的需要的服务。

kaoyan_ex.text: And to anticipate every imaginable driving situation is a difficult programming problem.

words.kaoyan_note: 作adj.；意为“可想象的”

words.def_en: providing a very engaging and realistic experience
words.mnemonic: 词根 immerse 源自拉丁语 immersus，im- 入和 mergere 浸，表示沉浸式体验，常用于 VR 技术。
example: The immersive movie experience made the audience feel like they were part of the action.
沉浸式的电影体验让观众感觉自己就是动作的一部分。

kaoyan_ex.text: …cannot replace the excitement of a zoo visit as an intense, immersive and interactive experience.

words.kaoyan_note: 作adj.；意为“沉浸式的”

words.def_en: Unfavorable weather conditions, typically cold or wet.
words.mnemonic: inclement 由前缀 in-（不）和 clement（温和的）构成，来自拉丁语 clementia，描述天气恶劣或不仁慈的状态，常指暴风雨或严寒。
example: Due to the inclement weather, the outdoor event was cancelled.
由于天气恶劣，户外活动被取消了。

kaoyan_ex.text: That’s likely because the rural poor are using the money as makeshift insurance policies against inclement weather, Ferraro says.

words.kaoyan_note: 作adj.；意为“恶劣”

words.def_en: not being able to do something
words.mnemonic: inability 由前缀 in-（不）和 ability（能力）构成，表示缺乏完成某事的能力或技能。
example: His inability to swim kept him from joining the boat trip.
他不会游泳，因此没能参加乘船旅行。

words.def_en: the person being interviewed
words.mnemonic: interviewee 是 interview 的衍生词，后缀 -ee 表示动作接受者，词根 inter- 和 view 体现相互审视的过程。
example: The interviewee answered all questions clearly and confidently.
受访者清晰而自信地回答了所有问题。

words.def_en: involving a lot of work in a short time very detailed and careful producing a lot of food using little land or money
words.mnemonic: intensive 来自 intense，词根 in- 表示加强，tensus 意为伸展，指高度集中或强化的活动，如学习或农业方法。
example: The intensive training program helped me learn quickly.
强化训练项目帮助我快速学习。

kaoyan_ex.text: …appetite for information has caused a mushrooming of energy-intensive data centres around the world.

words.kaoyan_note: 作adj.；意为“密集的”

words.def_en: strong anger and shock about something unfair or wrong
words.mnemonic: indignation 源于 in-（不）和 dignus（值得），表达对不公正事件的强烈愤怒。
example: People felt great indignation when they heard about the unfair treatment.
人们听到这种不公正的待遇后感到非常愤慨。

words.def_en: Someone who runs a big company that makes products or provides heavy services.
words.mnemonic: 由 industry 工业和 -ist 表示人的后缀组成，industry 源于拉丁语 industria 勤奋，指推动工业发展的企业家，如 Henry Ford 是著名 industrialist。
example: The industrialist expanded his factory to increase production.
实业家扩建了工厂以提高产量。

words.def_en: to develop industries in a country or area
words.mnemonic: industrialize 由 industry 和 ize 后缀组成，表示使一个地区或国家实现工业化转变。
example: Many nations work to industrialize to create more jobs and grow their economies.
许多国家努力实现工业化，以创造更多就业机会并促进经济增长。

words.def_en: so bad that it cannot be accepted or forgiven
words.mnemonic: 前缀 in 意为不可，excusable 源于可原谅的，整体描述无法辩解的错误或行为。
example: Not apologizing for such a big mistake is inexcusable.
犯了这么大的错误还不道歉，是不可原谅的。

words.def_en: whole and not broken
words.mnemonic: intact 源于拉丁语 intactus，in- 不加上 tactus 触摸，意为未被触及或保持完整的，如物品在运输中完好无损。
example: The ancient vase was found intact after the earthquake.
地震后，这个古代花瓶被发现完好无损。

words.def_en: A person who takes on the ideas or achievements of others who came before them. A person who gets money, property, or possessions from someone after they have died.
words.mnemonic: inheritor 由 inherit 继承和后缀 -or 表示人组成，指遗产或权利的法定继承人。
example: As the inheritor of his grandfather's legacy, he dedicated his life to preserving the family's cultural heritage.
作为祖父遗产的继承者，他毕生致力于保护家族的文化遗产。

words.def_en: to cover something with a material that stops heat, sound, or electricity from passing through to protect someone or something from bad experiences or outside influences
words.mnemonic: insulate 词源是拉丁语 insula 意为岛屿，因为岛屿被水隔离，引申为绝缘或保护免受外界影响，应用于物理或社会领域。
example: You should insulate your house to keep it warm in winter.
你应该给房子加保温层，以便冬天保暖。

words.def_en: to receive money or property from someone who has died to get physical features or qualities from your parents or ancestors to take over problems or responsibilities from someone else
words.mnemonic: inherit 源于拉丁语 hereditare，与 heir（继承人）相关，指接收财产或遗传特征。
example: She will inherit her grandmother's house when she passes away.
她将在祖母去世后继承她的房子。

words.def_en: to turn something upside down or reverse its order
words.mnemonic: invert 来自拉丁语 invertere，in-（反）和 vertere（转动）结合，意为颠倒或反转，如 invert the order。
example: You can invert the cake onto a plate to remove it from the pan.
你可以把蛋糕倒扣在盘子上，从烤盘中取出。

words.def_en: a time between two events a break during a show or performance a short time when something different happens the difference in pitch between two musical notes a part of interval training in exercise
words.mnemonic: Interval 来自拉丁语 intervallum，inter- 表示之间，vallum 是墙，原指墙间空隙，现用于时间或空间上的间隔。
example: The interval between the two meetings was only 15 minutes.
两次会议之间的间隔只有15分钟。

words.def_en: a break or pause that stops something for a short time stopping someone from speaking by talking or making noise
words.mnemonic: interruption 的词根 inter- 表示在中间，rupt 来自拉丁语 rumpere 意为打破，合起来描述打破连续性的事件，如突然的中断或打扰。
example: The power interruption caused all the computers to shut down suddenly.
电力中断导致所有电脑突然关机。

words.def_en: The reasons or principles that explain why a decision or action is taken.
words.mnemonic: 词根来自拉丁语 rationalis（理性的），后缀 -ale 构成名词，指行为或决策的基本理由或逻辑依据。
example: The company provided a clear rationale for the new policy.
公司为新政策提供了明确的理由。

words.def_en: A cover for a window that can be closed to block light or protect the window. The part of a camera that opens to let light in when taking a photo.
words.mnemonic: 词根 shut 关闭，加上 -er 表示工具，指相机中控制曝光的装置或窗户的百叶窗，用于遮挡光线。
example: They closed the wooden shutter to keep the bright sun out of the room.
他们关上木制百叶窗，不让明亮的阳光照进房间。

kaoyan_ex.text: At such high shutter speeds, the depth of field is tiny, and as butterflies do not fly in a straight line they swiftly flutter…

words.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“百叶窗”；常见搭配 of

words.def_en: A person who poses for an artist to paint or photograph them. A person who is paid to look after children while their parents are out. An easy scoring opportunity in a sport, especially soccer.
words.mnemonic: sitter 由 sit 加后缀 -er 构成，sit 意为坐，-er 表示人，因此它指保姆或看护者，也引申为容易完成的任务。
example: The artist asked the sitter to remain still for the portrait.
艺术家要求模特在肖像画期间保持静止。

kaoyan_ex.text: …created between 1840 and 1900, the majority of which show sitters posing miserably and stiffly in front of painted backdrops, or staring absently…

words.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“模特”；常见搭配 in

words.def_en: an arm or leg of a person or animal having certain types of limbs a large branch of a tree
words.mnemonic: limb 源于古英语 lim，意思是身体的分支部分，如手臂或腿，用于描述动物或植物的肢体。
example: After the accident, he couldn't move his limb for weeks.
事故发生后，他的肢体几周都无法活动。

kaoyan_ex.text: …images as sitters shifted position or adjusted their limbs.

words.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“肢体”

words.def_en: not wanting to work or do things not being careful when doing something
words.mnemonic: laziness 是 lazy 的名词形式，描述懒惰的状态，词源可追溯至中古英语，与闲散或缺乏活动相关。
example: His laziness kept him from cleaning his room.
他的懒惰使他没能打扫房间。

words.def_en: present but not yet visible or active
words.mnemonic: 来自拉丁语 latens（隐藏的），表示潜在或未显现的状态，在心理学中常指隐藏的特质。
example: The virus can remain latent in the body for years without causing symptoms.
这种病毒可以在体内潜伏多年而不引起症状。

words.def_en: how things are arranged or organized in a space
words.mnemonic: layout 来自动词短语 lay out，lay 源于古英语 lecgan 意为放置，out 表示出来，整体指事物位置的安排或设计。
example: The layout of the furniture makes the room feel spacious.
家具的布局让房间感觉很宽敞。

words.def_en: A large organ in your body that cleans your blood and helps digest food. The organ from animals that is cooked and eaten as food.
words.mnemonic: liver 作为器官名，源于古英语 lifer，指人体肝脏，负责代谢和解毒功能。
example: A healthy liver is important for filtering toxins from your blood.
健康的肝脏对于过滤血液中的毒素很重要。

words.def_en: how likely something is to happen
words.mnemonic: likelihood 由 likely 和 -hood 构成，likely 源于古英语 lic 身体形式，-hood 表示状态，因此是某事发生的概率，在统计学中广泛应用。
example: There is a high likelihood of rain tomorrow, so bring an umbrella.
明天很可能会下雨，所以带把伞。

words.def_en: The skill of reading and writing. Knowledge or skill in a particular area.
words.mnemonic: literacy 与拉丁语 littera（字母）相关，后缀 -cy 表示能力，因此指读写和识字的技能，是教育的基础。
example: Good literacy helps people understand information and communicate clearly.
良好的读写能力有助于人们理解信息并清晰沟通。

kaoyan_ex.text: O’Hanlon said she had been most surprised by the “emotional literacy that was evident in the [target] children’s writing” and…

words.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“读写能力”；后接 that 从句；常见搭配 in

words.def_en: a member of a royal family, like a king, queen, or prince money paid to creators when their work is sold or used money paid to landowners by companies using their resources
words.mnemonic: royalty 来自 royal（王室的），指王权或知识产权领域的版税收入，体现了从封建制度到现代商业的演变。
example: The royalty attended the grand ceremony in elegant attire.
皇室成员身着优雅礼服出席了盛大的典礼。

words.def_en: Objects like pots and dishes made from baked clay, often by hand. The clay material used to make pots and dishes. The art or skill of making objects from clay. A workshop or factory where clay objects are made.
words.mnemonic: pottery 来自 pot 添加后缀 -ery，pot 指罐子，-ery 表示物品或艺术，合起来指陶器制品或制陶工艺。
example: We saw beautiful pottery at the craft fair.
我们在手工艺展上看到了漂亮的陶器。

words.def_en: Birds like chickens, ducks, and geese that are raised for food or eggs Meat from birds like chickens, ducks, and geese
words.mnemonic: 词源来自古法语 pouletrie，基于 poule（母鸡），指家禽类动物如鸡鸭鹅
example: The farm keeps poultry for fresh eggs and meat.
农场饲养家禽以获取鲜蛋和肉。

words.def_en: a person who installs and repairs pipes and water systems
words.mnemonic: plumber 源自拉丁语 plumbum 铅，因为历史上水管工使用铅制管道，现在泛指管道维修专业人员。
example: The plumber fixed our leaking sink quickly and efficiently.
水管工快速高效地修好了我们漏水的洗手池。

words.def_en: An animal that feeds its babies with milk from its body. Most mammals give birth to live babies instead of laying eggs.
words.mnemonic: mammal 词源为拉丁语 mamma 意为乳房，指哺乳动物，特征为雌性分泌乳汁哺育幼崽，包括人类和常见宠物。
example: A whale is a mammal that lives in the ocean and feeds its young with milk.
鲸鱼是一种生活在海洋中并用乳汁哺育后代的哺乳动物。

words.def_en: the largest or greatest possible
words.mnemonic: maximal 来自 maximum 最大，后缀 al 表示性质，指最大的，优化问题中寻求 maximal 值。
example: For maximal results, follow the instructions carefully.
为了获得最佳效果，请仔细遵循说明。

words.def_en: A natural substance found in the earth, not from plants or animals, like gold or salt. Some minerals are in food and our bodies and are needed for health. A sweet, fizzy drink without alcohol, with different flavors.
words.mnemonic: mineral 来自拉丁语 minera，指自然界中的矿石或无机物质，这些元素通常在地质过程中形成。
example: Milk contains the mineral calcium, which helps build strong bones.
牛奶含有矿物质钙，有助于强健骨骼。

words.def_en: to make something as small as possible, especially something bad to make something seem less important than it is to make a computer window smaller
words.mnemonic: minimize 来自拉丁语 minimus 最小和 -ize 使动后缀，表示使某物最小化或减少到最低。
example: We should minimize waste to help the environment.
我们应该尽量减少浪费以保护环境。

kaoyan_ex.text: The TMT site was chosen to minimize the telescope’s visibility around the island and to avoid archaeological and environmental…

words.kaoyan_note: 作v.；意为“最小化”

words.def_en: The time between two events. While something else is happening.
words.mnemonic: meantime 拆分为 mean（中间）和 time（时间），原意表示在某个时间段内同时发生的事情，常用于过渡期描述。
example: The cake will bake for 30 minutes; in the meantime, you can prepare the frosting.
蛋糕将烤30分钟；在此期间，你可以准备糖霜。

kaoyan_ex.text: The sales for our May Books of the Month surpassed any month since 2018.” In the meantime, PRH authors have been the losers.

words.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“期间”

words.def_en: a person who drives a car
words.mnemonic: motor 指发动机，-ist 后缀表示操作者，整体指驾车者或汽车司机，反映现代交通文化。
example: The motorist stopped to help the person whose car had broken down.
那位驾车者停下来帮助汽车抛锚的人。

words.def_en: A silver liquid metal that is poisonous and used in thermometers.
words.mnemonic: Mercury 来自罗马神话中的神 Mercurius，也是元素水银的名称，常用于科学仪器如温度计，象征着快速和流动性。
example: The thermometer broke, spilling mercury onto the floor.
温度计碎了，水银洒在地板上。

words.def_en: a tool that makes sounds louder or records them
words.mnemonic: microphone 拆解为 micro- 表示微小，phone 意思是声音，源自希腊语。合起来指放大微弱声音的设备，常见于音乐会和演讲中。
example: Speak into the microphone so everyone can hear you.
对着麦克风说话，这样每个人都能听到你。

words.def_en: a tool that makes very small things look bigger so you can see them clearly
words.mnemonic: micro- 前缀表示微小，scope 是观察仪器，microscope 即显微镜，用于放大微小物体。
example: We used a microscope to see the tiny cells in the water sample.
我们用显微镜观察水样中的微小细胞。

words.def_en: the middle or central part of something
words.mnemonic: midst 源自 middle 中间的古英语变体，表示在事物之中或中央位置。
example: They found peace in the midst of the noisy city.
他们在喧嚣的城市中找到了宁静。

words.def_en: the way you think and feel about things
words.mnemonic: mindset 指心态或思维模式，由 mind 心智和 set 设置组合而成，强调个人固定的思考习惯或态度。
example: Having a positive mindset helps you face challenges with confidence.
积极的心态有助于你自信地面对挑战。

kaoyan_ex.text: …if parents and teachers tend to be still set in the degree mindset.

words.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“心态”

words.def_en: related to a country's navy or warships
words.mnemonic: naval 与 navy 海军 相关，后缀 -al 使其成为形容词，意思为海军的；词源 navis 源自拉丁语船的含义。
example: The country built new naval ships to protect its coast.
该国建造了新的海军舰艇以保护其海岸。

words.def_en: the country you legally belong to a group of people who share the same culture and history
words.mnemonic: nationality 由 nation 国家一词加上后缀 ality 构成，表示国籍或民族身份，护照上通常会标注你的 nationality。
example: Her nationality is Canadian, but she lives in France.
她的国籍是加拿大，但她住在法国。

kaoyan_ex.text: Anyone can be a citizen scientist, regardless of age, nationality or academic experience.

words.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“国籍”

words.def_en: When the government takes control and ownership of a business or industry.
words.mnemonic: 基于 nation（国家），通过后缀 -al、-ize 和 -ation 形成，描述将私有企业转为国有的过程，经济政策中常见。
example: The nationalization of the energy sector was announced to ensure equitable distribution of resources.
能源部门的国有化被宣布，以确保资源的公平分配。

words.def_en: a feeling of sadness and happiness when remembering good times from the past
words.mnemonic: nostalgia 源于希腊语 nostos 回家和 algia 痛苦，表达怀旧之情，常与过去美好记忆相关。
example: Listening to old songs brings a strong feeling of nostalgia for my childhood.
听老歌让我对童年产生强烈的怀旧感。

words.def_en: feeling happy and sad when remembering the past
words.mnemonic: nostalgic 源于 nostalgia，词根是希腊语 nostos（归家）和 algos（痛苦），表达怀旧或思乡之情。
example: Looking at old photos makes me feel nostalgic for my childhood.
看老照片让我怀念童年。

words.def_en: related to sight or light helps you see things better uses light to read or store information
words.mnemonic: 词源源于希腊语 optikos，opt 表示视力或光，后缀 -ical 构成形容词，optical 意为光学的或视觉的
example: The optical illusion made the straight line appear wavy.
这个视错觉让直线看起来是波浪形的。

words.def_en: something you can choose to have or not have
words.mnemonic: optional 基于拉丁语 optio，意为选择，加上后缀 -al 表示可选的，在软件设置或日常决策中常见此概念。
example: The extra insurance is optional, so you can decide if you want it or not.
额外的保险是可选的，所以你可以决定要不要。

words.def_en: more than necessary or desirable; excessively
words.mnemonic: overly 来自 over（过度）加后缀 -ly（副词），表示过分地或超出正常程度，常用于批评或修饰形容词。
example: We think you are being overly optimistic about the project's success.
我们认为你对项目的成功过于乐观了。

words.def_en: A person who supervises and directs the work of others. A person or organization responsible for managing and ensuring the proper functioning of a system or process.
words.mnemonic: overseer 拆解为 over-（上）和 seer（看），see 源自古英语 seon，指监督者或监工角色。
example: The overseer made sure that all the workers were completing their tasks on time.
监工确保所有工人都按时完成了任务。

kaoyan_ex.text: …exert self-interested pressure on the USPS’s ultimate overseer—Congress—insisting that whatever else happens to the Postal Service, aspects of the…

words.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“监工”；后接 that 从句

words.def_en: during the night or for one night very quickly or suddenly for one night or during the night happening very quickly or suddenly
words.mnemonic: overnight 由 over 和 night 组合而成，over 表示整个，night 是夜晚，合起来描述整夜发生或突然变化。
example: We stayed overnight at a hotel after the concert.
音乐会后我们在酒店住了一晚。

words.def_en: weighing more than is healthy weighing more than allowed
words.mnemonic: overweight 由 over 超过和 weight 重量合成，表示超重状态，常用于健康或医学讨论。
example: The doctor said he is overweight and needs to exercise more.
医生说他超重了，需要多运动。

words.def_en: to breathe quickly with short breaths, often with your mouth open, after exercise or when hot a quick, short breath, often taken with your mouth open, after exercise or when hot
words.mnemonic: pant 来自古法语 pantaisier，描述急促呼吸的动作，常用于运动或紧张时，含义演变为喘气。
example: After running, he began to pant heavily.
跑步后，他开始大口喘气。

words.def_en: A small living thing that lives on or in another living thing and takes food from it. A person who depends on others for support without giving anything in return.
words.mnemonic: parasite 源于希腊语 parasitos，由 para 旁边和 sitos 食物构成，字面意思是在食物旁依赖，现指寄生生物或依赖他人者。
example: The tick is a parasite that feeds on animal blood.
蜱虫是一种以动物血液为食的寄生虫。

words.def_en: Used to ask someone to repeat what they said because you didn't hear or understand it. Used to say sorry when you accidentally do something wrong. An official decision to not punish someone for a crime. Forgiving someone for something they did wrong. To officially free someone from punishment for a crime. To forgive someone for something they said or did.
words.mnemonic: pardon 源自拉丁语 perdonare，per 表示彻底，donare 意为给予，整体指宽恕或原谅的行为。
example: I didn't catch that. Pardon? Could you say it again?
我没听清。请再说一遍？你能再说一次吗？

words.def_en: A liquid fuel made from oil, used to power cars and other vehicles.
words.mnemonic: petrol 是 petroleum 的缩写，petro- 源自希腊语 petra 指岩石，oleum 是油，合起来描述从岩层中提取的燃料油。
example: My car needs petrol to run, so I have to fill up the tank regularly.
我的车需要汽油才能跑，所以我得定期加满油箱。

words.def_en: When two things are equal in amount, status, or value. When the money from two different countries has the same value.
words.mnemonic: 来自拉丁语 paritas（平等），par 指相等的，在数学中表示奇偶性，在物理或经济中象征平衡或等价状态。
example: There's a push for parity between the pay of men and women doing the same job.
人们推动同工同酬，要求男女薪酬平等。

kaoyan_ex.text: …Speaker Pro Tempore Patricia Haddad, to ensure “gender parity” on boards and commissions, provide a case in point.

words.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“平等”；常见搭配 on

words.def_en: A type of art material used for drawing, made of soft, colored powder that is mixed with a binder to form a stick. A drawing or painting made using pastel sticks. A light, soft color, often used to describe shades of pink, blue, or yellow.
words.mnemonic: 源于意大利语 pastello，指柔和的浅色调，常用于艺术和设计。
example: She used pastels to create a beautiful landscape painting.
她用粉彩创作了一幅美丽的风景画。

words.def_en: an activity you do for fun in your free time
words.mnemonic: pastime 由 pass 经过和 time 时间构成，字面意思是消磨时光，指休闲娱乐活动如阅读或运动。
example: Reading books is my favorite pastime when I have free time.
读书是我空闲时最喜欢的消遣。

words.def_en: how you hold your body when standing or sitting your attitude or way of dealing with a situation to pretend to be something you are not to impress or trick people
words.mnemonic: posture 来自拉丁语 positura，词根 pos- 源于 ponere 意为放置，后缀 -ture 表示状态，描述身体姿势或态度。
example: Good posture helps prevent back pain.
良好的姿势有助于预防背痛。

words.def_en: Extreme and not normal Related to disease or illness Related to the study of disease
words.mnemonic: 来自 pathology 病理学，词根 pathos 痛苦 logos 研究，后缀 -ical 形成形容词，描述病态或异常行为。
example: He has a pathological obsession with cleanliness.
他对清洁有病态的执着。

words.def_en: a small green seed that grows in a pod and is eaten as food
words.mnemonic: pea 来自古英语 pise，指豌豆这种常见蔬菜，是植物学中的基本豆类。
example: I added some fresh peas to the soup for extra flavor
我在汤里加了一些新鲜豌豆以增加风味。

words.def_en: to cook something like fish by boiling it lightly in water or other liquids. to make an egg by cooking it in boiling water without its shell. to illegally catch animals, fish, or birds on someone else's land or without permission. to secretly take and use someone else's ideas or things unfairly.
words.mnemonic: poach 可以指非法狩猎或在沸水中煮食物，其词源可追溯至古法语 pochier，意为侵入或偷取。
example: I decided to poach some pears for dessert.
我决定水煮一些梨作为甜点。

words.def_en: A covered area at the entrance of a building, like a house or church, with a roof and sometimes walls. A covered platform attached to the side of a house on the ground floor, open at the front.
words.mnemonic: porch 描述建筑物入口处有顶的遮盖区域，其词源来自拉丁语 porticus，指柱廊或门廊，体现了建筑功能的延续性演变。
example: She waited on the porch for someone to answer the door.
她在门廊上等着有人开门。

words.def_en: to talk about religion in public, like in a church to try to convince people to accept your beliefs or ideas to give advice in a way that annoys people
words.mnemonic: preach 来自古法语 prechier，源于拉丁语 praedicare，前缀 prae- 表示在前，词根 dic 表示宣告，本义为公开宣讲教义或理念。
example: The pastor preached about kindness and forgiveness.
牧师宣讲了仁慈和宽恕。

words.def_en: A foot-operated lever on a machine like a bicycle or car that makes it move or work. A foot-operated lever on a musical instrument like a piano or organ that controls the sound. To ride a bicycle. To push or turn the pedals on a bicycle or machine.
words.mnemonic: pedal 词根 ped 来自拉丁语，意思是脚，指踏板或脚踏装置，如自行车或乐器的控制部件。
example: He pushed the bike pedal to make it go faster.
他踩下自行车踏板，让它骑得更快。

words.def_en: A colored part of a flower that's usually soft and thin.
words.mnemonic: petal 源自希腊语 petalon 意为展开的叶子，在植物学中指花朵中色彩鲜艳的部分。
example: Each petal on the flower was a different shade of pink.
花上的每一片花瓣都是不同的粉色。

words.def_en: Quick to notice and understand things that are not obvious Related to how we see, hear, and understand things
words.mnemonic: 源于拉丁语 percipere，其中 per- 表示通过，capere 表示拿取，合起来形容敏锐洞察事物的能力。
example: She is very perceptive and often notices small details others miss.
她非常敏锐，经常注意到别人忽略的细节。

words.def_en: to treat someone badly and unfairly because of their race, religion, or beliefs to constantly bother someone and make their life difficult
words.mnemonic: persecute 源自拉丁语 persequi，意为追随或迫害，指对个人或群体的持续伤害。
example: Many groups have been persecuted for their religious beliefs throughout history.
历史上，许多群体因其宗教信仰而受到迫害。

words.def_en: likely to happen or become something in the future something that is expected to happen soon
words.mnemonic: prospective 词根 pro- 表示向前，spect- 表示看，来自拉丁语 prospectus，指预期的或未来的，与展望相关。
example: The company is interviewing prospective employees next week.
公司下周将面试应聘者。

words.def_en: a magazine or journal that comes out regularly, like every week or month
words.mnemonic: 基于 period 加上后缀 -ical，period 源于希腊语 periodos 意为循环或时期，描述定期出版的刊物如杂志。
example: I read a periodical about science every month to learn new things.
我每月阅读一本科学期刊，以学习新知识。

words.def_en: A person who studies how living organisms, like the human body, work.
words.mnemonic: physiologist 由希腊词根 physio-（自然或生命）和 -logist（研究者）组成，指研究生物体功能的科学家，与生理学紧密相关。
example: The physiologist explained how the heart pumps blood throughout the body.
生理学家解释了心脏如何将血液泵送到全身。

words.def_en: the science of how living things work how a living thing's body works
words.mnemonic: physiology 由希腊语 physis 自然和 logos 研究组成，专门探讨生物体的生命功能和机制，是医学的重要分支。
example: Studying physiology helps us understand how the human body works.
学习生理学有助于我们理解人体如何运作。

kaoyan_ex.text: But some of it remains in the brain, where it influences mood, behavior and physiology.

words.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“生理学”

words.def_en: A soft bag for resting your head on while sleeping. A soft cushion used to make seats more comfortable. To rest your head or something on a soft surface.
words.mnemonic: pillow 源于古英语 pyle，词源可追溯至拉丁语 pulvinus，意为软垫，常用于睡眠时支撑头部。
example: I put my head on the pillow to sleep.
我把头放在枕头上睡觉。

words.def_en: A farming tool with blades that digs and turns soil for planting. To dig and turn soil with a plow.
words.mnemonic: plow 来自古英语 plōh，直接指代农耕工具犁，用于翻土耕种，与农业历史紧密相关。
example: The farmer used a plow to prepare the field for seeds.
农民用犁翻地，为播种做准备。

words.def_en: A unit for measuring liquids, equal to about half a liter. A pint of beer, often ordered in pubs.
words.mnemonic: 这个单词源于古法语 pinte，可能来自拉丁语 pincta，意思是标记的刻度，因为传统液体容器上会有刻度，帮助理解它作为容量单位的含义。
example: The recipe needs one pint of milk.
食谱需要一品脱牛奶。

words.def_en: A sliding part in an engine that moves up and down or back and forth to make the engine work.
words.mnemonic: Piston 源自法语 piston，可能与意大利语 pistone（杵）相关，指引擎中往复运动的部件，这种设计源于早期机械的冲压原理。
example: The piston inside the engine moved up and down, creating power for the car.
发动机内部的活塞上下运动，为汽车产生动力。

words.def_en: marks like periods and commas that help make writing clear and easy to read
words.mnemonic: punctuation 来自拉丁语 punctus 点，演变出标点符号的意义，用于在文本中分隔句子和表达语气。
example: Using correct punctuation helps readers understand your writing better.
使用正确的标点符号有助于读者更好地理解你的写作。

words.def_en: to share or spread an idea or belief to a lot of people to officially announce a new law or rule
words.mnemonic: promulgate 源自拉丁语 promulgare，意为正式宣布或传播消息，如法律的颁布。
example: The organization aims to promulgate healthy eating habits among children.
该组织旨在向儿童推广健康的饮食习惯。

words.def_en: in a nice and respectful way in a proper way that may not be truly felt
words.mnemonic: 源自 polite，来自拉丁语 politus 文雅的，后缀 -ly 形成副词，表示礼貌地待人接物。
example: She asked politely for help with her bags.
她礼貌地请求帮忙拿包。

words.def_en: An animal that is hunted and eaten by another animal. A person who is easily tricked or harmed by someone else. to hunt and kill animals for food to harm or take advantage of someone who is weaker or vulnerable
words.mnemonic: 单词 prey 的词源可以追溯到古法语中的 preie，意指猎物，含义演变涉及捕食行为，在生态学中常描述被捕食的动物。
example: The lion hunts its prey in the grasslands.
狮子在草原上捕猎它的猎物。

words.def_en: used when you think something is likely true
words.mnemonic: presumably 意思是据推测或大概，源于 presume（假定）和拉丁语 praesumere。
example: He's not here, so presumably he went home early.
他不在这里，所以大概早回家了。

kaoyan_ex.text: Free-ranging elephants presumably also use this information to locate their preferred food.

words.kaoyan_note: 作adv.；意为“大概”

words.def_en: very good at doing something because you have learned and practiced it
words.mnemonic: 词根 pro 向前，fic 来自拉丁语 facere 做，ent 形容词后缀，表示熟练或精通
example: She is proficient in three languages and can speak them fluently.
她精通三种语言，并能流利地说它们。

words.def_en: stopping something bad before it happens
words.mnemonic: prevention 来自拉丁语 praeventio，prae- 之前和 venire 到来构成，意指预防措施，如健康或犯罪 prevention 计划。
example: Good hygiene is key to disease prevention.
良好的卫生习惯是预防疾病的关键。

words.def_en: the process of having babies or making babies
words.mnemonic: procreation 源于 pro（向前）和 creation（创造），描述生育或繁殖过程，是生物学生命延续的关键。
example: Some people think that the main purpose of having sex is for procreation.
有些人认为性行为的主要目的是为了繁衍后代。

words.def_en: to be in charge of a meeting or event
words.mnemonic: preside 来自拉丁语 praesidere，pre 表示在前，sidere 表示坐，意思是主持会议或担任领导角色。
example: She will preside over the conference to make sure everything runs smoothly.
她将主持这次会议，确保一切顺利进行。

words.def_en: a full and careful search for information a space machine that sends information back to Earth a thin tool doctors use to check inside the body a small device that tests or records information to ask questions to find out hidden information to examine or search with a tool
words.mnemonic: probe 源于拉丁语 probare 测试，指科学或医学中的探查工具，如太空探测器，用于深入检查未知领域。
example: The police started a probe to find out what caused the fire.
警方开始调查，以查明火灾原因。

words.def_en: writing that is not poetry
words.mnemonic: prose 来自拉丁语 prosa，原指直白、非诗体的语言，与诗歌形成对比，这个词源突出了它作为日常书面表达的特点。
example: The author's prose is clear and easy to read, unlike poetry which has rhymes and rhythm.
这位作者的散文清晰易读，不像诗歌那样有韵律和节奏。

kaoyan_ex.text: …a drawing Dickens felt was not faithful enough to his prose.

words.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“散文”

words.def_en: related to the quality or nature of something, not the amount
words.mnemonic: 拆解为 quality（质量）和 -ative（形容词后缀），表示定性的，关注性质而非数量，词源可追溯至拉丁语 qualitas。
example: The qualitative analysis showed that the new material is stronger and more durable than the old one.
定性分析表明，新材料比旧材料更坚固、更耐用。

words.def_en: relating to how much or how many of something there is
words.mnemonic: quantitative 基于 quantity 意为数量 添加后缀 -ative 表示相关 指涉及测量或数据的分析
example: The quantitative analysis showed that sales increased by 20% last quarter.
定量分析显示，上季度销售额增长了20%。

kaoyan_ex.text: Unfortunately, the long-term costs of using simple quantitative metrics to assess researcher merit are likely to be quite great.

words.kaoyan_note: 作adj.；意为“定量的”；常接 to 不定式/介词 to

words.def_en: a set of written questions used to gather information from people
words.mnemonic: 单词 questionnaire 借自法语，基于 question 表示问题，后缀 -naire 指相关工具，整体指一套用于调查或研究的问卷形式。
example: Please fill out this questionnaire about your shopping habits.
请填写这份关于您购物习惯的问卷。

words.def_en: related to different groups of people based on physical features connected to a person's ethnic background
words.mnemonic: racial 来自 race（种族），后缀 -ial 表示相关的，涉及不同人类群体的特征或问题，在社会科学中探讨多样性。
example: The new law aims to prevent racial discrimination in schools.
新法律旨在防止学校中的种族歧视。

words.def_en: showing great happiness or health giving off bright light spreading out from a center
words.mnemonic: radiant 来自拉丁语 radiare 意思放射，常描述发光或明亮的物体，如 a radiant smile 指灿烂的笑容。
example: Her radiant smile showed how happy she was.
她灿烂的笑容显示出她有多快乐。

words.def_en: A receptor is a part of your body that responds to certain things like heat or cold, and helps your body react in a specific way.
words.mnemonic: receptor 由 recept-（接收）加后缀 -or 构成，在生物学中指细胞表面接收信号的分子。
example: The scientist studied the receptors in the skin to understand how they react to different temperatures.
科学家研究了皮肤中的感受器，以了解它们如何对不同温度做出反应。

words.def_en: thinking about what is actually possible sensible and possible to achieve showing things as they really are
words.mnemonic: realistic 基于 real（真实的）加后缀 -istic，表示符合实际或现实主义的，常用于描述态度或艺术作品。
example: We need to be realistic about how much we can finish today.
我们需要现实地看待今天能完成多少工作。

kaoyan_ex.text: Those realistic possibilities are highlighted in the study presented by David Graddol.

words.kaoyan_note: 作adj.；意为“务实的”；常见搭配 in

words.def_en: relating to or resembling a ritual performed in a repetitive and often insincere manner
words.mnemonic: ritualistic 由 ritual 加后缀 -istic 构成，ritual 源于拉丁语 ritus，强调与仪式相关的或过分拘泥形式的行为。
example: The ceremony had a ritualistic quality, with participants following a set pattern of actions.
这个仪式具有仪式性的特点，参与者遵循一套固定的动作模式。

words.def_en: how closely something relates to the topic or situation how useful and important something is to people's lives or work
words.mnemonic: 单词 relevance 由 relevant 派生，relevant 来自拉丁语 relevare 意为减轻或举起，加上后缀 -ance 表示状态，演变为指事物与主题的相关性或适用性。
example: The relevance of his comment to our discussion was clear to everyone.
他的评论与我们讨论的相关性对每个人来说都很清楚。

kaoyan_ex.text: Just as the code-breaking has its wider relevance in the struggle for Spain, so his attempts to make his way up the promotion…

words.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“相关性”；常见搭配 for

words.def_en: A time in Europe from the 14th to 16th centuries when people rediscovered ancient Greek and Roman ideas, art, and learning. A new interest and growth in something that was not popular before.
words.mnemonic: 法语词意为重生，re-（再）加 naissance（出生），特指欧洲文艺复兴时期，影响艺术科学和思想复兴。
example: The renaissance brought amazing new art and science to Europe.
文艺复兴给欧洲带来了惊人的新艺术和科学。

kaoyan_ex.text: Hawaiian culture is not a relic of the past; it is a living culture undergoing a renaissance today.

words.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“文艺复兴”

words.def_en: to write something again to make it better or include new information a new version of something written to make it better or include new information
words.mnemonic: rewrite 由前缀 re- 再和 write 写组成，re- 源于拉丁语表示重复，整个词强调修改或重写文本的过程。
example: I need to rewrite my story to make it more interesting.
我需要重写我的故事，让它更有趣。

words.def_en: able to bounce back quickly from hard times able to return to its original shape after being bent or pressed
words.mnemonic: resilient 源于拉丁语 resilire，re- 表示回，salire 意为跳，指能弹回或恢复的，常用于形容材料或人的抗压能力。
example: Children are often resilient and can handle changes better than adults.
儿童通常很有韧性，比成年人更能应对变化。

kaoyan_ex.text: …the [target] children’s writing” and that they were “more resilient in their writing, more hopeful”.

words.kaoyan_note: 作adj.；意为“有弹性的”；常见搭配 in

words.def_en: unable to stay still or be happy where you are, because you are bored or need a change without real rest or sleep
words.mnemonic: restless 由 rest（休息）和 less（无）组合而成，表示无法安宁或持续躁动的状态，源自古英语词根。
example: The children were restless during the long car ride.
在漫长的乘车途中，孩子们坐立不安。

words.def_en: doing or saying something many times something that has been done or said before
words.mnemonic: 来自拉丁语 repetitio，re- 表示再，petere 意为寻求，指重复行为，音乐练习中 repetition 帮助提升技巧
example: The repetition of the same words made the speech boring.
重复同样的词语使演讲变得乏味。

words.def_en: A team race where each person does one part. A group that replaces tired workers or animals. A device that makes radio or TV signals stronger. To pass on information or news to someone. To send out TV or radio signals. To put something down again in a new way.
words.mnemonic: relay 词源是古法语 relai 指更换马匹，re- 表示再次，lay 意为放置，现在引申为信息传递或接力比赛。
example: She ran in the relay race.
她参加了接力赛跑。

words.def_en: to give back money you borrowed to do something nice for someone who helped you to be worth the time or effort you spend
words.mnemonic: repay 由前缀 re 和 pay 合成，re 表示回，pay 意为支付，组合起来指偿还债务或回报恩惠。
example: You must repay the loan next month.
你下个月必须偿还贷款。

words.def_en: to make a bad feeling or pain go away to make a problem less bad to make something less boring by doing something else to take over someone's job when their time is up to free a place from enemy forces to go to the toilet
words.mnemonic: relieve 源于拉丁语 relevare，re- 表示回或减轻，levare 意为举起，指缓解痛苦或压力，在医疗中常见。
example: The medicine helped relieve her headache.
药物帮助缓解了她的头痛。

words.def_en: in a surprising or unusual way that makes people notice
words.mnemonic: remarkably 源于 remark 注意，后缀 -ably 表示方式，因此指显著地或异常引人注目。
example: Remarkably, she finished the entire project in just one day.
值得注意的是，她仅用一天就完成了整个项目。

kaoyan_ex.text: Science-based analytical approaches proved remarkably successful in the hunt for German submarines in the Atlantic Ocean.

words.kaoyan_note: 作adv.；意为“引人注目地”；常见搭配 for

words.def_en: To make changes to the structure or appearance of a building or room.
words.mnemonic: 由前缀 re- 表示重新，加上 model 指模型，合为重塑或翻新
example: We decided to remodel the kitchen to make it more spacious and modern.
我们决定改造厨房，使其更宽敞、更现代。

words.def_en: taking someone or something away from a place getting rid of something dismissing someone from a job moving furniture from one house to another
words.mnemonic: removal 来自 remove 移除，后缀 al 将动词转为名词，描述拿走或清除某物的动作。
example: The removal of old furniture made the room look bigger.
搬走旧家具后，房间看起来更大了。

words.def_en: to go back on a promise or agreement
words.mnemonic: 拉丁语 renegare，前缀 re- 回，加 negare 否认，意思是食言或背弃承诺，牌类游戏中 renege 指违规出牌。
example: He reneged on his promise to pay back the money.
他违背了还钱的承诺。

words.def_en: hurting someone because they hurt you first beating someone who beat you before to hurt or punish someone because they have hurt you or someone you care about to get satisfaction by causing harm to someone who has harmed you
words.mnemonic: revenge 源于古法语 revenger，re- 表示回，venger 意为复仇，指为伤害而采取的报复行动。
example: He wanted revenge after they insulted him.
他们侮辱了他之后，他想报复。

words.def_en: based on what people say, but not confirmed

据报道，该公司计划下个月招聘更多员工。

words.def_en: to reply quickly in an angry, offended, or funny way a quick, angry, or funny reply a closed bottle with a long, bent spout used in labs to heat chemicals
words.mnemonic: retort 来自拉丁语 retorquere，re 表示回，torquere 表示扭，引申为尖锐反驳或化学中的蒸馏仪器。

当被指责迟到时，他反驳说其他人也都迟到了。

words.def_en: The area next to a river where you can walk or relax.
words.mnemonic: riverside 直接组合 river 表示‘河’和 side 表示‘边’，指河岸区域，常用于地理描述。

我们在河边享受了一顿宁静的野餐。

words.def_en: Made of three parts or involving three people or groups Three times as much or as many To become or make something three times bigger

words.def_en: a violent public disturbance by a crowd a colorful mix of many different things something very funny and entertaining to take part in a violent public disturbance

words.def_en: a reddish-brown coating that forms on metal when it gets wet and air touches it a plant sickness that makes red-brown spots, or the tiny living thing that causes it when metal gets covered with rust, or when something makes metal get rust

昨天我们看到一条鲨鱼在海滩附近游动。

words.def_en: a small amount of food eaten between meals something very easy to do to eat small amounts of food between meals

开会前我匆匆吃了点零食。

words.def_en: the thin stem that holds up a leaf, flower, or fruit on a plant a long, thin part that supports something, like an animal's eye to follow an animal or person quietly to catch or harm them to follow and watch someone illegally for a long time to walk in an angry or proud way to move through a place in a scary or threatening way

他吃苹果时，苹果的梗还连着。

words.def_en: A type of plant with flat, light green leaves that are used in cooking for their strong flavor. A person who is very wise and has a lot of knowledge or experience. Having a lot of wisdom and good judgment, often because of experience.
words.mnemonic: sage 来自拉丁语 sapius（智慧的），作为名词指智者，形容词表示明智的，如 sage advice 睿智的建议。
example: We used sage to make a delicious stuffing for the roast chicken.
我们用鼠尾草为烤鸡做了美味的填料。

words.def_en: having a healthy mind; not mentally ill sensible and reasonable
words.mnemonic: sane 词源可追溯到拉丁语 sanus，表示心智健全的或理智的，常用于法律或心理语境。
example: A sane person would not take such a dangerous risk.
一个理智的人不会冒这种危险。

words.def_en: a person who works on a ship a person who sails boats
words.mnemonic: 由 sail 帆和后缀 -or 表示人组成，直接指从事航海的水手。
example: The sailor worked hard on the ship every day.
这名水手每天在船上努力工作。

words.def_en: a person who makes or alters clothes, especially suits for men to make or change something to fit a specific need or person

他为了家人努力工作。

words.def_en: a man whose job is to sell things
words.mnemonic: salesman 由 sale（销售）和 man（人）构成，指从事商品推销的专业人员，女性形式为 saleswoman。
example: The salesman showed us many different cars to choose from.
销售员向我们展示了许多不同的汽车供选择。

words.def_en: a woman who sells things in a store
words.mnemonic: 组合 sales（销售）和 woman（女人），意思是女性销售员，从事商品推销工作。
example: The saleswoman helped me find the right size shoes.
女售货员帮我找到了合适尺码的鞋子。

words.def_en: a person who sells things for a living
words.mnemonic: salesperson 由 sales（销售）和 person（人）组合而成，指从事销售工作的人员，体现了商业角色的直接描述。
example: The salesperson helped me choose the right product for my needs.
销售员帮我选择了适合我需求的产品。

words.def_en: a person who speaks for a group or organization
words.mnemonic: spokesperson 由 spoke 说话和 person 人组合而成，指代表组织或群体发声的代言人，常见于媒体采访。

公司发言人向记者解释了新政策。

words.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“发言人”；常见搭配 for

words.def_en: To show respect by raising your right hand to your head, especially in the military. To show respect or admiration for someone or something. words.mnemonic: 来自拉丁语 salutare，词根 salus 意为健康或安全，原指问候，现在多用于军事敬礼以表达尊敬。
example: Soldiers salute their officers as a sign of respect.
士兵向军官敬礼以示尊重。

words.def_en: a solid figure of a person or animal, usually made from stone or metal and life-sized or larger
words.mnemonic: statue 源于拉丁语 statuere，意思是站立或建立，常指立体的雕塑作品。

这座城市在主广场上建造了这位著名领导人的雕像，以纪念他。

words.def_en: A light open shoe worn in warm weather, held on the foot by straps.
words.mnemonic: 音译为凉鞋，源自希腊语 sandalon，通过拉丁语传入，描述一种开放式鞋履。
example: She wore comfortable sandals to walk on the beach.
她穿着舒适的凉鞋在海滩上散步。

words.def_en: to make something very wet to fill something completely so no more can be added
words.mnemonic: saturate 来自拉丁语 saturare 使充满，表示使某物完全浸透或达到饱和状态，常用于化学或市场分析。
example: The rain will saturate the soil completely.
雨水将完全浸透土壤。

words.def_en: to put something in a certain place to understand something by looking at how it connects to other things
words.mnemonic: situate 源于拉丁语 situatus，意为放置或定位，与 site 相关，表示将某物置于特定位置。
example: They decided to situate the new bench under the big tree for shade.
他们决定把新长椅放在大树下遮阴。

words.def_en: a food made of chopped meat and spices stuffed into a casing
words.mnemonic: sausage 来自古法语 saussiche 可能源自拉丁语 salsus 咸的，因为传统香肠常经过腌制处理，这个词是直接音译食品的例子。

今天早上我煮了香肠当早餐。

神学讨论通常涉及对宗教文本和教义的深入分析。

公司制定了一项新规定，所有员工必须每年完成安全培训。

words.def_en: after that time or event
words.mnemonic: 由 there 和 after 简单组合而成，表示在那之后的时间点，常用于正式叙述中衔接事件。
example: He finished his studies in June and found a job shortly thereafter.
他六月份完成了学业，此后不久就找到了工作。

words.def_en: A thin string used for sewing or making cloth. An idea that connects different parts of something. A long, thin line of something. A series of connected messages online. The spiral ridge on a screw. Clothing. To pass something thin through a small opening. To move carefully through a crowded space. To join objects by passing something through them. To prepare equipment by passing material through it. To sew or twist thread into something.
words.mnemonic: thread 古英语 þræd 指线，在纺织中表示纱线，在计算机领域则指线程概念。
example: Be careful not to pull a thread on your shirt.
小心别拉衬衫上的线头。

words.def_en: to lean or make something lean to one side to favor or support one side more than another a leaning position or angle an attempt to win or achieve something
words.mnemonic: tilt 源自古英语词根，意为倾斜或使歪斜，在游戏文化中如扑克或电竞，tilt 还引申为情绪失控状态。
example: The table started to tilt when I put the heavy book on one end.
当我把那本沉重的书放在桌子一端时，桌子开始倾斜。

words.def_en: Trees grown for building and making things Wood ready for building and construction Large wooden beams used in building houses and ships A warning shout when a cut tree is falling
words.mnemonic: timber 源自古英语，指木材或树木，常用于建筑和家具制作，体现自然资源的利用。
example: The timber industry uses trees from forests to make wood products.
木材工业利用森林中的树木来制造木制品。

words.def_en: accepting others even when you disagree with them the body's ability to handle something without harm the allowed amount of variation in measurements
words.mnemonic: tolerance 源于拉丁语 tolerare（忍耐），后缀 -ance 表示状态，因此指宽容或忍耐能力。
example: We should show tolerance for people with different beliefs.
我们应该对持有不同信仰的人表现出宽容。

kaoyan_ex.text: …ideals was to be encouraged, as were ideas of liberty, tolerance and progress.

words.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“宽容”

words.def_en: a fast-moving, large amount of water a sudden, large amount of something that comes quickly
words.mnemonic: 拉丁语起源 torrens，意为急流；现代引申为大量数据下载，如 BitTorrent 技术中的文件传输。
example: The heavy rain turned the small river into a powerful torrent.
大雨把小河变成了湍急的洪流。

words.def_en: a special quality that makes you who you are
words.mnemonic: 借自法语 trait，源自拉丁语 tractus 拉或线，描述人或事物的显著特征或遗传特性。
example: Being kind to others is a good trait to have.
善待他人是一个好品质。

words.def_en: lasting for a short time only staying in a place for a short time only a person who stays in a place for a short time only
words.mnemonic: 前缀 trans- 表示跨越，后缀 -ient 表示状态，形容短暂经过的事物，在物理学中用于描述瞬态现象。
example: Happiness is often transient, coming and going quickly.
幸福往往是短暂的，来去匆匆。

kaoyan_ex.text: Transient investors, who demand high quarterly profits from companies, can hinder a firm’s efforts to invest in long-term…

words.kaoyan_note: 作adj.；意为“短暂的”

words.def_en: an abnormal growth of cells in the body that can cause health problems
words.mnemonic: tumor 来自拉丁语 tumor（肿胀），在医学上指细胞异常增生形成的肿块或瘤体。
example: Doctors found a small tumor during her check-up and are monitoring it closely.
医生在她的检查中发现了一个小肿瘤，并正在密切监测。

words.def_en: impossible to stop or prevent
words.mnemonic: un- 前缀表示否定，stop 意为停止，-able 后缀表示能力，整体形容无法阻挡的力量或趋势。
example: With her determination, she was unstoppable in achieving her goals.
凭借她的决心，她在实现目标的过程中势不可挡。

words.def_en: able to work or succeed able to live and grow on its own
words.mnemonic: viable 的词根来自拉丁语 vita，意思是生命，加上后缀 able 表示能够，因此指能够生存或可行的，在生物学和商业中常见。
example: The plan is viable and should work well.
这个计划是可行的，应该能很好地运作。

words.def_en: the middle part of your body, between your ribs and hips the part of clothing that goes around your waist having a certain type of waist
words.mnemonic: waist 来自古英语 wæst，指身体腰部区域，作为连接上半身和下半身的中间部分，常用于服装设计。
example: She wore a belt around her waist to hold up her pants.
她在腰间系了一条腰带以撑起裤子。

words.def_en: the part where your hand connects to your arm
words.mnemonic: wrist 指手腕关节，源自古英语，描述身体部位，可能与 writhe 的词根有关，表示弯曲或转动的动作。
example: She wore a watch on her wrist to tell the time.
她手腕上戴着一块手表来看时间。

words.def_en: A place in the past in England and Wales where very poor people were sent to live and work.
words.mnemonic: 由 work 和 house 组合而成，指历史上为穷人提供工作和住所的济贫机构，反映了社会救济制度的演变
example: During the Victorian era, many destitute families were forced to live in workhouses to survive.
在维多利亚时代，许多贫困家庭被迫住在济贫院以求生存。

kaoyan_ex.text: In Oliver Twist, he traces an orphan’s progress from the workhouse to the criminal slums of London.

words.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“济贫院”；常接 to 不定式/介词 to；常见搭配 of

words.def_en: Feeling a gentle sadness or longing, especially for something in the past.
words.mnemonic: 可能源于古英语 wist（智慧或存在），但更常见指惆怅或渴望的情绪，如 wistful look，其含义融合了沉思与淡淡的忧伤。
example: She gave a wistful smile while looking at her childhood photos.
她看着儿时的照片，露出了一丝惆怅的微笑。

words.def_en: a woman with magic powers, often shown as evil in stories a mean or nasty woman
words.mnemonic: witch 源自古英语 wicce，指的是传统中被认为拥有超自然力量的女性，与巫术文化紧密联系。
example: In the story, the witch used her magic to cast a spell on the village.
故事中，女巫用魔法对村庄施了咒语。

words.def_en: A meeting where people learn and practice a skill together. A room or building where people make or fix things with tools.
words.mnemonic: 由 work 工作和 shop 场所组合而成，描述工作车间或培训研讨会。
example: The writing workshop helped me improve my storytelling skills.
写作工作坊帮助我提高了讲故事的能力。

leftover.def_en: related to Buddhism a person who follows Buddhism
example: The Buddhist temple is a peaceful place for meditation.
这座佛教寺庙是一个宁静的冥想场所。

leftover.def_en: The system of religious beliefs and practices followed by the Roman Catholic Church, headed by the Pope.
example: Catholicism has a rich history and tradition that dates back to the early days of Christianity.
天主教有着悠久的历史和传统，可以追溯到基督教早期。

leftover.def_en: related to the beliefs of Jesus Christ connected to Christians showing good and kind behavior like a Christian a person who believes in Jesus Christ the main character in The Pilgrim's Progress
example: She follows Christian values in her daily life.
她在日常生活中遵循基督教价值观。

leftover.def_en: a person who believes in Karl Marx's ideas about society and economics based on Karl Marx's ideas about society and economics
example: As a Marxist, she believes that workers should control the means of production.
作为一名马克思主义者，她认为工人应该控制生产资料。

leftover.def_en: The lower part of the body that holds the stomach and other organs. The back part of an insect's body.
leftover.mnemonic: abdomen 表示腹部，来自拉丁语，可能源于 abdere（隐藏），因为腹部是内脏隐藏的部位，演变后特指人体躯干下部。
example: He felt a sharp pain in his abdomen after eating too much.
他吃太多后感到腹部剧痛。

kaoyan_ex.text: One study found that muscle loss and the accumulation of body fat around the abdomen are associated with a decline in fluid…

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“腹部”；常见搭配 with

leftover.def_en: referring to the belly area the muscles in the belly area
leftover.mnemonic: 源自拉丁语 abdomen 表示腹部，后缀 -al 构成形容词，描述与腹部相关的部位或状态。
example: She did some exercises to strengthen her abdominal muscles.
她做了一些锻炼来加强腹部肌肉。

kaoyan_ex.text: The researchers looked at data that included measurements of lean muscle and abdominal fat from more than accumulation,000…

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作adj.；意为“腹部的”；常见搭配 from

leftover.def_en: not normal or usual
leftover.mnemonic: abnormal 结合了 ab- 偏离和 normal 正常，描述事物超出常规范围或出现异常。
example: The doctor said the test results were abnormal and needed further checking.
医生说检查结果异常，需要进一步检查。

leftover.def_en: very silly or not making sense things that are very silly or not making sense
leftover.mnemonic: absurd 来自拉丁语 absurdus，前缀 ab- 远离和词根 surdus 愚蠢的，含义从不协调演变为不合理或荒谬，体现逻辑上的缺陷。
example: The idea of cats driving cars is absurd.
猫开车的想法是荒谬的。

kaoyan_ex.text: It would be absurd to try to track the changing price of sports cars since 1695, but to ask the same question of nails makes…

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作adj.；意为“荒谬的”；常接 to 不定式/介词 to

leftover.def_en: as said by someone or something based on or matching something
leftover.mnemonic: according to 作为短语，accord 意为一致，to 表示方向，整体指根据或与某事物相符，常用于引用信息或规则。
example: According to the weather report, it will rain tomorrow.
根据天气预报，明天会下雨。

leftover.def_en: a person who keeps track of money and financial records for people or businesses
leftover.mnemonic: accountant 由 account 意为账户或计算，以及后缀 -ant 指从事特定职业的人组成，因此指专业处理财务和账目的会计人员。
example: The accountant helps the business manage its money and taxes.
会计帮助企业管理资金和税务。

leftover.def_en: Acrylamide is a chemical that is used in making things like plastics and is also found in some cooked foods. It might be harmful to our health.
leftover.mnemonic: 化学名词，acryl 与丙烯酸相关，amide 指氨的衍生物，常用于描述高温烹饪中形成的化合物，如炸薯条中的潜在物质。
example: Studies have shown that acrylamide can be found in starchy foods that have been fried or baked to a golden brown color.
研究表明，丙烯酰胺可以在油炸或烘烤至金黄色的淀粉类食物中找到。

kaoyan_ex.text: While studies have shown that acrylamide can cause neurological damage in mice, there is no conclusive evidence that it causes…

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“丙烯酰胺”；常见搭配 in

leftover.def_en: a person who works to bring about social or political change
leftover.mnemonic: activist 来自 active（活跃的）加后缀 -ist，指积极参与社会运动的人，如环保或人权倡导者。
example: The activist organized a peaceful protest to protect the local park.
这位活动人士组织了一场和平抗议，以保护当地的公园。

leftover.def_en: able to adjust or change to fit new conditions or situations
leftover.mnemonic: 来自 adapt 适应 ad- 向 aptare 适合 加后缀 -able 表示可适应的 能应对变化
example: She is very adaptable, so she can easily fit into any new environment.
她适应性很强，所以能轻松融入任何新环境。

leftover.def_en: next to or very near something else
leftover.mnemonic: 前缀 ad- 表示朝向，词根 jacere 来自拉丁语意为扔，合为邻近的
example: The park is adjacent to the school, so children can play there after class.
公园毗邻学校，所以孩子们放学后可以在那里玩耍。

leftover.def_en: located next to something else, or sharing a common boundary
leftover.mnemonic: 前缀 ad- 表示朝向，join 是连接，后缀 -ing 表状态，意为相邻或毗连的区域。
example: The adjoining houses shared a common fence.
相邻的房子共用一道围栏。

leftover.def_en: the time in life when a person is an adult
leftover.mnemonic: 基于 adult，adult 来自拉丁语 adultus 长大，adulthood 指成年期，通常在 18 岁开始 legal adulthood
example: Many important decisions are made during adulthood.
许多重要决定是在成年期做出的。

kaoyan_ex.text: It peaks in young adulthood, levels out for a period of time, and then generally starts to slowly decline as we age.

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“成年期”；常见搭配 for

leftover.def_en: the arrival of something important the four weeks before Christmas in Christianity
leftover.mnemonic: 源于拉丁语 adventus（到来），由 ad（向）和 venire（来）组成，常指重要事件或人物的出现，比如基督降临节。
example: The advent of smartphones changed how we communicate.
智能手机的出现改变了我们的沟通方式。

kaoyan_ex.text: The advent of electronic publishing and authors’ need to find outlets for their papers resulted in thousands of new journals.

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“来临”；常见搭配 of

leftover.def_en: a word that describes how, when, where, or how much something happens
leftover.mnemonic: 拉丁语 ad- 表示到或添加， verbum 意思动词，组合为修饰动词的词类，在语法中描述动作的方式。
example: The word 'quickly' is an adverb that tells us how someone runs.
“quickly”这个词是一个副词，告诉我们某人跑步的方式。

leftover.def_en: someone who pays to promote their products or services
leftover.mnemonic: 源于 advertise 做广告，其中 ad- 表示朝向， vertere 转向，后缀 -er 指从事广告的人或实体。
example: The advertiser wanted to reach young people, so they chose to put their ad on social media.
广告商想接触年轻人，所以他们选择在社交媒体上投放广告。

leftover.def_en: in the air or flying carried through the air trained to jump from planes to fight
leftover.mnemonic: air 指空气，borne 是 bear 的过去分词意为被携带，因此 airborne 描述在空气中传播或飞行的状态，如军事中的空降部队或病毒扩散方式。
example: The plane becomes airborne after takeoff.
飞机起飞后升空。

leftover.def_en: even though; although
leftover.mnemonic: albeit 是中古英语 although it be 的缩写，用于引入让步从句，表示尽管，常见于正式文本。
example: She accepted the job offer, albeit with some hesitation about the long hours.
她接受了这份工作，尽管对长时间工作有些犹豫。

kaoyan_ex.text: She is proud that several sculptures have even gone on display again, albeit sometimes beneath protective cases.

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作conj.；意为“尽管”

leftover.def_en: a step-by-step method for solving a problem or completing a task
leftover.mnemonic: algorithm 源自9世纪阿拉伯数学家 al-Khwarizmi 的名字，现指计算机科学中的计算步骤，是 AI 和编程的核心概念。
example: The search algorithm helps find information quickly on the internet.
搜索算法有助于在互联网上快速找到信息。

kaoyan_ex.text: In 2016, researchers developed an algorithm to recognize suspicious citation patterns, including groups of authors that…

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“算法”；常接 to 不定式/介词 to

leftover.def_en: next to or at the side of someone or something next to or at the side of something together with or at the same time as something or someone
leftover.mnemonic: Alongside 由 along 和 side 组合而成，along 表示沿着，side 表示边，因此指在物体旁边或并行，体现英语复合词的直观性。
example: He walked alongside me all the way home.
他一路陪着我走回家。

kaoyan_ex.text: The proposal is that it should sit alongside the existing city of culture title, which was held by Hull in 2017, and has been…

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作adv.；意为“旁边”；常见搭配 of

leftover.def_en: used to introduce another choice or option
leftover.mnemonic: alternatively 源于 alternative（替代的），用于提出不同选项或可能性。
example: You can take the bus to the city center. Alternatively, you could walk if you have time.
你可以乘公交车去市中心。或者，如果你有时间，也可以步行。

leftover.def_en: A light, silver-colored metal that is used to make many things like cans, foil, and car parts.
leftover.mnemonic: aluminum 源于 alum 矿物，词根 alumin- 来自拉丁语 alumen，后缀 -ium 表示金属元素，因此是轻质金属铝，广泛用于包装材料。
example: We wrapped the food in aluminum foil to keep it fresh.
我们用铝箔把食物包起来以保持新鲜。

leftover.def_en: feeling very surprised and impressed
leftover.mnemonic: 单词 amazed 源于古英语 amasian，其中 a- 表示强调，mase 意为困惑，整体指被意外事件强烈震惊或困惑的状态。
example: She was amazed by the beautiful sunset.
她被美丽的日落惊呆了。

kaoyan_ex.text: We are amazed today at the mere number of plays produced, as well as by the number of dramatists writing at the same time for…

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作adj.；意为“惊叹”；常见搭配 of；以 -ed 形式出现

leftover.def_en: having more than one meaning a word or phrase with more than one meaning being unclear or hard to understand
leftover.mnemonic: 词根 ambi- 表示两者，guity 源自 agere 驱动，合起来描述模棱两可的状态，在语言或逻辑中常见歧义现象。
example: The ambiguity in his words made it hard to know what he really meant.
他话语中的歧义让人难以理解他的真实意图。

kaoyan_ex.text: …impacts, entails considerable savings in time, energy and ambiguity.

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“多义性”

leftover.def_en: in the middle of or surrounded by something during a particular situation or event
example: The house stood amidst tall pine trees.
房子矗立在高大的松树之中。

leftover.def_en: related to family members from a long time ago
leftover.mnemonic: ancestral 来自 ancestor 祖先，后缀 -al 表示属性，形容与家族先辈相关的传统或遗产。
example: The painting has been in my family for generations; it's part of our ancestral heritage.
这幅画在我家传了好几代；它是我们祖传遗产的一部分。

kaoyan_ex.text: Perhaps that is why we explore the starry skies, as if answering a primal calling to know ourselves and our true ancestral homes.

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作adj.；意为“祖先的”

leftover.def_en: A condition where your blood doesn't have enough red cells or hemoglobin, making you feel tired and look pale.
leftover.mnemonic: 源自希腊语 anaimia，其中 an- 表示缺乏，haima 指血液，anemia 描述了血液不足的医学状况，常用于诊断贫血。
example: The doctor diagnosed her with anemia due to her pale skin and constant fatigue.
医生根据她苍白的皮肤和持续的疲劳诊断她患有贫血。

leftover.def_en: the joint that connects your foot to your leg
leftover.mnemonic: ankle 一词可能演化自古英语 angle 表示弯曲，强调脚踝作为身体关节的转折点，帮助理解其结构功能。
example: She twisted her ankle while running and had to stop.
她跑步时扭伤了脚踝，不得不停下来。

leftover.def_en: happening every year
leftover.mnemonic: annually 来自 annual（每年的），词根是拉丁语 annus（年），表示每年发生一次的事件。
example: The company reviews its budget annually to plan for the next year.
公司每年审查预算，为下一年做规划。

kaoyan_ex.text: The global impact is about $71 billion annually.

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作adv.；意为“每年”

leftover.def_en: the state of being unknown to others the quality of being plain or ordinary
leftover.mnemonic: anonymity 源于希腊语 anonymia，由 an-（无）和 onyma（名字）构成，指匿名状态，在数字时代与隐私保护紧密相关。
example: Online forums often provide anonymity for users who want to share opinions without revealing their identity.
在线论坛通常为用户提供匿名性，以便他们分享意见而不暴露身份。

leftover.def_en: one of two long, thin parts on the head of some insects and animals, used to feel and touch things a device made of wire or metal rods for receiving or sending radio and TV signals
leftover.mnemonic: 词源为拉丁语，原指帆船的桁杆，在生物学中用于昆虫触角，在电子学中演变为天线装置，用于接收信号，如电视或广播设备的关键部件。
example: The insect uses its antenna to sense its surroundings.
昆虫用它的触角感知周围环境。

leftover.def_en: A person who studies human societies, cultures, and their development.
leftover.mnemonic: anthropo- 前缀来自希腊语，表示人类，-logist 表示专家，合起来指研究人类文化和社会的学者。
example: The anthropologist spent years living with the tribe to better understand their way of life.
这位人类学家花了数年时间与部落生活在一起，以更好地了解他们的生活方式。

kaoyan_ex.text: According to Dr Nikhil Chaudhary, an evolutionary anthropologist at Cambridge University, these practices, known as…

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“人类学家”；常见搭配 at

leftover.def_en: the science of studying humans, their history, and how they behave and develop.
leftover.mnemonic: anthropology 来自希腊语 anthropos 人类和后缀 -logy 学科，指研究人类文化和社会的人类学，与 AI 领域的 intelligence 类似，都是科学分支的缩写基础。
example: In my anthropology class, we learn about different cultures and how people live around the world.
在我的人类学课上，我们学习不同的文化以及世界各地的人们如何生活。

leftover.def_en: intended to reduce or prevent poverty relating to efforts against poverty the activity or policy of fighting poverty
example: The government launched an antipoverty program to help low-income families.
政府启动了一项反贫困计划，以帮助低收入家庭。

kaoyan_ex.text: …2008 to 2012— including during Indonesia’s phase-in of the antipoverty program—in 7,468 forested villages across 15 provinces.

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作adj.；意为“反贫困的”；常见搭配 in

leftover.def_en: used to say something is no longer true or happening
leftover.mnemonic: any 来自古英语，表示任何，more 意为更多，组合后指额外的数量或程度，常用于否定句或疑问句中表达不再需要的意思。
example: I don't eat meat any more because I became a vegetarian.
我不再吃肉了，因为我成了素食者。

leftover.def_en: used to add more to an idea or point even though something is true used to change or end a topic used to correct or adjust what was said in a messy or careless way
leftover.mnemonic: anyhow 是 any 和 how 的组合词，强调随意或不管怎样，常用于口语表达不确定性。
example: I don't think we should go; anyhow, it's too late now.
我认为我们不应该去；反正现在也太晚了。

leftover.def_en: A tiny bug that can damage plants by sucking their sap.
leftover.mnemonic: aphid 可能来自希腊语 aphis，是一种常见的蚜虫害虫，常侵害植物。
example: The gardener sprayed the roses to get rid of the aphids.
园丁给玫瑰喷药以去除蚜虫。

leftover.def_en: a person who asks for something, like a job or school admission
leftover.mnemonic: applicant 来自 apply，ad- 表示向，plicare 意为折叠，因此是申请职位的人，在求职中 applicant 指提交申请者。
example: The company received many applications, but only a few applicants were selected for interviews.
公司收到了许多申请，但只有少数申请人被选中参加面试。

kaoyan_ex.text: …of quality as well as quantity into the assessment of an applicant’s papers.

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“申请人”

leftover.def_en: A system where someone learns a job by working with skilled workers.
leftover.mnemonic: apprenticeship 来自 apprentice（学徒），其词根是古法语 aprentiz（学习者），加上后缀 -ship 表示状态，指一段正式培训期。
example: After completing his apprenticeship, he became a master craftsman.
完成学徒期后，他成为了一名工匠大师。

kaoyan_ex.text: And if the postgraduate student population also grows rapidly and there is loss of a close apprenticeship relationship between…

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“学徒制”

leftover.def_en: in a way that is right for the situation
leftover.mnemonic: 基于 appropriate 词根，源于拉丁语 appropriatus 适合的，后缀 -ly 构成副词，表示以恰当或合适的方式行动。
example: She dressed appropriately for the formal event.
她穿着得体，适合这个正式场合。

kaoyan_ex.text: We are hopeful with our shops now open again that normality will return and that we will be allowed to buy appropriately.

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作adv.；意为“恰当地”

leftover.def_en: suitable for growing crops
leftover.mnemonic: arable 词根是拉丁语 arare 意为耕种，因此描述土地适合耕作，常与农业相关。
example: Farmers cultivate the arable land to grow wheat and other crops.
农民耕种可耕地以种植小麦和其他作物。

leftover.def_en: A person who makes decisions or judgments about what is best or most appropriate.
leftover.mnemonic: arbiter 源于拉丁语 arbiter（裁判），词根 arbit- 表示判断，指仲裁者或权威决定者，如时尚界的 arbiter of style。
example: The teacher acted as an arbiter to resolve the students' argument.
老师充当仲裁者来解决学生的争论。

leftover.def_en: used to say that something could be considered true, although it is not certain or other people might not agree
leftover.mnemonic: 词根 argue 来自拉丁语 argutare（争辩），后缀 -ably 表示方式，意为可争辩地或有理由地，用于表达不确定观点。
example: He is arguably the best actor of his generation.
他可以说是他那一代最优秀的演员。

leftover.def_en: Someone who has been taken into custody by the police because they are suspected of a crime. A person who has been arrested and is now being held by the police for a possible legal violation.
leftover.mnemonic: arrestee 由 arrest（逮捕）加后缀 -ee（表示受动者）构成，指被逮捕的人，arrest 本身源于拉丁语 arrestare（阻止）
example: The arrestee was questioned for hours by the police about the robbery.
被捕者被警方就抢劫案审问了数小时。

leftover.def_en: a thin stick with a sharp point that is shot from a bow a mark (➞) that shows direction
leftover.mnemonic: arrow 源于古英语 arwe，直接表示射箭的武器，词源简单，在现代符号中常代表方向或指示。
example: The archer shot the arrow at the target.
弓箭手向目标射出了箭。

leftover.def_en: an object made by a person, especially one from the past that is interesting or important
leftover.mnemonic: Artefact 来自拉丁语 arte factum 意为人工制造 在考古学中指人造物品 如古代陶器 体现人类活动的痕迹。
example: The museum displayed an ancient artefact found during the archaeological dig.
博物馆展示了一件在考古挖掘中发现的手工制品。

leftover.def_en: A medical condition that results in pain, swelling, and stiffness in one or more joints of the body.
leftover.mnemonic: arthritis 源自 arthr（关节）和 itis（炎症），字面意为关节发炎，是医学中描述关节炎的常用术语。
example: Osteoarthritis is a common type of arthritis that affects many people as they age.
骨关节炎是一种常见的关节炎类型，影响许多老年人。

leftover.def_en: To say something is caused by or comes from someone or something. To give a quality or feature to someone or something.
leftover.mnemonic: ascribe 源于拉丁语 ascribere，由 ad- 表示向和 scribere 写组成，意为归因于或归功于特定原因。
example: He ascribes his success to hard work and determination.
他将自己的成功归因于努力和决心。

leftover.def_en: to kill an important person, often for political reasons
leftover.mnemonic: assassinate 源于 assassin 暗杀者，源自阿拉伯语 hashshashin，指针对重要人物的秘密谋杀行为。
example: The group planned to assassinate the president during the parade.
该团体计划在游行期间暗杀总统。

leftover.def_en: A small rocky object that orbits the sun.
leftover.mnemonic: 由希腊语 aster 星 和 eidos 形状组合而成，字面意思是星形物体，在太阳系中特指那些围绕太阳运行的小行星。
example: The telescope captured a beautiful picture of an asteroid.
望远镜捕捉到了一颗小行星的美丽图像。

leftover.def_en: a person who travels and works in space
leftover.mnemonic: astronaut 组合 astro- 星星和 naut 航海者，指星际旅行者，关联现代宇航员探索太空的职业。
example: The astronaut floated in the space station, looking at Earth through the window.
宇航员漂浮在空间站里，透过窗户看着地球。

leftover.def_en: The trait of being appealing or pleasing to the senses, especially sight. The quality of being appealing or desirable, often in a non-physical sense.
leftover.mnemonic: attractiveness 由 attract 吸引加后缀 -ive 和 -ness 构成，表示吸引力或魅力，在生物学中常指求偶时的特征。
example: Her attractiveness was not just in her looks, but also in her personality.
她的魅力不仅在于外貌，还在于她的个性。

leftover.def_en: related to sound that is recorded or broadcast sound that has been recorded
leftover.mnemonic: audio 来自拉丁语 audire，意为听，词根与听觉相关，表示声音的传输或录制，现代常与 audio 设备如耳机或音响联系。
example: The audio recording of the lecture is available online.
讲座的录音可以在线获取。

leftover.def_en: to wait for someone or something something that will happen to someone
leftover.mnemonic: 前缀 a- 表示动作，结合 wait 等待，await 指正式地等待某事发生，常用于书面语或正式场合。
example: We await your reply to our invitation.
我们期待您对我们的邀请给予回复。

kaoyan_ex.text: The digital services tax now awaits the signature of President Emmanuel Macron, who has expressed support for the measure, and…

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作v.；意为“等待”；常见搭配 of

leftover.def_en: the scenery or background that you can see behind something the situation or circumstances that are happening at the same time as an event a large piece of material, often decorated, that hangs behind a stage or at the back of a room
leftover.mnemonic: backdrop 由 back（后面）和 drop（幕布）组成，在戏剧中表示背景，引申为事件发生的环境。
example: The mountains made a beautiful backdrop for our picnic.
群山为我们野餐提供了美丽的背景。

kaoyan_ex.text: …Dickens to write a story in monthly installments, as a backdrop for a series of woodcuts by the then-famous artist Robert Seymour, who had…

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“背景”；常见搭配 by

leftover.def_en: When a plan or action has a result that is worse than expected, it backfires. When something makes a loud noise like an explosion, it backfires.
leftover.mnemonic: backfire 由 back 和 fire 组成，原指引擎反冲或火器回火，现在比喻计划产生相反效果。
example: The surprise party I organized for my friend backfired when they found out before the event.
我为朋友组织的惊喜派对适得其反，他们在活动前就发现了。

kaoyan_ex.text: …to keep in mind that trying to maintain eye contact may backfire if you’re trying to convince someone who has a different set of beliefs than you,”…

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作vi.；意为“适得其反；反噬”

leftover.def_en: to arrange for most of the payments, costs, or work to happen at the end of a period to put more weight or emphasis on the later part of something the practice of arranging payments or costs to occur mainly at the end
example: The company decided to backload the project costs into the final quarter.
该公司决定将项目成本后移至最后一个季度。

leftover.def_en: Work that has been delayed and needs to be done.
leftover.mnemonic: backlog 由 back 后和 log 记录组成，原指库存未处理的原木，现泛指工作积压。

假期过后，有大量积压的电子邮件需要回复。

leftover.def_en: A sport where players hit a shuttlecock over a net using rackets.
leftover.mnemonic: badminton 以英格兰的 Badminton House 命名，这项运动起源于19世纪，现在指羽毛球，是全球流行的室内球类运动。
example: We play badminton in the gym every Saturday morning.
我们每周六早上在体育馆打羽毛球。

leftover.def_en: A short vertical post that supports the rail of a staircase or balcony.
leftover.mnemonic: baluster 源自意大利语 balaustro，与石榴花形状相似，指楼梯栏杆的支柱。
example: The balusters on the staircase added a touch of elegance to the design.
楼梯上的栏杆为设计增添了一丝优雅。

leftover.def_en: related to a formal meal or event where many people gather to eat
leftover.mnemonic: 来自 banquet 宴会，后缀 -ing 表活动，常用于指举办或参与盛大宴会的场景。
example: The hotel has a large banqueting hall for special events.
这家酒店有一个大型宴会厅，用于举办特殊活动。

leftover.def_en: a metal frame used to cook food over fire outside an outdoor meal where food is cooked on a grill to cook food on a grill over fire
leftover.mnemonic: 词源来自西班牙语 barbacoa，原为泰诺语中木架烤架的意思，现在泛指户外烧烤，常与 BBQ 文化关联。
example: We cooked burgers on the barbecue in the backyard.
我们在后院的烧烤架上做了汉堡。

leftover.def_en: a person who cuts men's hair a shop where men get haircuts
leftover.mnemonic: 源于拉丁语 barba（胡子），直接相关理发师职业，常联想到 barber shop 理发店。
example: The barber gave me a nice haircut.
理发师给我理了个漂亮的发型。

leftover.def_en: something you buy for less money than usual an agreement where both sides get something they want to talk about price to get a better deal
leftover.mnemonic: bargain 词源是古法语 bargaignier 讨价还价，演变为交易或便宜货的概念。
example: I found a bargain on shoes at the store sale.
我在商店促销中淘到了一双便宜鞋。

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“特价商品”；常见搭配 at；以 -ing 形式出现

leftover.def_en: A big farm building used to store crops or keep farm animals. A large, plain, and unattractive building. A building where buses or trucks are parked when not in use.
leftover.mnemonic: 词源来自古英语 bereærn，bere 是大麦，ærn 是房子，原指谷仓，后泛指农场储存建筑。
example: The farmer keeps hay and animals in the barn.
农夫在谷仓里存放干草和饲养动物。

leftover.def_en: The line at each end of a tennis court or the boundary line in baseball where a player can run. A starting point or standard level used for comparison.
leftover.mnemonic: baseline 由 base（基础）和 line（线）组成，指测量或评估的起始参考点，在体育或数据分析中广泛使用。

比赛中，球员击球，使其刚好落在底线内。

leftover.def_en: in a way that is very nice to look at or hear very well or perfectly
leftover.mnemonic: 基于 beauty 美丽，加上后缀 -ful 形成形容词，再添加 -ly 转为副词，意为以优美的方式。
example: The flowers in the garden bloom beautifully every spring.
花园里的花每年春天都开得很美。

leftover.def_en: to make something look nicer
leftover.mnemonic: beautify 拆解为名词 beauty 和后缀 -ify，beauty 指美丽，-ify 是使动后缀，因此意思为使变美或美化，常用于艺术或环境改善。
example: We planted flowers to beautify our garden.
我们种花来美化花园。

leftover.def_en: Make a new friend, especially someone who needs help.
leftover.mnemonic: 前缀 be- 表示使成为，加上 friend（朋友），指主动与某人建立友谊关系。
example: When she moved to our neighborhood, I decided to befriend her and help her settle in.
当她搬到我们社区时，我决定和她交朋友，帮她安顿下来。

leftover.def_en: related to how someone acts or behaves related to the study of how people and animals act
leftover.mnemonic: behavioral 基于 behavior（行为）和形容词后缀 -al，描述与行为有关的；在心理学中，指行为科学或治疗。
example: The teacher noticed behavioral changes in the student after the incident.
事件发生后，老师注意到该学生行为上的变化。

leftover.def_en: A standard way to measure how well other things are doing. To compare the quality of something with other things.
leftover.mnemonic: 由 bench 和 mark 组成，原指测量师在长凳上刻标记作为参考点，现在泛指性能标准或基准。
example: By setting a high benchmark, the new product shows other companies how to improve.
通过设定高标杆，这款新产品向其他公司展示了如何改进。

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“基准”；后接 that 从句；常见搭配 in

leftover.def_en: A person who provides financial support or assistance to others, such as an individual, a school, or a charity.
leftover.mnemonic: benefactor 由 bene- 好和 factor 做者组成，指提供帮助或捐赠的恩人。
example: The hospital was able to expand its facilities thanks to the generosity of its benefactors.
得益于捐助者的慷慨，医院得以扩建其设施。

leftover.def_en: a product that sells very well, often a book
leftover.mnemonic: bestseller 是复合词 best 最好加上 seller 销售品，直接指畅销商品，出版行业 bestseller 榜单标识热门书籍或作品。
example: Her new book became a bestseller within weeks of its release.
她的新书在发布后几周内就成了畅销书。

leftover.def_en: A book, product, or author that is very popular and has been sold to many people.
leftover.mnemonic: bestselling 是复合词，best 表示最好，selling 来自 sell 销售，整体形容书籍或产品销量领先，如 bestselling novel，体现了市场成功的概念。
example: The author just released a new bestselling novel that everyone is talking about.
这位作者刚刚发布了一本畅销新小说，大家都在谈论它。

leftover.def_en: occurring every two months or twice a month
leftover.mnemonic: bimonthly 前缀 bi- 表示二，加上 monthly 每月的，因此可以指每两个月一次或每月两次，具体含义需根据上下文确定。
example: The magazine is published bimonthly, so we get new issues every other month.
这本杂志是双月刊，所以我们每隔一个月收到新一期。

leftover.def_en: The place where someone was born or where something started. The place where something first happened.
leftover.mnemonic: birth 词根来自古英语 byrþ 表示出生，place 源自拉丁语 platea 意为地点，合起来直接指代出生地，常用于描述历史人物的故乡。
example: My birthplace is a small town that's famous for its history.
我的出生地是一个以历史闻名的小镇。

leftover.def_en: A small, sweet, hard-baked cake for one person. A soft bread roll, often eaten with gravy. A pale yellow-brown color.
leftover.mnemonic: 源自法语 biscuit，bis- 意为两次， cuit 指烤熟的，原指烤两次以延长保存的面包，现在泛指脆饼干。
example: I like to have a biscuit with my tea.
我喜欢喝茶时配一块饼干。

leftover.def_en: very strange or unusual
leftover.mnemonic: 词源可能源于意大利语 bizzarro 愤怒或古怪，含义演变为奇异的，与超现实主义艺术风格相联系。
example: The bizarre costume made everyone stare at the party.
那件奇异的服装让派对上所有人都盯着看。

leftover.def_en: a line of descendants from a particular ancestor
leftover.mnemonic: bloodline 是 blood（血）和 line（线）的组合，指家族血统或遗传谱系。
example: The royal family is known for its distinguished bloodline.
王室以其高贵的血统而闻名。

leftover.def_en: The path that blood takes as it moves through the body.
leftover.mnemonic: bloodstream 由 blood 血和 stream 流组合而成，字面指血流，描述血液在体内循环的系统。
example: The medicine entered the bloodstream quickly, providing relief from the pain.
药物迅速进入血液，缓解了疼痛。

kaoyan_ex.text: Oxytocin is made primarily in the central lower part of the brain, and some of it is released into the bloodstream.

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“血流”

leftover.def_en: a loose top for women, often worn with skirts or pants
leftover.mnemonic: blouse 直接借自法语，指宽松上衣，中文常音译为衬衫，体现服饰文化中的外来词影响。
example: She wore a beautiful silk blouse to the office meeting.
她穿着一件漂亮的丝绸衬衫去参加办公室会议。

leftover.def_en: A detailed plan for a building or machine, printed with white lines on blue paper. A detailed plan for how to do something or achieve a goal. The genetic plan in every cell that determines how a living thing grows and looks.
leftover.mnemonic: blueprint 字面意思是蓝色的印刷图，源自建筑行业中的图纸制作，blue 指蓝色，print 指印刷品，现在常用于比喻详细计划或设计。
example: The engineer used the blueprint to build the new machine.
工程师使用蓝图来建造新机器。

leftover.def_en: not sharp or pointed very direct and honest, not trying to be polite to make something less strong or effective to make a sharp edge or point less sharp

刀很钝，切不了面包。

leftover.def_en: Extra money given as a reward for good work Something extra that is better than expected
leftover.mnemonic: bonus 来自拉丁语 bonus，意为好，因此指额外的好处或奖金，在职场 bonus 常作为绩效奖励。
example: The company gave all employees a bonus at the end of the year for their hard work.
公司年底给所有员工发了奖金，以奖励他们的辛勤工作。
