leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“奖金”；常见搭配 of

leftover.def_en: a strong drink made from wine one serving of brandy
leftover.mnemonic: brandy 源自荷兰语 brandewijn，其中 brand 表示燃烧，指的是蒸馏过程中酒液被加热，最终演变为一种烈酒名称。
example: He poured a glass of brandy after dinner.
晚餐后他倒了一杯白兰地。

leftover.def_en: an important new discovery or success new and very successful for the first time
leftover.mnemonic: breakthrough 是组合词 break（打破）和 through（通过），指在科技或研究中取得的关键突破。
example: Scientists made a breakthrough in cancer research that could save many lives.
科学家在癌症研究方面取得了一项突破，可能挽救许多生命。

kaoyan_ex.text: Stand in the shoes of scientists and witness the degree to which breakthroughs emerge from accidents, conflict and sheer…

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“突破”；常见搭配 from

leftover.def_en: using few words when speaking or writing lasting a short time
leftover.mnemonic: 来自拉丁语 brevitas，词根 brevis 意为短的，强调表达简洁的特性，在写作或演讲中提倡简短有力。
example: The author's brevity made the story easy to understand.
作者行文简洁，使故事易于理解。

leftover.def_en: a flat case for carrying papers and documents
leftover.mnemonic: briefcase 是组合词，由 brief 文件和 case 箱子构成，直译为文件箱，常用于商务场景携带文档。
example: He carried his important papers in a black briefcase to the meeting.
他带着一个黑色公文包，里面装着重要文件去开会。

leftover.def_en: A fast internet connection that is always on. Signals that use many different frequencies.
leftover.mnemonic: broadband 拆解为 broad（宽阔）和 band（频带），在电信中指高速互联网连接，能同时传输多数据流。
example: Many homes now have broadband for fast internet access.
许多家庭现在都有宽带，可以快速上网。

kaoyan_ex.text: …in 2015, but rejected the commission’s authority to require broadband providers to do much of anything.

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“宽带”；常接 to 不定式/介词 to；常见搭配 of

leftover.def_en: a small book or magazine with pictures and information about a product or service
leftover.mnemonic: 直接源自法语，指折叠式宣传册，常用于旅游或产品推广中。
example: The travel company sent me a brochure with photos of their vacation packages.
旅游公司给我寄了一本小册子，里面有他们度假套餐的照片。

kaoyan_ex.text: Visit any antiques store and you’ll encounter artifacts from the past: photographs, letters, a brochure detailing the Sinclair…

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“宣传册”

leftover.def_en: a short news report on radio or TV an official announcement about something important a printed news report from an organization
leftover.mnemonic: 词根源于意大利语 bulletino，意为小公告，bull- 部分与印章相关，现指新闻简报或公告牌。
example: The weather bulletin warned of a coming storm.
天气预报警告即将有暴风雨。

leftover.def_en: a small round sweet cake a small round flat bread roll hair twisted into a round shape on the head the two sides of a person's bottom
leftover.mnemonic: 词源可追溯到古法语 bugne 指小圆面包，含义演变后常用于描述发型或食物如汉堡 bun。
example: I ate a sweet bun with icing for breakfast.
我早餐吃了一个带糖霜的甜面包。

leftover.def_en: A desk with drawers and a top that folds down to write on. A piece of furniture with drawers for storing clothes. An office or organization that provides information on a specific subject. A government department or part of a government department (US).
leftover.mnemonic: bureau 源自法语，原指覆盖粗毛布的办公桌，后引申为机构，如 Federal Bureau of Investigation 代表调查局。
example: The small room had a bed, a chair, and a bureau for writing letters.
小房间里有一张床、一把椅子和一个写字台。

leftover.def_en: a person who breaks into a building to steal things
leftover.mnemonic: burglar 可能源于中古英语 burgler，由 burg 城镇和 lar 贼组成，意为入室窃贼，常与 burglar alarm 防盗警报关联。
example: The burglar stole jewelry from the house at night.
窃贼夜间从房子里偷走了珠宝。

leftover.def_en: able to be burned or set on fire suitable for burning as fuel capable of being destroyed by fire
example: The factory only uses burnable waste for energy production.
该工厂仅使用可燃垃圾进行能源生产。

leftover.def_en: A word or phrase that becomes popular and is used a lot, especially in connection with a specific topic.
leftover.mnemonic: 由 buzz 和 word 合成，buzz 比喻流行或热议，word 指词语，因此是时尚术语，常见于商业或科技领域如 AI 讨论中。
example: The buzzword for this year's marketing strategy is 'sustainability'.
今年营销策略的热词是“可持续性”。

leftover.def_en: A place where you choose your food, pay for it, and then take it to your table to eat.
leftover.mnemonic: cafeteria 借自西班牙语 cafetería，café 意为咖啡，teria 是场所后缀，原指咖啡店，现常表示自助餐厅形式。
example: The school cafeteria offers a variety of healthy meals for students.
学校食堂为学生提供各种健康餐食。

leftover.def_en: A soft, silver-white metal found in bones, teeth, and chalk.
leftover.mnemonic: calcium 来自拉丁语 calx（石灰），指一种常见元素，在人体骨骼和牙齿中扮演重要角色。
example: Milk contains calcium, which helps build strong bones and teeth.
牛奶含有钙，有助于强健骨骼和牙齿。

leftover.def_en: A unit of heat energy, especially in nutrition. Relating to heat or calories.
example: The caloric content of this meal is quite high.
这顿饭的热量含量相当高。

leftover.def_en: A unit that measures the energy in food A unit that measures heat energy
leftover.mnemonic: calorie 来自拉丁语 calor（热），calor- 表示热量单位，常用于营养学衡量食物能量。
example: An apple has about 95 calories, which gives your body energy.
一个苹果大约含有95卡路里，能为身体提供能量。

leftover.def_en: A desert animal with a hump on its back that people ride or use to carry things. A soft, thick, light brown cloth made from camel hair, often used for coats.
leftover.mnemonic: 这个词源自古希腊语 kamēlos，通过拉丁语 camelus 传入英语，指骆驼这种适应沙漠的动物，在运输中扮演重要角色。
example: The camel walked across the hot desert sand.
骆驼走过炎热的沙漠沙地。

leftover.def_en: a long, man-made waterway for boats to travel on or for moving water to farms a tube in the body that carries liquids, food, or air
leftover.mnemonic: 词源来自拉丁语 canalis，意思是水道或渠道，指人工开凿的运河，如著名的巴拿马运河在运输中扮演重要角色。
example: Large ships can travel through the Panama Canal to cross between oceans.
大型船舶可以通过巴拿马运河在海洋之间穿行。

leftover.def_en: a person trying to get a job or win an election a person taking a test someone or something likely to be chosen for something
leftover.mnemonic: candidate 来源于拉丁语 candidatus，candidus 意为 '白色'，古罗马时期候选人穿白色长袍象征纯洁，现在指竞选者。
example: The candidate for mayor promised to fix the roads.
市长候选人承诺修路。

kaoyan_ex.text: But it can also be antagonistic, such as when a political candidate turns toward their competitor during a debate and makes…

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“候选人”

leftover.def_en: a strong, rough cloth used for making tents, sails, and for painting a piece of cloth used for painting; an oil painting on cloth
leftover.mnemonic: canvas 来自拉丁语 cannabis（大麻），因早期用大麻纤维制成粗布，现在指帆布或画布，在艺术和航海中有广泛应用。
example: The artist painted on a large canvas.
画家在一块大画布上作画。

leftover.def_en: A member of a Catholic religious order known for wearing a cowl. A small monkey with a tuft of hair on its head like a cowl.
leftover.mnemonic: capuchin 名源于 Capuchin 修道士，因为猴子毛色类似其袍子；同时，capuchin 也与卡布奇诺咖啡文化相关
example: The capuchin friar walked through the town, his cowl casting a shadow.
卷尾猴修士走过小镇，他的兜帽投下阴影。

leftover.def_en: A substance in food like sugar or starch that gives your body energy. Foods that have a lot of carbohydrate, such as bread, potatoes, and rice.
leftover.mnemonic: carbohydrate 拆解为 carbo（碳）和 hydrate（水合物），源自化学术语，指含碳氢氧的化合物，营养学中为能量来源
example: Foods like bread and pasta contain carbohydrate to give you energy.
面包和意大利面等食物含有碳水化合物，能为你提供能量。

leftover.def_en: The remains of an animal after it has been slaughtered and the skin, fur, or feathers have been removed.
leftover.mnemonic: carcass 源自法语 carcasse，可能源于拉丁语 caro 意为肉，现在指动物尸体或残骸。
example: The hunters left the carcass of the deer in the forest.
猎人们把鹿的尸体留在了森林里。

leftover.def_en: without worries or stress
leftover.mnemonic: 由 care 忧虑和 free 自由组合而成，carefree 描述一种无忧无虑、轻松自在的生活态度，常与积极心态相关。
example: Children playing in the park look happy and carefree.
在公园里玩耍的孩子们看起来快乐又无忧无虑。

leftover.def_en: A person who looks after and provides care for someone who cannot fully care for themselves, such as a child, elderly person, or someone with a disability.
leftover.mnemonic: 组合 care 照顾和 giver 给予者，指提供护理的人如家庭看护
example: The caregiver assisted the elderly woman with her daily tasks, ensuring she remained comfortable and safe.
护理员协助老妇人完成日常事务，确保她舒适安全。

kaoyan_ex.text: …of humans’ evolutionary history, but introducing additional caregivers could reduce stress and maternal depression, which could have a “knock-on”…

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“照顾者”

leftover.def_en: a thick fabric used to cover floors a thick layer covering the ground to cover a floor with carpet to cover with a thick layer to scold someone angrily
leftover.mnemonic: carpet 词源是拉丁语 carpere（采摘），后指编织的地毯，如 red carpet 事件象征隆重场合。
example: The new carpet makes the room feel warm.
新地毯让房间感觉很温暖。

kaoyan_ex.text: Those pieces included small beds of roses and other items as well as a few dozen “nature carpets”—large rectangles decorated…

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“地毯”

leftover.def_en: a place where people play games to win money
leftover.mnemonic: 来自意大利语 casino，原意是小房子，后来演变为指代娱乐场所特别是赌场，体现了词义的变迁。
example: We went to the casino to play slot machines and card games.
我们去赌场玩老虎机和纸牌游戏。

leftover.def_en: a complete list of items, typically arranged in alphabetical or other systematic order to make a systematic list of items
example: The library has an online catalogue of all its books.
图书馆有所有藏书的在线目录。

kaoyan_ex.text: …Victorians” makes up only a tiny percentage of the vast catalogue of photographic portraiture created between 1840 and 1900, the majority of which…

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“目录，清单”；常见搭配 of

leftover.def_en: A sudden event that causes great harm to many people. An event that causes serious problems or failure for someone or something.
leftover.mnemonic: 源自希腊语 katastrophē，词根 kata- 表示向下，strephein 意为转动，演变为突然的灾难性事件。戏剧中常指高潮的悲剧转折。
example: The earthquake was a catastrophe that destroyed entire cities and left thousands homeless.
这场地震是一场灾难，摧毁了整座城市，导致数千人无家可归。

leftover.def_en: a popular word or phrase repeated and used to represent an idea or to gain attention
leftover.mnemonic: catchword 由 catch 捕捉和 word 单词组成，意思是能快速抓住注意力的流行语或口号。
example: These days, 'sustainability' has become the catchword in all discussions about the environment.
如今，“可持续性”已成为所有环境讨论中的流行词。

leftover.def_en: to provide food and drinks for an event
leftover.mnemonic: cater 词源可追溯至古英语 cateren，最初指提供食物，现在扩展为迎合需求，如 catering service 餐饮服务。
example: The restaurant will cater the company party with delicious meals.
这家餐厅将为公司派对提供美味的餐点。

kaoyan_ex.text: This 11 approach aims to cater to individual preferences and enhance the concept of beauty tailored to each person’s unique…

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作v.；意为“承办宴席”；常接 to 不定式/介词 to

leftover.def_en: farm animals like cows and bulls raised for milk or meat
leftover.mnemonic: cattle 来自拉丁语 capitale（资本），最初泛指财产，后来专指牛等家畜，体现从财富到特定动物的演变。
example: The farmer raises cattle for milk and beef.
农民饲养牛以获取牛奶和牛肉。

kaoyan_ex.text: There, as people got more money, some of them may have more cleared land for cattle to raise for meat, Ferraro says.

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“牛，牛只”；常接 to 不定式/介词 to；常见搭配 for

leftover.def_en: a very famous person being famous
leftover.mnemonic: celebrity 从拉丁语 celebritas 名声演变而来，指因成就或媒体曝光而成名的人。
example: The celebrity visited the children's hospital and made everyone smile.
这位名人参观了儿童医院，让每个人都露出了笑容。

kaoyan_ex.text: …choices of customers regarding their hobbies, favourite celebrities, and fashions to provide unique content in marketing messages put out through…

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“名人”；常接 to 不定式/介词 to

leftover.def_en: a place where dead people are buried in the ground
leftover.mnemonic: 这个词源于希腊语 koimeterion，原意是安息之地，演变为现代墓地的含义，体现从睡眠场所到埋葬地的变迁。
example: We visited the cemetery to put flowers on our grandmother's grave.
我们去墓地给祖母的墓前献花。

leftover.def_en: the practice of controlling or limiting what people can see, read, or say
leftover.mnemonic: censor 源于拉丁语 censere 评估，-ship 表示制度，整体指对信息进行审查的制度。
example: The government's censorship prevents people from sharing certain opinions online.
政府的审查制度阻止人们在网上分享某些观点。

leftover.def_en: An official count of a country's population and other information about people.
leftover.mnemonic: Census 源于拉丁语 censere，意为评估或登记，现在专指政府的人口普查活动，用于统计社会数据。
example: The government conducts a census every ten years to count all the people living in the country.
政府每十年进行一次人口普查，以统计全国所有居民。

leftover.def_en: A temperature scale where water freezes at 0° and boils at 100°. Relating to or measured on the temperature scale where water freezes at 0° and boils at 100°.
leftover.mnemonic: 来自拉丁语 centi- 意思百，和 gradus 意思度或步，组合表示百分度的温度测量单位。
example: The weather forecast shows 25 degrees centigrade for tomorrow.
天气预报显示明天25摄氏度。

leftover.def_en: A unit of length equal to one hundredth of a meter.
leftover.mnemonic: centimeter 由 centi- (百分之一) 和 meter (米) 构成，是公制长度单位，常用于科学测量。
example: The caterpillar was about two centimeters long.
这只毛毛虫大约有两厘米长。

leftover.def_en: the feeling of being sure about something something that is definitely true or will definitely happen
leftover.mnemonic: certainty 由 certain（确定的）加后缀 -ty 构成，certain 来自拉丁语 certus，因此这个词表示确定或无疑的事实。
example: The certainty of his success gave him confidence to continue working hard.
他成功的确定性给了他继续努力工作的信心。

leftover.def_en: the person who leads a meeting or organization
leftover.mnemonic: chairperson 由 chair 指椅子象征权威和 person 指人构成，表示会议主持人，公司治理中 chairperson 负责引导董事会讨论。
example: The chairperson called the meeting to order and asked everyone to sit down.
主席宣布会议开始，并请大家就座。

leftover.def_en: A soft white rock White or colored sticks used for writing or drawing To write or draw with chalk
leftover.mnemonic: chalk 是一种书写工具，常用于教学场景如黑板写字，其名称来自古英语。
example: The white cliffs are made of chalk.
白色悬崖是由白垩构成的。

kaoyan_ex.text: His pictures of a Glanville fritillary rising from the sea-pinks beside the chalk cliffs of Compton Bay on the Isle of Wight…

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“白垩”；常见搭配 of

leftover.def_en: A bubbly white wine from the Champagne region in France, often enjoyed during celebrations.
leftover.mnemonic: champagne 借自法语，源自法国 Champagne 地区，特指该地生产的起泡酒，因此得名。
example: We opened a bottle of champagne to celebrate the good news.
我们开了一瓶香槟来庆祝这个好消息。

leftover.def_en: The leader of the government in Germany or Austria. The government minister in charge of money and finances. The honorary head of a British university. The head of some American universities. A title for some high-ranking British government officials.
leftover.mnemonic: chancellor 源于拉丁语 cancellarius，原指法庭门卫，现指政府高官或大学校长，体现职务的演变
example: The chancellor of Germany meets with other world leaders.
德国总理与其他世界领导人会面。

leftover.def_en: The ability to please or attract people. A pleasant or attractive quality. A small object worn for good luck. Words or acts believed to have magic power. To please or attract someone to make them like you. To control or protect using magic.
leftover.mnemonic: 单词 charm 源自拉丁语 carmen，原意是歌曲或咒语，后来含义演变为具有吸引力的魅力或护身符。
example: His natural charm made everyone like him.
他天生的魅力让每个人都喜欢他。

leftover.def_en: having or showing the belief that one gender, nation, or group is superior to others displaying excessive pride in or loyalty to one's country
leftover.mnemonic: 源自 Nicolas Chauvin，一个法国士兵象征极端爱国主义，演变为沙文主义。现代用法常关联性别或民族优越感。
example: His chauvinistic attitude towards women was outdated and offensive.
他对女性的大男子主义态度既过时又令人反感。

leftover.def_en: to love and protect someone or something very much to keep a happy thought or hope in your mind for a long time
leftover.mnemonic: cherish 来自古法语 cherir，基于词根 cher-（宝贵的或亲爱的），常用于表达深切爱护或珍视的情感。
example: Parents cherish their children and keep them safe.
父母珍爱孩子并保护他们的安全。

kaoyan_ex.text: A. explore B. recall C. simplify D. cherish 10.

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作v.；意为“珍爱”

leftover.def_en: A small, round fruit that is red or black and has a pit inside. A tree that grows cherries or pretty flowers. The wood from a cherry tree. A bright red color. Bright red in color.
leftover.mnemonic: cherry 源自拉丁语 cerasum，通过古法语 cherise 演变而来，指樱桃水果或树，词源与植物传播相关。
example: I picked a ripe cherry from the tree.
我从树上摘了一颗成熟的樱桃。

leftover.def_en: A two-player game played on a board with black and white squares. Players move pieces like kings and queens following special rules to capture the opponent's king.
leftover.mnemonic: chess 源自波斯语 shah 国王，演变为国际象棋游戏，其中王是核心棋子；这项策略游戏在全球广泛流行。
example: I enjoy playing chess with my friends on weekends.
我喜欢在周末和朋友下国际象棋。

leftover.def_en: to bite food with your teeth to break it down before swallowing to bite on something repeatedly, often when nervous or thinking the action of chewing a type of chewy candy tobacco made for chewing
leftover.mnemonic: 直接源自古英语 ceowan，描述用牙齿磨碎食物的动作，即咀嚼。
example: Always chew your food well to help digestion.
总是充分咀嚼食物以帮助消化。

leftover.def_en: The act of a woman giving birth to a baby.
leftover.mnemonic: childbirth 由 child（孩子）和 birth（出生）组合而成，直接表示分娩过程，词源可追溯至中古英语。
example: During childbirth, the mother felt a mixture of pain and joy.
分娩时，母亲感受到痛苦与喜悦交织。

leftover.def_en: A pipe or structure that carries smoke from a fire up and out of a building. A narrow crack in rock that people can climb up.
leftover.mnemonic: chimney 来自古法语 cheminee，可能与希腊语 kaminos 意为炉子相关，指建筑物中排放烟雾的通道。
example: Smoke from the fireplace goes up the chimney and out of the house.
壁炉的烟顺着烟囱升到屋外。

leftover.def_en: Tiny string-like parts found in the center of cells in animals and plants. They carry the information that determines what traits living things have.
leftover.mnemonic: chromosome 来自希腊语 chroma 意思是颜色，和 soma 意思是身体，因为染色体在染色后显微镜下可见，这与细胞遗传相关。
example: Each person has their own unique set of chromosomes that make them who they are.
每个人都有自己独特的染色体组，这决定了他们是谁。

leftover.def_en: a roll of dried tobacco leaves for smoking, larger than a cigarette and not wrapped in paper
leftover.mnemonic: cigar 源自西班牙语 cigarro，可能来自玛雅语 sikar 抽烟，指卷制的烟草制品。
example: He enjoyed a fine cigar after dinner.
饭后他享用了一支上等雪茄。

kaoyan_ex.text: There were Pickwick coats and Pickwick cigars, and the plump, spectacled hero, Samuel Pickwick, became a national figure.

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“雪茄”

leftover.def_en: A small roll of tobacco wrapped in paper for smoking. The act of smoking a cigarette.
leftover.mnemonic: cigaret 是 cigarette 的变体，词源可追溯至法语 cigarette，源于西班牙语 cigarro，可能来自玛雅语，指香烟这种烟草制品。
example: He put a cigaret in his mouth and lit it.
他把一支香烟放进嘴里，点燃了它。

leftover.def_en: shaped like a circle moving in a circle using the same idea to prove itself sent to many people a notice sent to many people
leftover.mnemonic: circular 词根源于拉丁语 circus 圆圈，指圆形形状或循环过程，在数学和设计中常见。
example: The circular table was perfect for our family dinner.
那张圆桌非常适合我们的家庭聚餐。

leftover.def_en: showing prejudice or discrimination based on social class relating to or characterized by classism a person who discriminates against others based on social class
example: Her classist remarks about people from working-class backgrounds offended many listeners.
她对工人阶级背景的人发表的阶级歧视言论冒犯了许多听众。

leftover.def_en: A group of words with a subject and verb that forms part of a sentence. A rule or condition in a legal document that requires or forbids something.
leftover.mnemonic: clause 源于拉丁语 claudere（关闭），在语法中指句子中的独立分句，如合同条款。
example: The clause in this sentence describes the action.
这个句子中的从句描述了动作。

leftover.def_en: A sharp, curved nail on an animal's or bird's foot A sharp, curved body part on shellfish used for grabbing things A tool part shaped like a claw, used for holding or lifting To scratch or tear using claws or nails
leftover.mnemonic: claw 源自古英语 clawu，指动物用于抓握或攻击的爪子，常出现在描述猛禽或猫科动物时。
example: The cat used its claw to scratch the furniture
猫用爪子抓挠家具。

leftover.def_en: A clawback is when money that was given out or paid is taken back or returned.
leftover.mnemonic: clawback 是复合词，claw 爪子表示抓取，back 回表示返回，指追回已发放的资金，多用于金融领域。
example: The company had to deal with a clawback situation when they discovered the mistake in the payments.
当公司发现付款错误时，不得不处理追回款项的情况。

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“追回”；常接 to 不定式/介词 to

leftover.def_en: a heavy, sticky earth that hardens when baked, used to make pots, bricks, and other items
leftover.mnemonic: clay 是一种柔软的土壤，常用于制作陶器，其词源可追溯到古英语。
example: The artist shaped the clay into a beautiful vase.
艺术家将黏土塑造成一个漂亮的花瓶。

leftover.def_en: A product used to wash your face, often to take off makeup. A substance with chemicals in it that is used to clean things.
leftover.mnemonic: 基于 clean 清洁，加上后缀 -er 表示执行动作的工具，常见于日常清洁产品如洗面奶。
example: After a long day, she used a gentle cleanser to remove her makeup and cleanse her skin.
漫长的一天过后，她用温和的洁面乳卸妆并清洁皮肤。

leftover.def_en: religious leaders like priests or ministers
leftover.mnemonic: clergy 指神职人员，源于拉丁语 clericus，与教堂和宗教服务紧密联系。
example: The clergy help people in their religious communities.
神职人员帮助其宗教社区中的人们。

leftover.def_en: A phrase or idea that has been used so often that it is no longer original or interesting. Overused and lacking originality.
example: The film's plot was full of tired cliches about love and destiny.
这部电影的情节充满了关于爱情和命运的老套陈词滥调。

leftover.def_en: a very steep, high wall of rock
leftover.mnemonic: cliff 源于古英语 'clif'，表示陡峭的岩石地形，常出现在自然景观中。
example: The hikers stood at the edge of the cliff, looking down at the ocean below.
徒步旅行者站在悬崖边缘，俯瞰下面的海洋。

kaoyan_ex.text: His pictures of a Glanville fritillary rising from the sea-pinks beside the chalk cliffs of Compton Bay on the Isle of Wight…

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“悬崖”；常见搭配 of

leftover.def_en: Moving in the same direction as a clock's hands.
leftover.mnemonic: 基于 clock（时钟）和 -wise（方向），表示顺时针转动，因为传统钟表指针以此方向移动。
example: Turn the knob clockwise to open the door.
顺时针转动旋钮开门。

leftover.def_en: A small room or space for storing things. Keeping a secret about yourself. To put someone in a private room to talk or be alone.
leftover.mnemonic: 古法语 clos 指封闭空间，后缀 -et 表示小，原义为储藏衣物的壁橱，英语中隐喻未公开的秘密。
example: She keeps her shoes in the closet.
她把鞋子放在壁橱里。

leftover.def_en: resembling or having the characteristics of a clump forming or occurring in dense, irregular masses having a thick, compact, or lumpy appearance
example: The clumplike growth of the fungus made it easy to identify.
这种真菌的丛状生长使其易于识别。

leftover.def_en: rough or not smooth made of large pieces rude or impolite
leftover.mnemonic: coarse 词源可能来自古法语 cors，意为粗糙或不精细，常用于形容质地粗粝或言行粗鲁。
example: His coarse hands showed years of hard work.
他粗糙的双手显示出多年的辛苦劳作。

leftover.def_en: A strong illegal drug that makes people feel very excited and happy, but is very addictive. Doctors can use it in medicine to numb pain.
leftover.mnemonic: cocaine 来自 coca 植物名称，后缀 -ine 表示化学物质，是一种从古柯叶提取的 stimulant 药物。
example: Cocaine is a dangerous drug that can ruin lives and health when used illegally.
可卡因是一种危险的毒品，非法使用会毁掉生活和健康。

leftover.def_en: A person who moves to a new place to live and work, especially when it is controlled by another country.
leftover.mnemonic: colonist 来自 colony 殖民地，加上后缀 -ist 表示人，指在新领土定居的移民者。
example: The colonist from England built a small house on the new land.
来自英格兰的殖民者在这片新土地上建了一座小房子。

kaoyan_ex.text: …blazes dating back hundreds of years before European colonists arrived on the continent.

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“殖民者”；常见搭配 on

leftover.def_en: A tool with teeth used to tidy hair or hold it in place. The action of tidying hair with a comb. A honeycomb made by bees to store honey and eggs. The red crest on a rooster's head. To tidy hair using a comb. To search carefully for something. To clean and straighten wool or cotton with a comb.
leftover.mnemonic: 源于古英语 camb，指带齿的工具用于梳理头发，这个词根在日耳曼语系中常见。
example: She used a comb to fix her messy hair.
她用梳子整理凌乱的头发。

leftover.def_en: A bright object in space made of ice and dust that orbits the sun and has a glowing tail.
leftover.mnemonic: 词源来自希腊语 kometes，意为长发，指彗星拖着像头发一样的尾巴划过天空，这种天文现象常被视为预兆。
example: We saw a bright comet with a long tail in the night sky.
我们在夜空中看到了一颗拖着长尾巴的明亮彗星。

leftover.def_en: very common or ordinary something that happens often and is not special a boring or unoriginal remark
leftover.mnemonic: commonplace 结合 common（普通）和 place（地方），形容平凡事物或陈词滥调。
example: Using smartphones is commonplace in daily life.
使用智能手机在日常生活中很常见。

leftover.def_en: to make someone do something they might not want to do to cause a strong feeling or reaction
leftover.mnemonic: 前缀 com- 表示强调，pel 来自 pellere 意为推动，因此 compel 指施加压力强迫行动。法律语境中，compel testimony 要求证人作证。
example: The law can compel people to pay taxes.
法律可以强制人们纳税。

leftover.def_en: hard to stop or control unable to control one's behavior so interesting that it grabs your attention
leftover.mnemonic: compulsive 根源于拉丁语 compellere，com- 表示一起，pellere 是推，意为强迫性的，常形容难以控制的冲动行为。
example: She has a compulsive habit of checking her phone every few minutes.
她有每隔几分钟就检查手机的强迫性习惯。

leftover.def_en: required by law or rule
leftover.mnemonic: 词根来自拉丁语 compellere，com 表示一起，pellere 意思是推动，演变后指必须做的或强制的，如义务教育。
example: Wearing a helmet is compulsory for all motorcycle riders.
所有摩托车骑手都必须佩戴头盔。

leftover.def_en: possibly or theoretically
leftover.mnemonic: conceivably 来自 conceive（构想），加上后缀 -ably 表示可能性，意思是'可以想象地'，常用于表达假设情景。
example: Conceivably, the new technology could change the way we live.
可以想象，这项新技术可能会改变我们的生活方式。

leftover.def_en: working hard and being careful to do things well
leftover.mnemonic: 词根 con- 表示一起，scientia 源自拉丁语意为知识，conscientious 指基于良心而尽责的，在道德层面强调认真和责任感。
example: She is a conscientious worker who always completes her tasks carefully and on time.
她是一位尽职尽责的员工，总是认真按时完成任务。

leftover.def_en: an agreement that everyone in a group accepts
leftover.mnemonic: consensus 来自拉丁语 consentire，con- 表示一起，sentire 意思是感觉，组合起来指共同感觉或一致意见，常用于科学或政治领域。
example: The team reached a consensus on the best way to solve the problem.
团队就解决问题的最佳方式达成了共识。

kaoyan_ex.text: …after the organization failed five years earlier to build consensus between Hollywood and Silicon Valley to win passage of legislation in Congress…

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“共识”

leftover.def_en: A disease that can spread from person to person by close contact. A person who has a disease that can spread to others by close contact.
leftover.mnemonic: contagious 词根源于拉丁语 contagio，由 con- 表示一起和 tangere 表示接触组成，指通过接触传播的传染性疾病。
example: The flu is contagious, so stay home if you are sick.
流感具有传染性，所以如果你生病了，请待在家里。

leftover.def_en: a box, bottle, or other object used to hold or store things a large metal box used to transport goods on ships, trains, or trucks a pot or box used for growing plants
leftover.mnemonic: container 基于 contain，contain 来自拉丁语 continere，con- 一起，tenere 持有，后缀 -er 表示物，指容纳物品的器具，如海运集装箱。
example: Store food in a sealed container to keep it fresh longer.
将食物存放在密封容器中，以保持更长时间的新鲜。

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“容器”

leftover.def_en: To understand or explain something by considering the situation or environment it is in.
leftover.mnemonic: contextualize 由 context 和 ize 后缀组成，context 意思是背景，ize 表示使动，意为将事物置于上下文中理解。
example: To fully understand the painting, we need to contextualize it within the artist's life and the era it was created.
为了充分理解这幅画，我们需要将其置于艺术家的生活和创作时代背景中。

leftover.def_en: the quality of being easy, useful, or helpful something that makes life easier or more comfortable
leftover.mnemonic: 源自拉丁语 convenire，其中 con- 表示一起，venire 意为来，合起来指聚集或适合，演变为便利的意思；日常生活中如 convenience store 便利店就体现了这一概念。
example: Online shopping offers great convenience for busy people.
网上购物为忙碌的人们提供了极大的便利。

leftover.mnemonic: convenient 的词根是拉丁语 convenire（聚集），前缀 con- 表示一起，venire 是来，引申为方便或适合的。

leftover.mnemonic: copper 源自拉丁语 cuprum，因古代塞浦路斯岛 Cyprus 盛产此金属而得名，现在指一种重要的导电材料铜。
example: The house has copper pipes for water.
这所房子使用铜管供水。

kaoyan_ex.text: …by making his own telescope with mirrors composed of copper and tin.

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“铜”

leftover.def_en: A long narrow passage in a building with doors to rooms on both sides. A narrow strip of land or airspace that goes through another country's area. A long narrow area along a major road or river. A walkway along the side of a train with doors to compartments.
leftover.mnemonic: corridor 的词源是意大利语 corridore，意为奔跑的地方或通道，演变为英语中的走廊或过道，常用于建筑设计中。
example: Walk down the corridor to find the bathroom.
沿着走廊走，就能找到洗手间。

leftover.mnemonic: 词根 cor 表示完全，rupt 源于拉丁语 rumpere 打破，加上后缀 ive 构成形容词，意为导致道德或系统腐败的，常用于负面评价。
example: The corruptive influence of the city's underworld affected many young people.
城市黑社会的腐败影响了许多年轻人。

leftover.def_en: The outer part of certain body structures, like the brain or the skin of a tree.
leftover.mnemonic: cortex 源自拉丁语意为树皮或外壳，在生物学中延伸为大脑皮层或植物外皮的结构。
example: The doctor explained that the cortex is the outer layer of the kidney, which plays a crucial role in filtering blood.
医生解释说，皮质是肾脏的外层，在过滤血液中起着关键作用。

leftover.def_en: A hormone that helps the body respond to stress and is used in medicine for skin and muscle conditions.
leftover.mnemonic: cortisol 基于 cortex，词根是拉丁语 '树皮' 或 '外层'，指肾上腺皮质分泌的激素，后缀 -ol 表示它是一种类固醇。
example: Cortisol is often used in medicines to treat skin and muscle conditions.
皮质醇常用于治疗皮肤和肌肉疾病的药物中。

leftover.def_en: the entire universe seen as a well-ordered whole
leftover.mnemonic: cosmos 源于希腊语 kosmos，指有序的宇宙整体，与混沌相对。
example: Scientists study the cosmos to understand how stars and planets form.
科学家研究宇宙以了解恒星和行星是如何形成的。

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“宇宙”

leftover.def_en: a small house, usually in a rural area
leftover.mnemonic: cottage 由古英语 cot 小屋和名词后缀 -age 构成，指乡村小屋，cottage industry 表示家庭手工业。
example: They rented a small cottage near the lake for their vacation.
他们在湖边租了一间小别墅度假。

leftover.def_en: to balance something by having something equal but opposite something that balances something else by being equal but opposite
leftover.mnemonic: Counterbalance 由 counter（对抗）和 balance（平衡）组成，意为抵消重量或力量，在物理和工程领域用于描述均衡机制。
example: The good qualities of the product counterbalance its high price.
产品的优良品质抵消了其高昂的价格。

leftover.def_en: An action taken to stop or protect against something harmful or dangerous.
leftover.mnemonic: countermeasure 中的 counter 表示对抗，measure 表示措施，整体指为应对威胁而设计的防御性行动。
example: The town took countermeasures to prevent flooding.
该镇采取了应对措施以防止洪水。

kaoyan_ex.text: “While there is some optimism that emerging countermeasures and best practices may see piracy begin to plateau by 2027, there…

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“对策”

leftover.def_en: A paper or code that gives you a lower price when you buy something. A form you fill out to enter a contest or order something.
leftover.mnemonic: coupon 借自法语，原意是切下的小片，来自 couper 指切割；现在常用于商业中的折扣券或票根。
example: I used a coupon to get a discount on my coffee.
我用了一张优惠券来打折我的咖啡。

leftover.def_en: an open area surrounded by buildings, often found in castles or large houses
leftover.mnemonic: courtyard 是 court（庭院）和 yard（院子）的复合词，指被建筑物包围的露天庭院，常见于传统建筑。
example: Children played in the sunny courtyard between the buildings
孩子们在建筑物之间的阳光庭院里玩耍。

kaoyan_ex.text: …some 50 rectangular buildings, all of which had open courtyards.

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“庭院”

leftover.def_en: A person who is skilled in making things by hand, often with a high level of quality and detail.
leftover.mnemonic: 由 craft 手艺和 man 人组成，表示精通手工技能的工匠。
example: The furniture was crafted by a skilled craftsman.
这件家具是由一位熟练的工匠制作的。

leftover.def_en: A team sport played with a bat and ball on a field. A small insect that makes a chirping sound.
leftover.mnemonic: cricket 可能源于古英语 cricc，既指昆虫蟋蟀，也指板球运动，两者在英语文化中都有深厚历史。
example: We watched a cricket game at the park yesterday.
昨天我们在公园看了一场板球比赛。

leftover.def_en: a small, separated space in an office or room, often with desks or for changing clothes
leftover.mnemonic: 词源来自拉丁语 cubiculum 小房间，与 cube 立方体相关，cubicle 在现代指办公室隔间或小空间。
example: She keeps photos and a plant in her cubicle to make it feel like home.
她在自己的小隔间里放了照片和一盆植物，让它感觉像家一样。

leftover.def_en: related to cooking or the art of preparing food
leftover.mnemonic: culinary 来自拉丁语 culina 厨房，与烹饪艺术相关，常用于描述美食或厨艺技巧。
example: She attended a culinary school to learn how to make delicious dishes.
她上了一所烹饪学校，学习如何制作美味菜肴。

kaoyan_ex.text: On a cold winter’s day, few culinary pleasures can match it.

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作adj.；意为“烹饪的”

leftover.def_en: A piece of furniture with doors and shelves for storing things like dishes, food, or clothes. A built-in space in a wall with a door, used for storage.
leftover.mnemonic: cupboard 是组合词，由 cup 和 board 构成，原意是放置杯子的木板架，后泛指橱柜或储物柜。
example: I keep my plates and bowls in the kitchen cupboard.
我把盘子和碗放在厨房的橱柜里。

leftover.def_en: done very quickly and without paying attention to details
leftover.mnemonic: cursory 源于拉丁语 cursorius，词根 currere 意为奔跑，意指仓促的或表面的检查。
example: She gave the document a cursory glance before signing it.
她粗略地瞥了一眼文件就签了字。

leftover.def_en: the legal right or duty to care for someone or something the state of being held by police or in prison
leftover.mnemonic: 词源可追溯至拉丁语 custodia，词根 custod- 意为看守，常用于法律场景指监护或拘留状态。
example: The court decided the mother would have custody of the children after the divorce.
法院判决离婚后母亲拥有孩子的监护权。

leftover.def_en: A shape with round ends and straight sides, like a tube or can. A container that is shaped like a tube, often holding gas or liquid. The tube in an engine where the piston moves up and down.
leftover.mnemonic: 词源可追溯至希腊语 kylindros，指圆柱体，在工程或数学中常见。
example: A soup can is a good example of a cylinder shape.
汤罐是圆柱形状的一个好例子。

leftover.def_en: a yellow flower that looks like a trumpet and grows in the spring.
leftover.mnemonic: daffodil 指水仙花，词源可能来自荷兰语，是春天的象征，常用于诗歌或园艺。
example: The garden was full of bright daffodils, adding color to the spring day.
花园里开满了鲜艳的水仙花，为春日增添了色彩。

leftover.def_en: the part of the day when it is light outside
leftover.mnemonic: 简单组合 day（白天）和 time（时间），指白天的时段，与夜晚形成对比。
example: I prefer to do outdoor activities during daytime when it's bright.
我更喜欢在白天明亮的时候进行户外活动。

leftover.def_en: to make someone unable to see clearly for a short time because of bright light To amaze someone with beauty or skill. The effect of bright light that blocks clear vision. Something impressive that may confuse clear thinking.
leftover.mnemonic: dazzle 可能源于中古英语 daze 表示眩晕，加上 -le 后缀，表示强光或耀眼事物导致视觉模糊的效果。
example: The bright car lights dazzle me at night.
明亮的车灯在夜晚让我眼花缭乱。

leftover.def_en: In an extremely bright or impressive way. In a way that leaves someone impressed or overwhelmed by excellence or beauty.
leftover.mnemonic: dazzlingly 是 dazzle 的副词形式，dazzle 源自中古英语 dasen，意指使目眩，其词根可能与眩晕感相关，形容耀眼或令人惊叹的效果。
example: The stars shone dazzlingly in the clear night sky.
星星在晴朗的夜空中耀眼地闪烁。

leftover.def_en: unable to hear people who cannot hear not willing to listen
leftover.mnemonic: deaf 来自古英语，描述听力完全缺失的状态，词根强调无法感知声音，常用于形容听觉障碍。
example: The deaf child uses sign language to communicate.
这个失聪的孩子用手语交流。

leftover.def_en: A match or game that determines the winner of a competition.
leftover.mnemonic: decider 基于 decide 这个词，decide 来自拉丁语 decidere，其中 de- 表示 '离开'，caedere 是 '切'，原义为切断争议，引申为做决定的人或关键因素。
example: The final match was the decider, and the team's fate rested on the outcome.
决赛是决定胜负的一局，球队的命运系于结果。

leftover.def_en: to give property or rights to someone using a legal document something someone does, usually very good or very bad a signed legal document that proves you own property
leftover.mnemonic: deed 源自古英语 dǣd，指行为或契约，表示具体行动或法律文件。
example: He deeded the house to his daughter as a gift.
他把房子立契赠给了女儿。

leftover.def_en: To make someone look bad by saying or writing false or unkind things about them.
leftover.mnemonic: 单词 defame 源于拉丁语 diffamare，其中 de- 前缀表示向下或否定，fame 部分指名声，整体演变意为诽谤或中伤，即损害他人声誉的行为。
example: The journalist was sued for defaming the celebrity's character in the article.
该记者因在文章中诽谤这位名人的品格而被起诉。

leftover.def_en: a store or part of a store where you can buy prepared food such as meats, cheeses, or food from other countries
leftover.mnemonic: deli 是 delicatessen 的简写，源于德语，指售卖熟食和特色食品的小店，类似纽约风格的美食店。
example: I bought an amazing turkey sandwich from the deli.
我从熟食店买了一个超棒的火鸡三明治。

leftover.def_en: in a very pleasing and enjoyable way in a very satisfying or delightful manner
leftover.mnemonic: deliciously 是 delicious 的副词形式，词根源于拉丁语 deliciosus，来自 deliciae 表示‘愉悦’，形容以美味或享受的方式。
example: She savored the dessert, which was deliciously sweet.
她细细品尝了甜点，味道甜美可口。

leftover.def_en: to strongly criticize someone or something as wrong or bad to report someone's illegal actions to authorities
leftover.mnemonic: 拉丁语 de-（向下）和 nuntiare（宣布）结合，意思公开谴责或指控某人。
example: The leader will denounce the unfair rules at the meeting.
领导将在会议上谴责不公平的规则。

leftover.def_en: to strongly disapprove of something bad
leftover.mnemonic: deplore 来自拉丁语 deplorare，de-（向下）和 plorare（哭泣），原意为哀叹，现指强烈谴责或不满。
example: We deplore the use of violence in any situation.
我们谴责任何情况下使用暴力。

leftover.def_en: To make something worth less money or less value than before. To consider something as less important or valuable than it should be.
leftover.mnemonic: devalue 由前缀 de- 表示减少，加上 value 价值组成，意为贬值，在经济领域常描述货币价值下降
example: The government decided to devalue the currency to boost exports.
政府决定让货币贬值以促进出口。

kaoyan_ex.text: As degrees became universal, they became devalued.

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作v.；意为“贬值”；以 -ed 形式出现

leftover.def_en: still growing or changing related to growth or progress
leftover.mnemonic: developmental 基于 develop，其法语源 développer 意为展开，指与成长或进化相关的过程。
example: The child's developmental progress is being carefully monitored by doctors.
医生正在仔细监测孩子的发育进展。

leftover.def_en: tiny drops of water that form on surfaces overnight
leftover.mnemonic: dew 源自古英语 deaw，指清晨凝结在物体表面的水珠，与自然现象相关。
example: The morning dew covered the leaves with tiny water drops.
晨露在叶子上覆盖了小小的水滴。

leftover.def_en: a disease where the body has trouble controlling blood sugar levels
leftover.mnemonic: diabetes 来源于希腊语 diabainein，意思是 '穿过'，描述疾病中糖分通过尿液排出的特性，现指糖尿病。
example: People with diabetes need to monitor their blood sugar regularly.
糖尿病患者需要定期监测血糖。

leftover.def_en: A straight line through the center of a circle or round object from one side to the other. A measure of how much a lens or instrument can make things look bigger.
leftover.mnemonic: diameter 源自希腊语 diametros，dia- 意思是穿过，-meter 表示测量，因此指圆或球体中通过中心的直线距离。
example: The diameter of the pizza was 12 inches, making it perfect for sharing.
披萨的直径是12英寸，非常适合分享。

leftover.def_en: Someone who thinks or studies how ideas and culture spread from one place to another.
leftover.mnemonic: diffuse 扩散来自拉丁语 diffundere，后缀 -ist 表示主义者，指相信文化传播理论的人。
example: The diffusionist noticed that many cultures had similar traditions, which made him believe they must have come from a common source.
传播论者注意到许多文化有相似的传统，这让他相信它们必定源自一个共同的源头。

leftover.def_en: A calm and serious way of acting that makes people respect you Being treated with honor and respect by others Feeling good about yourself and knowing your own worth
leftover.mnemonic: dignity 源于拉丁语 dignitas，词根 dign- 表示值得，因此指人的内在价值或尊严，常用于道德或社会语境。
example: She kept her dignity even when others were being rude to her.
即使别人对她粗鲁无礼，她也保持了自己的尊严。

kaoyan_ex.text: One explanation might be the loss of dignity displayed through a cheesy grin.

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“尊严”

leftover.def_en: a hard choice between two equally bad options
leftover.mnemonic: 希腊语源 dilemma，di 表二，lemma 表前提，指两难困境，必须在两个不利选项中抉择。
example: She faced a dilemma: tell the truth and hurt her friend, or lie and feel guilty.
她面临一个两难境地：说实话会伤害朋友，说谎又会感到内疚。

leftover.def_en: working hard and carefully
leftover.mnemonic: 单词 diligence 源自拉丁语 diligentia，意指勤奋和细心，其词根 di-（表示彻底）和 legere（选择）组合，强调通过持续努力达到目标。
example: Her diligence in studying helped her get good grades.
她在学习上的勤奋帮助她取得了好成绩。

leftover.def_en: working hard and carefully
leftover.mnemonic: 来自拉丁语 diligere，词根 di- 表示仔细，legere 表示选择，原意勤奋挑选，演变为刻苦工作
example: She is a diligent worker who always completes her tasks on time.
她是一位勤奋的员工，总是按时完成任务。

leftover.def_en: to become or make something smaller or weaker to make someone or something seem less important
leftover.mnemonic: 词根源于拉丁语 diminuere，其中 mini- 表示小，整体意为减少大小或强度，描述逐渐减弱的过程。
example: The pain will diminish over time.
疼痛会随着时间的推移而减轻。

kaoyan_ex.text: Complex international, economic, technological and cultural changes could start to diminish the leading position of English as…

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作v.；意为“减弱”；常见搭配 of

leftover.def_en: a chemical made of two oxygen atoms and one atom of another element
leftover.mnemonic: dioxide 由希腊语 di 二和 oxys 酸组成，在化学中指含有两个氧原子的化合物，如二氧化碳。
example: Plants absorb carbon dioxide from the air during photosynthesis.
植物在光合作用过程中从空气中吸收二氧化碳。

kaoyan_ex.text: …carbon emissions if we can’t track the amount of carbon dioxide in the atmosphere, where it’s coming from and who’s producing it?

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“二氧化物”；常见搭配 in

leftover.def_en: any substance that makes things dirty, like dust, soil, or mud loose earth or soil bad information about someone that could hurt their reputation solid waste from the body
leftover.mnemonic: dirt 源自古英语 drit，原指污物或排泄物，词根与 dirty 相关，现在泛指泥土或土壤，在园艺中 dirt 是植物生长的基本介质。
example: Wash your hands to remove any dirt before eating.
吃饭前洗手以去除污垢。

leftover.def_en: when someone or something is lost and cannot be found when something stops existing or can no longer be seen
leftover.mnemonic: disappearance 由 dis 不、appear 出现和 ance 名词后缀组成，意为消失或失踪，如 sudden disappearance 突然消失，突出不再可见的状态。
example: The disappearance of the child worried everyone in the town.
孩子的失踪让镇上的每个人都忧心忡忡。

leftover.def_en: A person who finds or learns something new or something that was not known before. A person who finds something or someone that was hidden or not expected to be found.
leftover.mnemonic: 前缀 dis- 表示分开，cover 来自拉丁语 cooperire 覆盖，后缀 -er 表示人，因此意为发现者，如科学探索中的先驱。
example: The discoverer of the lost city was a famous explorer.
这座失落之城的发现者是一位著名的探险家。

leftover.def_en: A harmful action or situation that does more harm than good. An action that is not fair or helpful and causes negative effects.
leftover.mnemonic: 前缀 dis- 表示负面，词根 service 意为服务，因此指有害的行为或损害，如 do a disservice 表示帮倒忙。
example: Not fixing the broken fence would do a disservice to the neighborhood.
不修理破损的篱笆会对邻里造成损害。

kaoyan_ex.text: Greg Newberry: Emma Marris’s article is an insult and a disservice to the thousands of passionate, dedicated people who work…

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“帮倒忙”；常接 to 不定式/介词 to；常见搭配 of

leftover.def_en: to mix into a liquid and become part of it to make a solid mix into a liquid to officially end something like a marriage or agreement to fade away or make something fade away to suddenly start laughing or crying to break down or destroy something, especially with chemicals
leftover.mnemonic: dissolve 来自拉丁语 dissolvere，其中 dis 表示 apart 而 solvere 表示 to loosen，原意是松开分离，常用于描述物质在水中分解。
example: Sugar will dissolve in hot tea.
糖会在热茶中溶解。

leftover.def_en: A part of a company's profit paid to its shareholders. A benefit or advantage gained from something. A payment shared among a group of people. A number to be divided by another number.
leftover.mnemonic: dividend 来自拉丁语 dividendum，指被分割的东西，在金融中特指公司分给股东的利润份额。
example: The company announced a dividend of $2 per share for its investors.
公司宣布向投资者派发每股2美元的股息。

leftover.def_en: related to the highest university degree
leftover.mnemonic: 词根 doctor 来自拉丁语 docere 意为教，后缀 -al 表示与...相关，因此 doctoral 指与博士学位或学术研究有关的
example: She is writing her doctoral dissertation on ancient languages.
她正在撰写关于古代语言的博士论文。

leftover.def_en: An area of knowledge, interest, or control that someone is responsible for. A group of internet addresses that share the same ending, like '.com' or '.org'. Land owned or controlled by a person or government, especially in history. All the possible values that a variable can have.
leftover.mnemonic: 来自拉丁语 dominus（主人），词根 dom- 表示控制，指专属领域如互联网域名。
example: Artificial intelligence is a growing domain in computer science.
人工智能是计算机科学中一个不断发展的领域。

kaoyan_ex.text: One suggestion is that AI models could be trained on images in the public domain, and AI companies could forge partnerships…

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“领域”

leftover.def_en: A farm animal like a small horse with long ears.
leftover.mnemonic: donkey 可能源自 dun（暗褐色）描述其毛色，指家畜驴子，常与农耕文化相关，区别于 horse（马）的驯养历史。
example: The farmer uses his donkey to carry heavy bags of grain.
农夫用他的驴子驮着沉重的粮袋。

kaoyan_ex.text: …survived.” The researchers examined 207 genomes from modern donkeys living in 31 countries across the globe.

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“驴”；常见搭配 in

leftover.def_en: the opening where a door goes, leading into a building or room
leftover.mnemonic: doorway 由 door（门）和 way（道路）组合而成，表示入口或门洞，常用于建筑和日常场景。
example: The cat sat in the doorway, watching the rain outside.
猫坐在门口，看着外面的雨。

leftover.def_en: A measured amount of medicine taken at one time. An amount of something. To give medicine to someone.
leftover.mnemonic: dose 来自希腊语 dosis，意思是给予的量，特指药物剂量，在医疗领域强调精确测量。
example: Take one dose of this medicine every morning.
每天早上服用一剂这种药。

leftover.def_en: moving or pointing down
leftover.mnemonic: downward 来自 down（向下）和后缀 -ward（方向），down 源自古英语 dūn（山丘），整体表示下降或下行的运动趋势。
example: The downward slope made it easy to ride the bike downhill.
下坡使得骑自行车下山变得容易。

leftover.def_en: to sleep lightly for a short time a short light sleep
leftover.mnemonic: doze 可能源于古诺尔斯语 dusa，意为打盹或浅睡，词源与休息相关，日常用于描述短暂的小憩。
example: I often doze in my chair after lunch.
我午饭后经常在椅子上打盹。

leftover.def_en: A big, scary animal in stories that has wings, a long tail, and can breathe fire. A mean word for a woman who seems angry or scary.
leftover.mnemonic: dragon 源于希腊语 drakon，指神话中的强大爬行动物，在跨文化中如中国传说象征祥瑞或力量。
example: The brave knight fought the dragon to save the princess.
勇敢的骑士与龙搏斗以拯救公主。

kaoyan_ex.text: For example, type in “Wizard with sword and a glowing orb of magic fire fights a fierce dragon Greg Rutkowski,” and the system…

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“龙”

leftover.def_en: very extreme and sudden, causing big changes or effects
leftover.mnemonic: 词源来自希腊语 drastikos 意思是有效的或有力的，描述剧烈或极端的行动。
example: The company made a drastic change to its policy after the incident.
事件发生后，公司对其政策做出了重大改变。

kaoyan_ex.text: The most drastic, and thoroughly illegal, reaction has been the emergence of Sci-Hub, a kind of global photocopier for…

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作adj.；意为“剧烈的”

leftover.def_en: A sliding box in furniture for storing items. A person who creates drawings. A person who writes a check to pay for something.
leftover.mnemonic: drawer 源于 draw 拉，后缀 -er 表示物，指抽屉或绘画的人。
example: I keep my socks in the top drawer of the dresser.
我把袜子放在梳妆台最上面的抽屉里。

leftover.def_en: to die from being underwater too long without air; to kill someone by holding them underwater to cover something completely with water or liquid to be so loud that other sounds cannot be heard
leftover.mnemonic: drown 从古英语 druncnian 演变，原与过量饮酒相关，后专指在水中窒息而死，含义聚焦于致命淹没。
example: He almost drowned when he fell into the deep water.
他掉进深水里时差点淹死。

leftover.def_en: able to last a long time without breaking or wearing out
leftover.mnemonic: durable 词根来自拉丁语 durabilis durus 表示坚硬 able 表示能够 意思是耐用或持久的 常用于描述高质量产品
example: This durable backpack can handle rough use for many years.
这款耐用的背包可以承受多年的粗用。

kaoyan_ex.text: People often complain that plastics are too durable.

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作adj.；意为“耐用的”

leftover.def_en: to change the color of something using a special liquid a substance used to change the color of materials like cloth or hair
leftover.mnemonic: dye 源自古英语 deagian，意思是染色，指给材料上色的过程，常用于纺织业。
example: She used dye to make her hair a different color.
她用染料把头发染成了不同的颜色。

leftover.def_en: A large bird that hunts other animals for food. It has a sharp curved beak and very good eyesight. In golf, a score of two strokes less than the expected number for a hole.
leftover.mnemonic: 词源可追溯到拉丁语 aquila，意思是鹰；eagle 作为美国国鸟，常象征自由与力量。
example: The eagle flew high in the sky looking for food.
鹰在高空中飞翔寻找食物。

kaoyan_ex.text: We can offer them a visit to Blackwater National Wildlife Refuge in Dorchester County where bald eagles fly over tidal marshes…

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“鹰”

leftover.def_en: A small device you wear on or in your ear to listen to sounds privately. A small speaker you hold close to your ear for clear sound and privacy.
leftover.mnemonic: 复合词，ear 指耳朵，phone 源于希腊语 phone 声音，整体描述戴在耳上的声音设备，与现代科技紧密相关。
example: I put on my earphones to enjoy music without disturbing others.
我戴上耳机享受音乐，以免打扰他人。

leftover.def_en: safe to eat
leftover.mnemonic: 单词 edible 源于拉丁语 edibilis，意思是可食用的，常用于食品安全描述，如可食用植物或食品标签。
example: The berries looked ripe and edible, so we picked some to eat.
这些浆果看起来成熟可食，于是我们摘了一些来吃。

leftover.def_en: related to preparing content for publication or broadcast an article expressing the opinion of a publication's editors
leftover.mnemonic: editorial 与 editor 相关，后缀 -ial 表示与编辑工作有关的观点性文章。
example: The newspaper's editorial team decides which stories to publish.
报社的编辑团队决定刊登哪些报道。

kaoyan_ex.text: …service consultancies that provide language and other editorial support to individual authors and to journals sometimes advise contributors to add a…

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作adj.；意为“编辑的”；常接 to 不定式/介词 to

leftover.def_en: Made up of eight parts or eight times as much. Increased to eight times the original amount.
leftover.mnemonic: 由 eight 八和 fold 倍组合而成，直接表示八倍的增加或重复，常用于量化描述
example: The garden has an eightfold increase in flowers since last year.
自去年以来，花园里的花增加了八倍。

leftover.def_en: the quality of being stylish and graceful the quality of being clever and simple
leftover.mnemonic: elegance 源自拉丁语 elegantia，意为优雅，常与精致和品味相联系，用于描述艺术或行为。
example: Her simple dress showed true elegance.
她朴素的裙子展现了真正的优雅。

leftover.def_en: to remove something completely to decide someone or something is not involved to remove someone from a competition to kill someone, usually an enemy
leftover.mnemonic: eliminate 源自 e-（出）、 limin（界限）和 -ate（动词后缀），意为消除或淘汰出局，常用于比赛或决策中。
example: This medicine helps eliminate pain quickly.
这种药有助于快速消除疼痛。

kaoyan_ex.text: …when weather kept the blazes easy to control, and helped eliminate some of the fuel that had built up around important park’s facilities.

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作v.；意为“完全去除”；后接 that 从句；常见搭配 of

leftover.def_en: to get on a ship or plane, or to put someone or something on a ship or plane
leftover.mnemonic: embark 拆解前缀 em-（进入）和 bark（船），源自法语 embarquement，表示登船或开始新旅程，常用于比喻新事业的启动。
example: The passengers will embark on the cruise ship at noon.
乘客将于中午登上邮轮。

leftover.def_en: A very young animal or plant that is just starting to grow, before it is born or hatches. Something that is just beginning to develop or form.
leftover.mnemonic: embryo 源于希腊语 embryon，意为幼小生物，其中 em- 表示在内，bryein 指生长，描述在母体内发育的早期阶段。
example: Scientists study the human embryo to understand early development.
科学家研究人类胚胎以了解早期发育。

leftover.def_en: the male ruler of a large group of countries or lands
leftover.mnemonic: 源于拉丁语 imperator，词根 imperare 表示命令，指如罗马 emperor 的统治者
example: The emperor ruled over many lands and people.
皇帝统治着许多土地和人民。

kaoyan_ex.text: …between the British, ever keen to exacerbate the emperor’s difficulties, and the marshals sent from Paris to try to keep them in check; between new…

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“皇帝”

leftover.def_en: A book or set of books containing information on many subjects or on many aspects of one subject.
example: She consulted the encyclopaedia to learn about ancient civilizations.
她查阅了百科全书以了解古代文明。

leftover.def_en: a book or digital collection that gives information on many topics, usually arranged in alphabetical order
leftover.mnemonic: 词源来自希腊语 enkyklios paideia，en 表示在...中，kyklos 是圆，paideia 指教育，整体意为全面知识体系，与百科全书这一信息载体紧密关联。
example: An encyclopedia contains detailed information on many subjects, from history to science.
百科全书包含从历史到科学等多个学科的详细信息。

leftover.def_en: at risk of dying out completely
leftover.mnemonic: endangered 拆解为前缀 en- (使) 和 danger (危险) 加上后缀 -ed，描述物种濒临灭绝的风险状态，常用于环境保护语境。
example: Many animals are endangered because their habitats are being destroyed.
许多动物因栖息地遭到破坏而濒临灭绝。

kaoyan_ex.text: A hundred years on from Marconi and Reith, is the art of mere listening endangered?

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作adj.；意为“濒危的”；以 -ed 形式出现

leftover.def_en: a serious effort to do something, especially something new or hard to try very hard to do something
leftover.mnemonic: endeavour 可能源于中古英语 endeven，与法语 devoir 责任相关，意思是努力或尝试，常用于正式表达个人奋斗。
example: Scientists make a great endeavour to find new medicines.
科学家们为寻找新药付出了巨大努力。

leftover.def_en: A natural chemical in the brain that helps to relieve pain and make you feel happy.
leftover.mnemonic: 缩写自 endogenous morphine，endo- 指内源性，morphine 是吗啡，整体为体内产生的快乐激素，运动后释放以缓解疼痛。
example: After a long run, my body releases endorphins, which makes me feel good.
长跑后，我的身体会释放内啡肽，这让我感觉良好。

leftover.def_en: the ability to keep going through hard times without stopping
leftover.mnemonic: endurance 的词根 en-（使）和 dur（来自拉丁语 durare，持久）加上后缀 -ance，表示忍耐力或持久性，常用于体力或精神考验。
example: Running a marathon shows great endurance.
跑马拉松展现了极大的耐力。

leftover.def_en: fun or pleasant to do
leftover.mnemonic: enjoyable 由 enjoy 加 able 后缀组成，enjoy 源于古法语 enjoier，意为能带来快乐或愉悦的。
example: The movie was very enjoyable and made us laugh many times.
这部电影非常有趣，让我们笑了很多次。

leftover.def_en: to give someone information that helps them understand something better
leftover.mnemonic: enlighten 由 en-（使）和 light（光）组成，表示启发思想，如启蒙运动推动知识传播。
example: The teacher will enlighten the students about the history of the solar system.
老师将向学生讲解太阳系的历史。

kaoyan_ex.text: Enlightening, challenging, stimulating, fun.

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作v.；意为“启迪”；以 -ing 形式出现

leftover.def_en: to a very great extent or degree
leftover.mnemonic: 源于 enormous（巨大的），而 enormous 来自拉丁语 enormis（异常的），强调程度之大，常用来形容规模或数量的惊人增长。
example: The movie was enormously popular, attracting enormous crowds.
这部电影非常受欢迎，吸引了大量观众。

leftover.def_en: fun and enjoyable to watch, listen to, or do
leftover.mnemonic: entertaining 基于动词 entertain（娱乐），后缀 -ing 形成形容词，描述有趣或消遣性的内容，如 an entertaining movie。
example: The movie was very entertaining and made us laugh many times.
这部电影非常有趣，让我们笑了很多次。

leftover.def_en: a thing that exists on its own
leftover.mnemonic: entity 来自拉丁语 entitas，意为存在的事物，词根 ens 表示是或存在，强调独立实体的概念，如法律或哲学中的个体。
example: Each company is a separate entity with its own rules.
每家公司都是一个独立的实体，有自己的规则。

leftover.def_en: to completely destroy or remove something bad
leftover.mnemonic: Eradicate 源于拉丁语 eradicare，其中 e- 前缀表示向外，radix 指根，组合起来意为连根拔除，强调彻底消灭。
example: Vaccines help eradicate dangerous diseases from communities.
疫苗有助于从社区中根除危险疾病。

leftover.def_en: to bring a feeling, memory, or picture to mind
leftover.mnemonic: evoke 源自拉丁语 evocare（召唤），由 e-（向外）和 vocare（呼叫）构成，意为唤起情感或记忆。
example: The old song can evoke strong memories of childhood.
这首老歌能唤起对童年的强烈回忆。

leftover.def_en: to show something publicly for people to see or learn from to clearly show a quality, feeling, or symptom an object or group of objects shown publicly for viewing a public display of items like art or collections an object used as evidence in court
leftover.mnemonic: exhibit 的前缀 ex- 表示向外，词根 hibit 来自拉丁语 habere 意为持有，整体指公开展示或陈列物品的行为。
example: The artist will exhibit her paintings at the gallery next month.
这位艺术家将于下个月在画廊展出她的画作。

kaoyan_ex.text: …letters, a brochure detailing the Sinclair dinosaur exhibit from the 1964-1965 World’s Fair, the ephemera of history.

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作v.；意为“展出”；常见搭配 from

leftover.def_en: being forced to live away from your own country, often for political reasons a person who is forced to live away from their own country to force someone to leave their country and live somewhere else
leftover.mnemonic: 源于拉丁语 exilium，词根 ex- 表示出，solum 指土地，含义是被迫离开家园
example: Many people live in exile because of their political beliefs.
许多人因政治信仰而流亡。

leftover.def_en: from a faraway or tropical country, and therefore interesting and unusual
leftover.mnemonic: exotic 源自希腊语词根 exo 表示'外部'，描述来自异域或外国的事物，常用来形容不常见的动植物或文化。
example: The market sells many exotic fruits from other countries.
这家市场出售许多来自其他国家的异域水果。

leftover.def_en: the feeling of waiting for something to happen, especially something good
leftover.mnemonic: expectancy 源于 expect 期待和名词后缀 ancy，指期望状态如 life expectancy 预期寿命。
example: The expectancy in the room grew as everyone waited for the announcement.
房间里的人们等待着宣布，期待感越来越强。

leftover.def_en: in a very unusual or surprising way much more than usual or expected
leftover.mnemonic: extraordinarily 由 extra 超出和 ordinary 普通构成，表示极其非凡的程度，词源可追溯到拉丁语 extraordinarius。
example: He was extraordinarily calm during the emergency.
他在紧急情况下异常冷静。

kaoyan_ex.text: …the 17th century, with the arts and sciences flourishing extraordinarily among those with a more logical disposition.

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作adv.；意为“异常地”；常见搭配 with

leftover.def_en: the strip of hair above each eye
leftover.mnemonic: eyebrow 是 eye 眼和 brow 眉毛的组合词，直接指代眉毛部位。
example: She raised one eyebrow in surprise when she heard the news.
听到这个消息，她惊讶地扬起一边眉毛。

leftover.def_en: a short story that teaches a lesson, often with animal characters a story or statement that is not true
leftover.mnemonic: fable 来自拉丁语 fabula，源于 fari 说话，表示虚构的故事或寓言，常用于道德教育。
example: The fable about the tortoise and the hare teaches us that slow and steady wins the race.
龟兔赛跑的寓言告诉我们，稳扎稳打才能赢得比赛。

leftover.def_en: A popular activity or thing that people like for a short time and then forget.
leftover.mnemonic: 词源来自 fiddle-faddle，意为琐碎或无价值的事物，演变后指一时流行的狂热或时尚，比如某种短暂的社会潮流。
example: Slime was a huge fad last year, but now, not so much.
史莱姆去年风靡一时，但现在没那么流行了。

leftover.def_en: strange and wonderful, like something from a fantasy extravagantly fanciful or unrealistic
example: The movie features fantastical creatures and magical landscapes.
这部电影展现了奇幻生物和魔法景观。

leftover.def_en: able to plan for the future and understand the long-term effects of actions unable to see things clearly when they are close to you
example: She made a far-sighted decision to invest in renewable energy.
她做了一个有远见的决定，投资可再生能源。

leftover.def_en: A goodbye when someone leaves A word said when leaving someone To say goodbye to someone who is leaving
leftover.mnemonic: farewell 由中古英语 fare 旅行和 well 好组成，字面意思是祝旅途顺利，演变为告别语。
example: They shared a warm farewell before he moved away.
在他搬走之前，他们依依惜别。

leftover.def_en: A political system with a strong central government that promotes one country or race above others and does not allow opposition. Extreme views or actions that force others to think or act the same way.
leftover.mnemonic: fascism 词源是意大利语 fascismo，根植于拉丁语 fasces，指古罗马的束棒象征，代表集权统治。
example: The government's use of fascism led to the suppression of free speech and political dissent.
政府使用法西斯主义导致了对言论自由和政治异议的压制。

kaoyan_ex.text: But after the war, great social and political changes arising out of the successful war against Fascism created a growing…

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“法西斯主义”

leftover.def_en: all the animals that live in a certain place or at a certain time
leftover.mnemonic: fauna 来自拉丁语，指动物群，与罗马神话中的森林女神 Fauna 相关，常与 flora 植物群对比使用。
example: The park's fauna includes both rabbits and foxes.
公园里的动物群包括兔子和狐狸。

kaoyan_ex.text: …its hot springs and waterfalls to its variety of flora and fauna.

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“动物群”

leftover.def_en: When someone treats one person better than others because they like them more.
leftover.mnemonic: favoritism 表示偏袒或偏爱，源于 favorite（喜爱的），常用于描述不公行为。
example: The teacher was accused of showing favouritism to the smartest student in class.
这位老师被指责对班上最聪明的学生表现出偏爱。

kaoyan_ex.text: …The court’s ruling is legally sound in defining a kind of favoritism that is not criminal.

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“偏袒”；后接 that 从句

leftover.def_en: very weak, lacking strength not strong or convincing
leftover.mnemonic: feeble 来自古法语 feble，意为虚弱的，形容体力、智力或论据上的无力，常用于描述衰老或缺陷。
example: After being sick for a week, his voice sounded feeble and quiet.
病了一周后，他的声音听起来虚弱而低沉。

leftover.def_en: A substance added to soil to help plants grow better.
leftover.mnemonic: fertilizer 的词根是 fertile，来自拉丁语 fertilis 意为肥沃的，后缀 -izer 表示使...的工具，所以是促进土壤肥力的物质
example: Plants grow faster when you add fertilizer to the soil.
往土壤中添加肥料时，植物生长得更快。

leftover.def_en: the hard part at the end of your finger
leftover.mnemonic: fingernail 由 finger 和 nail 组合而成，直接指代手指末端的硬质保护层，体现了英语复合词的直观性。
example: I need to cut my fingernail because it's getting too long.
我需要剪指甲，因为太长了。

leftover.def_en: The unique pattern of lines on a person's fingertip, used to identify them. To record someone's fingerprint patterns for identification.
leftover.mnemonic: fingerprint 是 finger 和 print 的组合，指手指留下的独特印记，在犯罪学中用于身份识别。
example: Police found a fingerprint on the door that helped solve the case.
警方在门上发现了一枚指纹，这有助于破案。

leftover.def_en: in a way that is strong and steady, not moving or changing
leftover.mnemonic: firmly 是 firm 意为坚固的，加上副词后缀 -ly，表示坚定或稳固的方式；词源演变强调从物理硬度到决心如 firmly believe 的抽象应用。
example: She held the rope firmly to keep it from slipping.
她紧紧握住绳子，防止它滑落。

leftover.def_en: related to government money and taxes
leftover.mnemonic: 单词 fiscal 来自拉丁语 fiscus，意为公共钱箱或国库，后缀 -al 表示形容词，演变为与政府财政和预算相关的事务。
example: The government's fiscal plan includes new taxes to fund public services.
政府的财政计划包括征收新税以资助公共服务。

kaoyan_ex.text: It reported a net loss of $5.6 billion for fiscal 2016, the 10th straight year its expenses have exceeded revenue.

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作adj.；意为“财政的”

leftover.def_en: a person who catches fish for work or fun
leftover.mnemonic: fisherman 由 fish（鱼）和 man（人）组成，指以捕鱼为职业的人，女性形式为 fisherwoman。
example: The fisherman caught many fish in the lake today.
渔夫今天在湖里捕到了很多鱼。

leftover.def_en: A flagstone is a flat, square stone that is used to make paths or floors.
leftover.mnemonic: flagstone 是 flag 和 stone 的组合，flag 可能源自古诺尔斯语指石板，stone 石头，合起来指铺路用的扁平石板。
example: The garden path was paved with beautiful flagstones of different colors.
花园小径铺着不同颜色的漂亮石板。

leftover.def_en: A flat piece attached on one side that hangs down or covers an opening A quick up and down or side to side movement, often with noise A state of worry and excitement Public anger or criticism about something said or done A movable part on an aircraft wing used for control A speech sound made by quickly touching the tongue to the roof of the mouth To move wings up and down quickly To move up and down or side to side, often making noise To behave in an anxious or excited way To produce a flapping sound or movement
leftover.mnemonic: Flap 可能来自拟声词，模拟拍打的声音，如鸟翼扇动或飞机襟翼的动作。
example: The tent flap kept the rain out.
帐篷的门帘挡住了雨水。

leftover.def_en: how food or drink tastes a type of taste something added to food to change its taste a special feeling or style an idea of what something is like a type of something, like software to add taste to food or drink
leftover.mnemonic: flavor 源于拉丁语 flator，意思是气味或吹气，演变为英语中的风味或味道，常用于描述食物或体验的独特品质。
example: This cheese has a strong flavor that many people enjoy.
这种奶酪味道浓郁，很多人都喜欢。

leftover.def_en: The ability to speak or write a language easily and well. The ability to do something smoothly and skillfully.
leftover.mnemonic: fluency 的词根是拉丁语 fluere，意为流动，引申为语言或技能的流利程度，如外语 fluency 是沟通的关键。
example: Her fluency in Spanish helps her communicate smoothly with native speakers.
她流利的西班牙语帮助她与母语者顺畅交流。

kaoyan_ex.text: …not appear to be gaining greater encouragement to achieve fluency in other languages.

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“流利”；常见搭配 in

leftover.def_en: A person who enjoys trying and cooking different types of food. Related to or showing a strong interest in food and cooking.
leftover.mnemonic: foodie 由 food（食物）加上后缀 -ie 构成，是现代俚语，指热衷美食文化和探索的人。
example: As a foodie, she loves exploring new restaurants and trying exotic dishes.
作为一个美食家，她喜欢探索新餐厅，尝试异国菜肴。

leftover.def_en: lacking good sense or judgment made to feel silly or embarrassed
leftover.mnemonic: foolish 由古英语 fol 意为傻瓜，加上后缀 -ish 表示具有特性，形容缺乏智慧或判断力的行为。
example: It was foolish to go out in the storm without an umbrella.
在暴风雨中不带伞出门是愚蠢的。

kaoyan_ex.text: …there could be “nothing more damning than a silly, foolish smile fixed forever”.

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作adj.；意为“愚蠢的”

leftover.def_en: the sound or mark made when a foot touches the ground while walking or running
leftover.mnemonic: footstep 由 foot 和 step 组合，表示行走时脚步的声音或痕迹。
example: I heard a footstep outside my door and knew someone was approaching.
我听到门外有脚步声，知道有人正在靠近。

leftover.def_en: the area of the face above the eyes and below the hairline
leftover.mnemonic: forehead 由前缀 fore-（前部）和 head（头）组成，字面意思是头的前额部分。
example: She gently touched her forehead to check for a fever.
她轻轻摸了摸额头，看是否发烧。

leftover.def_en: having the ability to anticipate future events or needs and plan accordingly showing careful planning for the future
example: Her foresighted investment in renewable energy paid off handsomely when fossil fuel prices soared.
她对可再生能源的前瞻性投资在化石燃料价格飙升时获得了丰厚回报。

leftover.def_en: letting go of anger toward someone who hurt you
leftover.mnemonic: forgiveness 拆解为 forgive 表示原谅和 -ness 名词后缀，源于古英语 forgiefan 的演变，强调放下怨恨的宽恕行为，在心理学中常被视为健康的情感释放。
example: She asked for forgiveness after making a mistake.
她犯错后请求原谅。

kaoyan_ex.text: College officials also tend to emphasize that the goal of grade forgiveness is less about the grade itself and more about…

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“原谅”

leftover.def_en: happening or being released very soon available when needed willing to share information
leftover.mnemonic: forthcoming 由 forth 和 coming 组成，字面意思是向前来，描述即将发生的事物或坦率乐于助人的态度。
example: The forthcoming movie will be released next month.
即将上映的电影将于下个月发布。

leftover.def_en: Consisting of four parts or elements; increased to four times the original amount.
leftover.mnemonic: fourfold 意为四倍的，它由 four 四和 fold 倍数或折组合而成，表示数量增加四倍或分成四部分。
example: The company's profits have increased fourfold since the new CEO took over.
自新任CEO上任以来，公司利润增长了四倍。

leftover.def_en: to move your eyebrows down to show you are serious, angry, or worried a serious, angry, or worried look on your face with your eyebrows down
leftover.mnemonic: frown 的词源可能来自古法语 froignier，表示皱眉的表情，用于表达不悦或担忧，这种面部动作在人类交流中常见。
example: She began to frown when she heard the bad news.
听到坏消息时，她开始皱眉头。

kaoyan_ex.text: The US Supreme Court frowns on sex-based classifications unless they are designed to address an “important” policy interest.

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作v.；意为“皱眉”；常见搭配 on

leftover.def_en: Only using as much money or food as you really need. Simple, not fancy, and not expensive.
leftover.mnemonic: frugal 来自拉丁语 frugalis，意为节俭或节约，词源与实用性和资源管理相关，体现避免浪费的生活方式。
example: Being frugal means not spending much money and using things carefully.
节俭意味着不花太多钱，并且小心使用物品。

leftover.def_en: to cook in hot oil or fat to get burned by the sun very small young fish a piece of potato fried in oil
leftover.mnemonic: 来自古法语 frire，意思是用热油烹饪食物，通常指油炸过程。
example: Fry the eggs in a little oil until they are cooked.
用少许油煎鸡蛋，直到煎熟。

leftover.def_en: Strong-smelling or harmful smoke or gas.
leftover.mnemonic: 来自拉丁语 fumus 烟，指排放的烟气或有毒烟雾
example: The strong fumes from the car's exhaust made it hard to breathe.
汽车尾气强烈的气味让人难以呼吸。

leftover.def_en: practical and useful, not just for looks designed for a specific purpose or task working properly and ready to use
leftover.mnemonic: functional 基于 function 功能，后缀 -al 表示具有...性质，指实用的或正常运作的。
example: The functional design of the kitchen made cooking easy and efficient.
厨房的功能性设计使烹饪变得简单高效。

leftover.def_en: a very hot enclosed space for heating metal or glass a device that heats water for buildings or makes steam for engines
leftover.mnemonic: furnace 源于拉丁语 fornax 炉子，指高温加热的熔炉用于工业或供暖。
example: The metal was melted in the furnace to make tools.
金属在熔炉中熔化以制作工具。

leftover.def_en: a huge group of stars and planets in space the star system that includes our sun and planets, seen as a bright band at night a group of famous or talented people
leftover.mnemonic: galaxy 源自希腊语 galaxias 牛奶圈，指银河系，也泛指宇宙中的星系。
example: The Milky Way is our galaxy, and it contains billions of stars.
银河系是我们的星系，它包含数十亿颗恒星。

kaoyan_ex.text: They’ve implored citizens to help with bug counting and categorising cancer cells, and even identifying distant galaxies.

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“星系”

leftover.def_en: A unit for measuring liquids. In the UK and Canada, it is about 4.5 liters. In the US, it is about 3.8 liters.
leftover.mnemonic: gallon 来自古法语 'galon'，作为容量单位，常用于测量液体体积。
example: The car's fuel tank holds 15 gallons of gasoline.
这辆车的油箱能装15加仑汽油。

kaoyan_ex.text: In robust09 archaeologists Chrysanthi Gallon and Jon Henderson resumed the excavation of Pavlopetri in cooperation with the…

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“加仑”

leftover.def_en: a place where people are kept as punishment for crimes to put someone in prison as punishment
leftover.mnemonic: gaol 是 jail 的英国拼写变体，来自古法语 jaiole，指监狱，常见于英式英语中。
example: The criminal was sent to gaol for ten years.
该罪犯被判处十年监禁。

leftover.def_en: a plant with a strong taste and smell, used in cooking to add flavor to food
leftover.mnemonic: garlic 词源是古英语 gar 意思是矛，leac 意思是韭菜，因其蒜瓣形似矛头而得名，指常见的大蒜植物。
example: Add some chopped garlic to make the sauce taste better.
加一些切碎的大蒜，让酱汁味道更好。

leftover.def_en: A liquid fuel made from oil, used to power cars and other engines.
leftover.mnemonic: 由 gas 加后缀 -ol 和 -ine 构成，指石油提炼的燃料，在美国常用，英国则用 petrol。
example: My car needs gasoline to run, so I stop at the station to fill the tank.
我的车需要汽油才能跑，所以我停在加油站把油箱加满。

leftover.def_en: A person who controls access to a place by checking who can enter through a gate. A person, system, or process that decides who or what can access a particular place or person.
leftover.mnemonic: 由 gate（门）和 keeper（看守者）构成，比喻控制信息或资源访问的守门人。
example: The gatekeeper checked our tickets before allowing us to enter the park.
门卫检查了我们的门票后才允许我们进入公园。

leftover.def_en: a meeting of people for a purpose collecting things together
leftover.mnemonic: gathering 由动词 gather 演变而来，gather 来自古英语 gaderian 收集，后缀 -ing 表示行为或事件，指集会或收集。
example: The family gathering was held at the park.
家庭聚会在公园举行。

kaoyan_ex.text: …for games such as Dungeons & Dragons and Magic: The Gathering.

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“聚会”；以 -ing 形式出现

leftover.def_en: relating to or involving different generations within a family or society
leftover.mnemonic: generational 来自 generation，其拉丁词根 generatio 意为产生，描述不同代际间的差异或特征。
example: This museum's exhibits create a bridge between generational gaps, making history appeal to all ages.
这个博物馆的展品在代沟之间架起了一座桥梁，使历史对所有年龄段的人都有吸引力。

leftover.def_en: in a soft and light way, not rough or hard in a calm and kind way sloping very slowly and smoothly used to say 'be careful'
leftover.mnemonic: gently 由 gentle 加后缀 -ly 形成，gentle 源于拉丁语 gentilis，意为温和的，副词形式强调轻柔的行动方式。
example: She patted the baby's back gently to help him sleep.
她轻轻地拍着婴儿的背，帮助他入睡。

leftover.def_en: the study of Earth's rocks and how they formed the rocks and soil history of a specific place
leftover.mnemonic: geology 来自希腊语 geo- 指地球，-logy 意为研究，组合成研究地球结构的地质学，与岩石和矿物探索相关。
example: Geology helps us understand how mountains and valleys were created over millions of years.
地质学帮助我们理解山脉和山谷是如何在数百万年间形成的。

leftover.def_en: a large, slow-moving river of ice formed from snow on mountains or in cold regions
leftover.mnemonic: glacier 来自法语 glace 冰，加上后缀 -ier，指缓慢移动的大型冰体，在地理学中描述高山或极地形成的冰川。
example: The glacier slowly moves down the mountain, carving the landscape as it goes.
冰川缓慢地沿山而下，一路雕刻着地貌。

leftover.def_en: to make something operate or spread around the world
leftover.mnemonic: 词根源于 globe，globe 来自拉丁语 globus 球体，globalize 意为全球化，例如 multinational companies 推动经济 globalize
example: Many companies now globalize their products to reach customers in different countries.
许多公司现在将其产品全球化，以触达不同国家的客户。

leftover.def_en: in a way that affects the whole world in a way that includes all parts of something in a way that applies to everything in a system
leftover.mnemonic: globally 是 global 全球的副词形式，-ly 后缀表示方式，意为在世界范围内运作或影响
example: We must act globally to solve climate change.
我们必须全球行动以解决气候变化。

leftover.def_en: The positive feelings or friendliness between people or countries. The value of a company's positive relationships with its customers, which is considered when the company is sold.
leftover.mnemonic: goodwill 组合了 good（好的）和 will（意愿），在商业中表示商誉或品牌信誉，也泛指善意和友好态度。
example: The ambassador's visit was meant to build goodwill between the two nations.
大使的访问旨在增进两国之间的友好关系。

leftover.def_en: Talk about other people's private lives that may be unkind or not true. A conversation about other people's private lives. A person who likes to talk about other people's private lives. To talk about other people's private lives, often in an unkind way.
leftover.mnemonic: 源自古英语 godsibb，原指教父母或亲密伙伴，god 神 sibb 亲属，后演变为闲谈或流言，体现了含义的变迁。
example: The gossip about their relationship spread quickly through the office.
关于他们关系的八卦在办公室里迅速传开。

leftover.def_en: A small unit for measuring weight. One thousand grammes equal one kilogram.
leftover.mnemonic: gramme 源于希腊语 gramma，意为书写或字母，现在主要用作重量单位克，体现测量标准的演变。
example: This apple weighs about one hundred grammes.
这个苹果大约重一百克。

leftover.def_en: a very hard, grey rock, often used to make buildings or statues
leftover.mnemonic: 来自拉丁语 granum，意为谷物，形容这种火成岩的颗粒状纹理，因其坚硬特性常用于建筑和纪念碑。
example: The kitchen countertops were made of beautiful, polished granite.
厨房台面由漂亮、抛光的花岗岩制成。

kaoyan_ex.text: Eight monumental curving staircases of granite with over 4,000 individually cast bronze balusters are capped by four skylight…

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“花岗岩”；常见搭配 with

leftover.def_en: a grandmother like something an old woman would wear
leftover.mnemonic: 是 grandmother 的昵称形式，源自口语化缩写，常用于亲切称呼祖母。
example: My granny bakes the best cookies.
我奶奶烤的饼干最好吃。

leftover.def_en: a big area where only grass grows and there are no trees
leftover.mnemonic: grassland 是复合词，grass 草和 land 土地，描述覆盖草类的广阔区域，如草原，体现自然生态的简单组合。
example: Cows grazing in the grassland seemed peaceful.
在草地上吃草的奶牛看起来很平静。

kaoyan_ex.text: They move between a variety of habitats, including forests, grasslands, woodlands, wetlands and agricultural land.

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“草原”

leftover.def_en: The most basic level of an organization or society, often involving ordinary people.
leftover.mnemonic: grassroots 由 grass 和 roots 组合，字面意思是草根，比喻从基层民众发起的运动或支持。
example: The grassroots movement gained momentum as more people joined.
随着更多人加入，草根运动势头渐长。

leftover.def_en: A place with a lot of graves where dead people are buried. A place where unwanted or obsolete things or people end up.
leftover.mnemonic: graveyard 是 grave 坟墓和 yard 场地的组合，指埋葬死者的墓地，文化上常与幽灵或宁静场景关联。
example: They visited the graveyard on Halloween for a scary adventure.
他们在万圣节去了墓地，进行了一次恐怖的冒险。

leftover.def_en: A thick, oily substance used to make machines run smoothly. Soft animal fat from cooking. To put grease or oil on something to make it slippery.
leftover.mnemonic: grease 源于古法语 grece，其词根可追溯至拉丁语 crassus，意为脂肪或厚重，因此它描述油腻的润滑物质，在机械工程中常被用作减少摩擦的涂层。
example: To keep the machine working well, you need to add grease to its moving parts.
为了让机器保持良好的工作状态，你需要在其运动部件上添加润滑油。

leftover.def_en: a word or action used to say hello or welcome someone a message wishing someone good health or happiness
leftover.mnemonic: greeting 由 greet 问候和 -ing 组成，指问候语或欢迎仪式。
example: A friendly greeting can make people feel welcome.
友好的问候能让人感到受欢迎。

kaoyan_ex.text: And interest groups ranging from postal unions to greeting-card makers exert self-interested pressure on the USPS’s ultimate…

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“问候”；以 -ing 形式出现

leftover.def_en: to smile with a wide mouth a big smile showing teeth
leftover.mnemonic: grin 源自古英语 grennian，表示露齿而笑，常表达高兴或狡黠。
example: He gave a big grin when he saw the surprise.
看到惊喜时，他咧嘴大笑。

kaoyan_ex.text: A toothy grin (especially when there were gaps or blackened teeth) lacked class: drunks, tramps and music hall performers…

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作v.；意为“咧嘴笑”

leftover.def_en: Very new and different; introducing new ideas or methods.
leftover.mnemonic: groundbreaking 字面意思是破土动工，象征开创性的革新，常用于描述颠覆传统的发明或事件。
example: The groundbreaking technology is changing the way we live.
这项突破性的技术正在改变我们的生活方式。

kaoyan_ex.text: The grammar school boy from Stratford-upon-Avon has landed a scholarly punch after groundbreaking research showed that…

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作adj.；意为“开创性的”；后接 that 从句；以 -ing 形式出现

leftover.def_en: making an estimate or decision without enough information to be certain
leftover.mnemonic: guesswork 拆解为 guess 即猜测和 work 即工作，组合起来指依赖推测而非事实的活动，体现了含义从具体动作到抽象过程的演变。
example: It was just guesswork when we tried to predict the weather.
我们试图预测天气时，那只是瞎猜。

leftover.def_en: A flat, round patty made from ground beef, usually cooked and served in a bread roll. Beef that has been ground into very small pieces using a machine.
leftover.mnemonic: hamburger 源自德国城市 Hamburg 汉堡，但现代汉堡包是美国创新，现指夹肉饼的快餐食品，体现文化演变。
example: I ordered a hamburger with cheese and lettuce for lunch.
我午餐点了一个加奶酪和生菜的汉堡。

leftover.def_en: A small square of cloth or paper used for wiping your nose or face.
leftover.mnemonic: handkerchief 由 hand 和 kerchief 组成，kerchief 来自古法语 couvrechief 意为头巾，整体演变指用于手或脸的小块布料。
example: She always carries a clean handkerchief in her pocket.
她口袋里总是带着一条干净的手帕。

leftover.def_en: bothering someone again and again in a way that upsets or troubles them repeated attacks against an enemy to weaken them
leftover.mnemonic: 可能源于法语 harasser，意为不断烦扰，harassment 指持续的骚扰或折磨行为，常见于社会和法律语境。
example: The company has a strict policy against any form of harassment in the workplace.
公司对工作场所任何形式的骚扰都有严格的政策。

leftover.def_en: A safe place on the coast where ships can stay. To hide and protect someone who is running from the law. To keep feelings or thoughts in your mind for a long time. To contain something and help it grow.
leftover.mnemonic: harbor 源于古英语 herebeorg，here 指军队，beorg 意为庇护，现在指提供安全的港口或港湾
example: The harbor protects ships from big waves.
港口保护船只免受大浪侵袭。

kaoyan_ex.text: …Secretary of State Cordell Hull after the bombing of Pearl Harbor.

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“海港”

leftover.def_en: to come out of an egg to break open so a young animal can come out to make a young animal come out of an egg to create a secret plan or idea an opening or door in a ship, aircraft, or spacecraft an opening in a wall to pass food between rooms an opening or door in a floor or ceiling
leftover.mnemonic: hatch 源于古英语 hæccan，意思是孵化或打开舱口，如鸟类破壳而出或船舶上的开口设计。
example: The baby birds will hatch from their eggs soon.
小鸟很快就要从蛋里孵出来了。

leftover.def_en: the main office or center where an organization is run from
leftover.mnemonic: head 意为头部或领导，quarters 指住所或区域，合起来表示组织或军队的总部，是决策和指挥的中心地点。
example: The company's headquarters is where all the important decisions are made.
公司总部是所有重要决策的制定地。

kaoyan_ex.text: …by the work of one George Scovell, an officer in British headquarters.

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“总部”

leftover.def_en: A photo showing someone from the waist up, often used by actors and models. A shot that hits someone in the head, often used in video games or in a military context.
leftover.mnemonic: headshot 指头部射击，在电子游戏中表示爆头得分，也用于摄影中的肖像照。
example: She submitted her headshot to the talent agency for consideration.
她把她的头像照提交给了人才经纪公司以供考虑。

leftover.def_en: The progress you make towards achieving something. The distance a ship can travel in a straight line before it needs to change direction.
leftover.mnemonic: headway 由 head 头 和 way 路 组合而成，比喻在困难中取得进展或向前移动。
example: After many setbacks, we finally started to make headway with the project.
经历多次挫折后，我们终于在这个项目上取得了进展。

leftover.def_en: A person who gets someone's property or title after they die. A person who continues someone else's work or tradition.
leftover.mnemonic: heir 继承自古法语 eir，词根是拉丁语 heres，意思是继承人。这个词强调血统或法律上的继承关系，演变中保留了核心含义。
example: He is the heir to his father's business.
他是他父亲生意的继承人。

leftover.def_en: a hard hat that protects your head
leftover.mnemonic: helmet 源于古法语，词根与 helm 相关，helm 在日耳曼语中表示保护头部的覆盖物，现在指安全头盔，常用于骑行或军事防护。
example: Always wear a helmet when riding a bike to stay safe.
骑自行车时务必佩戴头盔以确保安全。

leftover.def_en: a female chicken that lays eggs a female bird
leftover.mnemonic: hen 指母鸡，源于古英语 henn，是常见家禽，词源简单直接。
example: The farmer collects eggs from the hen every morning.
农夫每天早上从母鸡那里收鸡蛋。

leftover.def_en: for this reason; therefore
leftover.mnemonic: hence 源于古英语 heennes，意思是从此地或因此，用于表示逻辑上的结果或推论。
example: The road was closed, hence we had to take a different route.
道路封闭了，因此我们不得不走另一条路线。

kaoyan_ex.text: The founders deliberately focused their projects around light—hence the “visual studies” in the name.

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作adv.；意为“因此”；常见搭配 in

leftover.def_en: from this time forward
leftover.mnemonic: henceforth 由 hence（从此）和 forth（向前）构成，正式用语，表示从今以后的时间点。
example: Henceforth, we will use this new system for all our work.
今后，我们将使用这个新系统进行所有工作。

leftover.def_en: arranged in levels of importance or authority
leftover.mnemonic: hierarchical 源于希腊语 hieros 神圣的 和 archos 统治者，加上形容词后缀 ical，描述像金字塔一样的等级结构，如公司层级。
example: The military has a hierarchical structure with clear ranks and chain of command.
军队有等级分明的结构，包括清晰的军衔和指挥链。

leftover.def_en: getting a lot of attention from the public and media
leftover.mnemonic: high-profile 由 high（高）和 profile（轮廓）组成，比喻为高度可见或备受关注，常用于描述名人或重要事件。
example: The celebrity's high-profile divorce was covered by news outlets worldwide.
这位名人的高调离婚被全球新闻媒体广泛报道。

leftover.def_en: up to this time; until now
