leftover.mnemonic: hitherto 由 hither 到这里和 to 到组成，是一个古英语词汇，表示直到现在或迄今为止，保留在正式书面语中。
example: The technology, hitherto unknown, changed everything.
这项此前不为人知的技术改变了一切。

leftover.def_en: grown or produced in one's own garden or country developed or originating within a particular place or organization characteristic of or typical to a particular region or culture
example: We enjoyed a salad made with homegrown tomatoes from our backyard.
我们享用了用后院自种的西红柿做的沙拉。

leftover.def_en: A hominid is a type of primate that includes humans, apes, and their ancestors.
leftover.mnemonic: hominid 源于拉丁语 hominidae，homo 是人，指人科动物包括人类及其祖先，在人类进化研究中常用。
example: Scientists study hominid fossils to learn more about human evolution.
科学家研究人类化石以了解更多关于人类进化的信息。

leftover.def_en: A type of melon with a smooth, green rind and sweet, juicy flesh. The sweet substance made by bees from flower nectar, often eaten by people.
leftover.mnemonic: honeydew 由 honey 蜂蜜和 dew 露珠组成，形容甜瓜的汁液或植物分泌的蜜露。
example: I enjoyed a refreshing slice of honeydew after dinner.
晚餐后，我享用了清爽的蜜瓜片。

leftover.def_en: A natural chemical in the body that controls growth and how cells work. It can also be made artificially.
leftover.mnemonic: hormone 来自希腊语 hormon 源于 hormao 即激发，指体内分泌的化学物质，能激发生理反应，如调节新陈代谢，在生物学中扮演关键角色。
example: The hormone insulin helps control blood sugar levels in your body.
激素胰岛素有助于控制体内的血糖水平。

kaoyan_ex.text: When people place their trust in an individual or an institution, their brains release oxytocin, a hormone that produces…

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“激素”；后接 that 从句

leftover.def_en: very shocked and scared
leftover.mnemonic: horrified 由 horrify（使惊骇）和 -ed 后缀构成，词根 horror（恐怖）突显极度恐惧的反应。
example: She was horrified when she saw the accident.
看到事故时，她吓坏了。

leftover.def_en: a unit that measures how strong an engine is
leftover.mnemonic: horsepower 源于工业革命时期 James Watt 的发明，用来测量引擎功率，一 horsepower 相当于一匹马在标准条件下能输出的力量，体现了从动物劳动到机械动力的演变。
example: This car has 200 horsepower, which means its engine is very powerful.
这辆车有200马力，意味着它的发动机非常强劲。

leftover.def_en: when someone stays in a hospital to get better from an illness or injury
leftover.mnemonic: hospital 医院源于拉丁语 hospes 客人，ization 表示状态，整体是住院治疗，强调医疗护理过程。
example: After the surgery, she needed a short period of hospitalization before she could go home.
手术后，她需要短期住院才能回家。

leftover.def_en: work done to keep a home clean and running, like cleaning and cooking
leftover.mnemonic: housework 是复合词，由 house 和 work 直接组成，指家庭内的日常劳动，如清洁和烹饪，体现了英语中简洁构词的特点。
example: She spends her weekends doing housework to keep the home tidy.
她周末做家务以保持家里整洁。

leftover.def_en: to an extreme degree very much
leftover.mnemonic: huge 巨大，-ly 副词后缀，强调程度非常大，如 hugely popular 表示极其受欢迎。
example: The movie was hugely entertaining, keeping the audience engaged throughout.
这部电影非常有趣，全程吸引着观众。

leftover.def_en: a small, simple house or shelter
leftover.mnemonic: 词源可能来自德语 Hütte，描述简陋的小屋或临时住所
example: We built a small hut in the woods for shelter.
我们在树林里建了一个小棚屋作为庇护所。

leftover.def_en: The lightest chemical element, a gas that combines with oxygen to make water.
leftover.mnemonic: hydrogen 源于法语 hydrogène，hydro- 来自希腊语 hydor 水，-gen 意思是产生，因为燃烧时产生水，是重要的清洁能源元素。
example: Hydrogen is used as fuel because it burns cleanly and produces only water.
氢被用作燃料，因为它燃烧清洁且只产生水。

leftover.def_en: keeping clean to stay healthy and avoid sickness
leftover.mnemonic: hygiene 表示卫生，源自希腊语 hygieinos，与健康女神 Hygieia 相关，演变后强调保持清洁以预防疾病的概念。
example: Good hygiene means washing your hands often to prevent germs from spreading.
良好的卫生意味着经常洗手以防止细菌传播。

kaoyan_ex.text: …proper dentistry, mouths were often in a shocking state of hygiene.

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“卫生”

leftover.def_en: a sweet frozen food made from milk or cream, often with added flavors like fruit or chocolate
leftover.mnemonic: ice cream 字面意为冰和奶油，是一种冷冻甜点，中文直接音译为 ice cream 冰淇淋，反映了其制作原料。
example: I love to eat ice cream on a hot summer day.
我喜欢在炎热的夏日吃冰淇淋。

leftover.def_en: A small picture on a screen that you click to open a program or file. A very famous person or thing that people admire as a symbol of something. A holy picture or statue of a religious person.
leftover.mnemonic: icon 来自希腊语 eikōn 意为图像，既指宗教偶像也指现代象征；在数字领域，icon 是计算机屏幕上的小图标，简化了用户交互。
example: Click the printer icon to print your document.
点击打印机图标打印文档。

leftover.def_en: a rude word for someone who acts very stupid an offensive word for a person with very low intelligence
leftover.mnemonic: 起源于希腊语 idiotes，原指不参与公共事务的私人个体，后来含义演变，专指智力低下或愚蠢的人，反映了社会认知的变化。
example: He called me an idiot for forgetting my keys.
他因为我把钥匙忘带了而骂我是白痴。

leftover.def_en: in a way that breaks the law
leftover.mnemonic: 前缀 il- 表示否定，结合 legal 合法的，再加副词后缀 ly，构成非法地行事的意思。
example: He illegally crossed the border without permission.
他未经许可非法越境。

leftover.def_en: a false idea or belief something that looks real but is not
leftover.mnemonic: 来自拉丁语 illusio，词根 in- 表示否定而 ludere 意为玩或欺骗，整体演变为幻觉或错觉的概念。魔术表演经常利用 optical illusion 来创造惊奇效果。
example: The magician's trick created the illusion that the coin had disappeared.
魔术师的把戏制造了硬币消失的错觉。

leftover.def_en: seeming real but not actually real
leftover.mnemonic: illusory 来自拉丁语 illusio，指幻觉或欺骗，描述不真实或虚幻的事物。
example: The success felt illusory because it was based on luck, not skill.
这种成功感觉虚幻，因为它基于运气而非技巧。

leftover.def_en: not real; only in the mind
leftover.mnemonic: 这个词源于拉丁语 imago，意思是图像，加上后缀 -ary 表示与想象相关的，描述不真实的事物。
example: The child has an imaginary friend who only exists in her mind.
这个孩子有一个只存在于她想象中的朋友。

leftover.def_en: A state where things are not equal or fair, causing issues.
leftover.mnemonic: imbalance 包含前缀 im- 表示不，加上 balance 平衡，整体描述失去均衡的状态，常用于身体或心理方面。
example: The company is trying to fix the imbalance between the number of men and women in leadership positions.
公司正试图解决领导层中男女比例失衡的问题。

leftover.def_en: about to happen very soon
leftover.mnemonic: imminent 源于拉丁语 imminere，im 表示在...上，minere 相关于威胁，指即将发生的紧迫事件，常带负面含义。
example: The storm is imminent, so we should go inside now.
暴风雨即将来临，所以我们现在应该进屋。

leftover.def_en: easily annoyed by waiting or delays wanting something to happen right away not willing to accept unpleasant things
leftover.mnemonic: impatient 中 im- 是否定前缀，patient 来自拉丁语 pati 意为忍受，整体表示缺乏耐心或无法忍耐。
example: He became impatient when the bus was late.
公交车晚点时，他变得不耐烦。

leftover.def_en: about to happen soon
leftover.mnemonic: 来自拉丁语 impendere 意为悬挂，加上后缀 -ing 表示进行中，指即将发生或逼近的事件，常用于威胁或危机。
example: The news report talked about the impending storm.
新闻报道谈到了即将来临的风暴。

kaoyan_ex.text: When it comes to AI in business, we often hear about it in relation to automation and the impending loss of jobs, but in what…

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作adj.；意为“即将发生”；常见搭配 of；以 -ing 形式出现

leftover.def_en: something that cannot happen or be done a thing that cannot happen or be done
leftover.mnemonic: impossibility 由 impossible 加上后缀 -ity 构成，其中 impossible 源于 in- 表示不，和 possible 意为可能的，因此描述不可能实现的状态。
example: The impossibility of traveling faster than light is a scientific fact.
超光速旅行是不可能的，这是一个科学事实。

leftover.def_en: The part of an email system where you can see new messages that you have received. A special tray on a desk where you put letters that you have not read or dealt with yet.
leftover.mnemonic: 由 in（内部）和 box（盒子）构成，在数字时代特指电子邮件或消息的收件箱。
example: I had 50 unread emails in my inbox.
我的收件箱里有50封未读邮件。

leftover.def_en: too strange or unlikely to be imagined or believed
leftover.mnemonic: inconceivable 由 in- 否定前缀和 conceivable 组成，conceivable 源于拉丁语 concipere 意为构想，指完全无法想象的事物。
example: The idea that he would lie is inconceivable because he always tells the truth.
他会撒谎的想法是不可想象的，因为他总是说实话。

leftover.def_en: the quality of being hard-working and diligent consistent effort and dedication to work or tasks the trait of being persistently active and productive
example: Her industriousness was evident in how she completed all her tasks ahead of schedule.
她的勤奋体现在她提前完成了所有任务。

leftover.def_en: not producing the desired result; not working well
leftover.mnemonic: ineffective 由 in 和 effective 构成，in 表示否定，effective 指有效的，合起来意为无效的或不起作用的。
example: The teacher found that using punishments was ineffective in encouraging good behavior.
老师发现使用惩罚在鼓励良好行为方面效果不佳。

leftover.def_en: not wanting to move or change a thing's tendency to stay still or keep moving unless a force acts on it
leftover.mnemonic: 词源来自拉丁语 iners，由 in- 表示不，和 ars 表示技能或活动，描述物体保持原有运动状态的性质，牛顿力学中的惯性定律体现了这一概念。
example: My inertia kept me from starting my homework.
我的惰性让我迟迟没有开始做作业。

leftover.def_en: Something that cannot be avoided or ignored.
leftover.mnemonic: 来自 in- 不加上 escape 逃脱，-ably 后缀形成副词，表示不可避免地，强调无法回避的必然性。
example: The consequences of our actions are inescapably linked to our future.
我们行为的后果不可避免地与我们的未来相关联。

leftover.def_en: A sickness that makes you feel very tired, gives you a fever, and makes you cough and have a sore throat.
leftover.mnemonic: influenza 源自意大利语，意为影响，历史上指疾病对健康的影响，现在专指流感病毒引起的传染病。
example: Many people get sick with influenza during the winter months.
许多人在冬季会患上流感。

leftover.def_en: relating to light waves that are longer than red light and cannot be seen by human eyes
leftover.mnemonic: infra- 前缀指之下， red 来自红色，因此 infrared 描述电磁波谱中波长低于红光的辐射。
example: The camera uses infrared light to see in the dark.
相机使用红外光在黑暗中观看。

leftover.def_en: to give someone or something a particular feeling or quality to affect everything within something to put herbs or tea in hot water to get the flavor out to put a medicine or another substance slowly into a person's body, usually into a vein
leftover.mnemonic: infuse 词根为拉丁语 infundere，in 进入和 fundere 倒组合，指将物质注入或浸泡，如泡茶时 infuse 热水释放风味。
example: She aims to infuse her students with enthusiasm.
她旨在激发学生的热情。

kaoyan_ex.text: They infused some with stabilizing and consolidating chemicals.

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作v.；意为“注入”；常见搭配 with；以 -ed 形式出现

leftover.def_en: to breathe in air, smoke, or gas
leftover.mnemonic: inhale 由 in 进入和 halare 呼吸构成，源自拉丁语，意思是吸入空气或气体，常用于医学描述。
example: When you inhale, you breathe air into your lungs.
当你吸气时，你将空气吸入肺部。

kaoyan_ex.text: …of money to strangers than were their counterparts who inhaled something else.

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作v.；意为“吸入”；以 -ed 形式出现

leftover.def_en: harmful or damaging
leftover.mnemonic: injurious 来自拉丁语 injuria，in 表示否定，jus 表示正义，含义指有害或造成伤害，常用于法律或健康语境。
example: Smoking is injurious to your health and can cause serious diseases.
吸烟有害健康，可能导致严重疾病。

leftover.def_en: A colored liquid used for writing, drawing, or printing. A tattoo or tattoos on the skin. To cover with ink for printing. To sign a document, like a contract. To mark skin with a tattoo.
leftover.mnemonic: ink 词源可追溯至拉丁语 encaustum，经古法语 enque 演变而来，原指古代用于书写或绘画的液体，在现代指墨水或印刷材料。
example: I need to buy more ink for my pen.
我需要给我的笔买更多墨水。

kaoyan_ex.text: The U.S. Postal Service (USPS) continues to bleed red ink.

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“墨水”

leftover.def_en: toward the middle of a country, away from the coast in the middle of a country, not near the coast within one country, not between countries
leftover.mnemonic: inland 由前缀 in- 表示内部和 land 土地组成，直接描述远离海岸的内陆区域。
example: The river flows inland from the coast.
这条河从海岸向内陆流去。

leftover.def_en: A small hotel or pub, often in the countryside, where people can stay overnight. A small hotel, usually in a rural area. Used in names of pubs, hotels, and restaurants.
leftover.mnemonic: inn 源自古英语，指提供住宿的小旅馆或客栈，常见于乡村或历史背景中。
example: We found a cozy inn to stay at during our trip.
我们在旅途中找到了一家舒适的小旅馆。

kaoyan_ex.text: Caravanserais were roadside inns that were built along the Silk Road in areas including China, North Africa and the Middle East.

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“小旅馆”；后接 that 从句

leftover.def_en: too many to count
leftover.mnemonic: innumerable 前缀 in- 不、numer 数字 来自拉丁语 numerus、-able 能，表示无法计数的巨大数量，如繁星或沙粒。
example: There are innumerable stars in the night sky.
夜空中有无数的星星。

leftover.def_en: to ask for information
leftover.mnemonic: 来自拉丁语 inquirere，in 表示进入，quaerere 意思是寻求，所以 inquire 指深入询问或调查信息。
example: Please inquire at the front desk for directions.
请向前台询问方向。

leftover.def_en: related to a large organization like a university or bank like a place where people live and are cared for, such as a hospital or prison built into the normal ways of an organization or society
leftover.mnemonic: institutional 基于 institution，词根 instituere 表示建立，指与机构或制度相关的特性，如组织行为或规范。
example: Institutional investors manage large amounts of money for organizations.
机构投资者为组织管理大量资金。

leftover.def_en: a rude word or action that hurts someone's feelings to say or do something rude that hurts someone's feelings
leftover.mnemonic: insult 词源可追溯到拉丁语 insultare，最初指跳跃或攻击，后来含义演变为言语或行为上的侮辱，体现了从物理到抽象的转化。
example: Calling someone lazy is an insult that can make them feel bad.
称某人为懒汉是一种侮辱，会让他们感到难过。

kaoyan_ex.text: Greg Newberry: Emma Marris’s article is an insult and a disservice to the thousands of passionate, dedicated people who work…

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“侮辱”

leftover.def_en: easy to understand
leftover.mnemonic: intelligible 源自拉丁语 intelligibilis ，intellegere 意思是理解，后缀 -ible 表示能够，因此指可理解的或清晰的，避免混淆。
example: The teacher's explanation was intelligible and helped everyone learn quickly.
老师的解释清晰易懂，帮助大家快速学习。

leftover.def_en: about how people communicate and interact with each other
leftover.mnemonic: 前缀 inter- 表示之间，personal 指个人的，组合起来描述人际间的互动或关系。
example: Having good interpersonal skills is important for working in a team.
拥有良好的人际交往能力对于团队合作很重要。

kaoyan_ex.text: …which could lead not only to the subsequent loss of interpersonal connections, but also to a decrease in marketing personnel.

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作adj.；意为“人际的”

leftover.def_en: When different things or people influence each other in a way that affects their results or actions.
leftover.mnemonic: interplay 由 inter- '相互' 和 play '作用' 组成，表示元素间的 '动态交互'，常见于科学或艺术领域分析影响因素。
example: The interplay of sunlight and shadows created a beautiful effect in the garden.
阳光与阴影的相互作用在花园中创造了美丽的效果。

leftover.def_en: Involving or happening between different provinces. Affecting or crossing boundaries of different provinces.
leftover.mnemonic: interprovincial 拆解为前缀 inter-（在…之间）和 provincial（省的），provincial 来自拉丁语 provincia，合起来指省际的，常用于描述跨越省份的事务。
example: The interprovincial trade agreement made it easier to move goods between provinces.
省际贸易协定使货物在各省之间流动更加容易。

leftover.def_en: the quality of being intrusive; the act of intruding or interfering in an unwanted way the tendency to intrude on someone's privacy or personal space the quality of being too noticeable or prominent in an unwelcome manner
example: The intrusiveness of the security measures made many visitors uncomfortable.
安保措施的侵入性让许多访客感到不适。

leftover.def_en: extremely useful or helpful
leftover.mnemonic: Invaluable 包含前缀 in- 表示否定，valuable 是有价值的，整体强调无法估量的宝贵性。
example: Her advice was invaluable in helping me solve the problem.
她的建议在帮我解决这个问题时非常宝贵。

leftover.def_en: a person who looks into events to find out what happened
leftover.mnemonic: investigator 源于拉丁语 investigare，其中 in- 表示进入，vestigare 意为追踪足迹，整体指调查员通过追踪线索来探究真相。
example: The investigator carefully examined the evidence at the scene.
调查员仔细检查了现场的证据。

kaoyan_ex.text: …(TSA) found in a secret check that undercover investigators were able to sneak weapons—both fake and real—past airport security nearly every time…

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“调查员”；常接 to 不定式/介词 to

leftover.def_en: to use a law or rule as a reason for doing something to mention a person or idea to support your opinion to mention someone's name to make people feel or act a certain way to ask for help, especially from a god to make someone feel something or imagine a scene to start a computer program to make evil appear using magic
leftover.mnemonic: invoke 源于拉丁语 invocare，in- 表示进入，vocare 意思是召唤，与 voice 声音相关，因此指祈求神灵或在编程中调用函数。
example: He will invoke the new rule to explain his decision.
他将援引新规则来解释他的决定。

leftover.def_en: A situation that is the opposite of what you expected, often in a funny or strange way. Saying the opposite of what you mean, usually to be funny or make a point. made of, containing, or resembling iron
leftover.mnemonic: irony 词根来自希腊语 eironeia，原意是假装无知，现指言语或情境的讽刺性反差，文学作品中 irony 常制造戏剧效果。
example: The irony is that the fire station burned down while the firefighters were away.
讽刺的是，消防站就在消防员外出时烧毁了。

leftover.def_en: Not related or having no connection to the subject being discussed.
leftover.mnemonic: irrelevant 拆解为 ir-（否定前缀）和 relevant，relevant 源于拉丁语 relevare（举起），整体表示不相关或不重要。
example: The color of the curtains is irrelevant to the overall design of the room.
窗帘的颜色与房间的整体设计无关。

leftover.def_en: A hard white material from elephant tusks and some other animals. An object made from ivory. A pale creamy white color. creamy white in color, like ivory
leftover.mnemonic: 来自古法语 ivoire，源于拉丁语 ebur 象牙，指大象牙齿材料，常引申为象牙白色或保护濒危物种的议题。
example: Many countries have banned the sale of ivory to protect elephants.
许多国家已禁止销售象牙以保护大象。

leftover.def_en: A place where people are kept as punishment for breaking the law. To put someone in prison as punishment.
leftover.mnemonic: 源于古法语 jaiole，最终源自拉丁语 cavea 意思是笼子，指关押犯人的设施。
example: He was sent to jail for stealing.
他因偷窃被送进监狱。

leftover.def_en: A person who is actively looking for employment.
leftover.mnemonic: jobseeker 由 job 工作和 seeker 寻找者构成，直接表示正在找工作的人。
example: As a jobseeker, she attended the career fair to network with potential employers.
作为一名求职者，她参加了招聘会，与潜在雇主建立联系。

leftover.def_en: A container with a handle and a spout for pouring liquids. A large round container with a small opening and a handle for holding liquids. The amount of liquid that a jug can hold. An impolite word for a woman's breasts.
leftover.mnemonic: jug 是一种带柄的容器，词源可能来自中古英语，用于盛装液体如水或牛奶。
example: She poured milk from the jug into her glass.
她把牛奶从罐子里倒进自己的杯子。

leftover.def_en: a person who serves on a jury to help decide a court case
leftover.mnemonic: juror 来自 jury（陪审团），后缀 -or 指人，描述陪审团成员，在司法系统中参与审判决策。
example: The juror listened carefully to all the evidence presented in court.
陪审员仔细听取了法庭上出示的所有证据。

leftover.def_en: A group of people who decide if someone is guilty in court. A group of people who choose the winner of a contest.
leftover.mnemonic: jury 词源是古法语 juree，源自拉丁语 iurare（宣誓），指法庭上宣誓的陪审团，负责裁决事实。
example: The jury decided the person was guilty.
陪审团裁定该人有罪。

kaoyan_ex.text: The high court’s decision said the judge in Mr. McDonnell’s trial failed to tell a jury that it must look only at his…

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“陪审团”；后接 that 从句；常见搭配 at

leftover.def_en: a good reason for doing something
leftover.mnemonic: 源于拉丁语 justificare，其中 just 表示公正，后缀 ification 表示使...化，整体指证明某事合理或正当的过程。
example: He had no justification for being late to work.
他上班迟到没有任何正当理由。

leftover.def_en: to take someone away by force and hold them to get money or something else
leftover.mnemonic: kidnap 起源于 17 世纪英语，由 kid 儿童和 nap 抓取组合而成，最初专指偷盗儿童，后演变为任何绑架行为，词源揭示了其暴力本质。
example: The criminals planned to kidnap the rich man's son for ransom money.
罪犯们计划绑架富人的儿子以勒索赎金。

leftover.def_en: a unit for measuring distance equal to 1,000 meters
leftover.mnemonic: 前缀 kilo- 代表一千，meter 来自希腊语 metron 意为测量，因此 kilometer 指一千米的距离单位，是国际公制系统的基础。
example: The school is two kilometers from my house.
学校离我家两公里。

leftover.def_en: a country ruled by a king or queen an area ruled by someone or where something is important one of the three main groups of nature one of the five big groups of living things
leftover.mnemonic: 由 king 国王和后缀 -dom 组成，-dom 表示领域或状态，因此指国王统治的领土。
example: The United Kingdom has a king as its leader.
联合王国以国王为国家元首。

kaoyan_ex.text: …is so stable that the young generations of the United Kingdom do not need additional language capabilities.

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“王国”

leftover.def_en: to rest on your knees or go down onto your knees
leftover.mnemonic: kneel 源于古英语 cneowlian，与膝盖动作相关，描述跪下的姿势，常用于宗教或礼仪场合。
example: The knight will kneel before the queen to show respect.
骑士会在女王面前跪下以示尊敬。

leftover.def_en: knowing a lot about many things or a specific topic
leftover.mnemonic: knowledgeable 由 knowledge 知识加上后缀 -able 表示能够的，组合起来指一个人拥有丰富知识且能够运用。
example: My teacher is very knowledgeable and can answer all my questions about science.
我的老师知识渊博，能回答我所有关于科学的问题。

leftover.def_en: the joint where your finger bends, connecting it to your hand a cut of meat from the lower leg of an animal, like a pig to strike or hit someone with your knuckles to press or rub your knuckles against something, often as a gesture
leftover.mnemonic: knuckle 可能来自古英语 cnucel，描述手指关节的连接部位，在解剖学中特指骨头的突出点。
example: He knocked on the door with his knuckle.
他用指关节敲门。

leftover.def_en: a boy or young man a man's group of friends a young man who likes typical young men's activities a person who works with horses
leftover.mnemonic: lad 来自中古英语，指年轻的小伙子，常用于非正式场合描述男孩。
example: That lad is my son.
那个小伙子是我儿子。

leftover.def_en: consisting of layers bonded together having a protective plastic coating
leftover.mnemonic: laminated 源于拉丁词根 lamina 薄片，后缀 ated 表示状态，指被压成薄层或分层的材料。
example: The laminated glass is very strong and won't break easily.
夹层玻璃非常坚固，不易破碎。

leftover.def_en: A woman who rents out a room or house to others. A woman who owns or runs a pub or guest house.
leftover.mnemonic: landlady 由 land（土地）和 lady（女士）构成，特指拥有或出租房产的女性房东，常见于租赁场景。
example: My landlady collects the rent every month for the apartment I live in.
我的女房东每月来收我住的公寓的房租。

leftover.def_en: A person or company that rents out property to others. A man who owns or runs a pub or guest house.
leftover.mnemonic: landlord 由 land 土地和 lord 主人组合而成，字面意思是土地的主人，指地主或房东。
example: My landlord is responsible for fixing any problems with the apartment.
我的房东负责修理公寓的任何问题。

leftover.def_en: A person who has legal ownership of a piece of land.
leftover.mnemonic: 由 land（土地）和 owner（拥有者）组合而成，指土地的所有者，常用于描述房地产或农业领域的产权人。
example: The landowner decided to build a house on the land he owned.
地主决定在他拥有的土地上建一栋房子。

leftover.def_en: Clothes that need to be washed, are being washed, or have just been washed. The act of washing clothes and other items. A business or place that washes clothes for people.
leftover.mnemonic: 来自法语 lavanderie，由 laver 洗和 erie 地方构成，意思是洗衣的地方，现在直接指洗衣店或洗衣服务。
example: I need to fold the clean laundry from the dryer.
我需要把烘干机里干净的衣物叠好。

leftover.def_en: A place or situation where there are no laws, or where people do not follow the laws. Not respecting or not following rules and laws.
leftover.mnemonic: lawless 意为无法无天的，词根是 law（法律）加上后缀 -less（表示缺乏），描述行为不受法律约束的状态。
example: After the earthquake, the town became lawless as people started looting and stealing.
地震后，小镇变得无法无天，人们开始抢劫和偷窃。

leftover.def_en: An area of short grass in a yard or park, often used for games. A fine, thin cotton or linen fabric used for clothing.
leftover.mnemonic: lawn 源自古法语 launde，指草地或林间空地，现在多用于指代修剪整齐的草坪，常与花园或高尔夫球场等休闲场所联系。
example: Children love to play on the soft lawn in the park.
孩子们喜欢在公园柔软的草坪上玩耍。

leftover.def_en: a small paper sheet with information or ads, given out for free to hand out leaflets to people
leftover.mnemonic: leaflet 源自 leaf（叶子）加上后缀 -let 表示小事物，因此指小叶子或像叶片般轻便散发的传单。
example: I read a leaflet about the new park rules.
我读了一份关于新公园规则的传单。

leftover.def_en: An old story about people and events that might be true or not. A very famous and admired person in a certain area. The part of a map or diagram that explains what the symbols mean. Words written on a sign, label, or coin.
leftover.mnemonic: 来自拉丁语 legenda，原意是被读的故事，演变为神话或民间传说
example: The legend of King Arthur tells stories of knights and magic.
亚瑟王的传说讲述了骑士和魔法的故事。

leftover.def_en: taking a long time or having many parts
leftover.mnemonic: lengthy 由 length 加 -y 后缀形成，length 源自古英语 lengu，意为长度，整体形容过度冗长的事物，如 a lengthy speech。
example: The meeting was lengthy and made everyone tired.
会议冗长，让所有人都感到疲惫。

leftover.def_en: being less strict when punishing someone or enforcing rules
leftover.mnemonic: leniency 来自拉丁语 lenire，意为使温和或减轻，加上后缀 -ency 形成名词，表示宽大或仁慈的态度。
example: The teacher showed leniency by giving the student another chance to complete the assignment.
老师表现出宽容，给了学生另一次完成作业的机会。

leftover.def_en: not strict when punishing or enforcing rules
leftover.mnemonic: Lenient 源自拉丁语 lenire 意为减轻或缓和，词根 lenis 表示温和的，常用来描述宽容的态度。
example: The teacher was lenient and gave the students extra time to finish the test.
老师很宽容，给了学生额外的时间来完成考试。

leftover.def_en: A curved piece of glass or plastic that makes things look bigger, smaller, or clearer when you look through it. The part of a camera that has one or more lenses to take pictures. A small, thin plastic piece you put on your eye to help you see better. The clear part inside your eye that helps you see by focusing light.
leftover.mnemonic: lens 来自拉丁语 lens 指扁豆，因为早期透镜形状类似扁豆，演变为光学设备如相机 lens 或眼镜片。
example: The lens in my glasses helps me see things clearly.
我眼镜的镜片帮助我看清东西。

kaoyan_ex.text: These takeoff shots are even more challenging because they require a wide-angle lens, which means he must be less than 2cm…

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“透镜”

leftover.def_en: to avoid the risk of something happening because of the fear that something might happen
leftover.mnemonic: lest 是古英语连词，意为以免，用于引导从句以避免不希望发生的情况，保留在正式语境中。
example: He spoke quietly lest he wake the baby.
他轻声说话，以免吵醒婴儿。

leftover.def_en: a person who works in a library and helps people find books and information
leftover.mnemonic: librarian 由 library 和 ian 组成，词根 liber 源于拉丁语意思是书，后缀 ian 表示职业，指图书管理员。
example: The librarian helped me find the perfect book for my research project
图书管理员帮我找到了适合我研究项目的完美书籍。

kaoyan_ex.text: As a librarian whose day job revolves around special collections and digital assets, I share the night terrors of historians,…

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“图书管理员”

leftover.def_en: A cover that goes on top of a container and can be taken off or opened. The skin that covers your eye when you blink or close it.
leftover.mnemonic: lid 源自古英语 hlid，表示盖子或覆盖物，用于容器如锅盖，体现了简单实用功能。
example: Put the lid on the pot to keep the food warm.
把盖子盖上，让食物保温。

leftover.def_en: in the same way also me too
leftover.mnemonic: likewise 来自古英语 gelicwisan，其中 like（相似的）和 wise（方式）结合，表示同样地或相似地。这个词用于表达同意或类比。
example: She smiled at him, and he smiled likewise.
她对他笑了笑，他也同样笑了笑。

kaoyan_ex.text: Likewise, automation should eventually boost productivity, stimulate demand by driving down prices, and free workers from…

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作adv.；意为“同样地”

leftover.def_en: A strong cloth made from flax plants, used for nice clothes and home items. Bed and table items like sheets and cloths.
leftover.mnemonic: linen 指亚麻布，词源可追溯到拉丁语 linum（亚麻），经历了从植物纤维到布料的含义演变。
example: She wore a cool linen dress in summer.
夏天她穿了一件凉爽的亚麻连衣裙。

leftover.def_en: strong alcoholic drinks like whiskey or vodka any type of alcoholic drink
leftover.mnemonic: liquor 词源是拉丁语 liquor，原义液体，现在主要指蒸馏酒精饮料如威士忌或伏特加。
example: He prefers liquor like whiskey over beer or wine.
比起啤酒或葡萄酒，他更喜欢威士忌之类的烈酒。

leftover.def_en: farm animals raised for food or other products
leftover.mnemonic: livestock 是复合词，live 表示活的，stock 指存货，组合意为牲畜，常指农场中饲养的动物如牛或羊。
example: Farmers care for their livestock by providing food, water, and shelter.
农民通过提供食物、水和住所来照料他们的牲畜。

leftover.def_en: a room in a home where people relax, watch TV, and spend time together
leftover.mnemonic: living room 是 living 和 room 的组合，living 表示日常生活，意为家庭日常活动的起居室。
example: We gather in the living room every evening to watch our favorite shows.
我们每天晚上聚在客厅看最喜欢的节目。

leftover.def_en: A small, lockable storage box for keeping personal items safe.
leftover.mnemonic: 由 lock 加后缀 -er 构成，lock 指锁住，-er 表示器具，特指带锁的储物柜。
example: I put my bag and coat in my locker at the gym.
我把包和外套放在健身房的储物柜里。

leftover.def_en: A special picture or symbol that represents a company or group.
leftover.mnemonic: logo 来自希腊语 logos 词或思想，现代指品牌标志，如公司 logo 用于视觉识别系统。
example: The company logo helps people recognize the brand easily.
公司标志帮助人们轻松识别品牌。

kaoyan_ex.text: …tax credit if the project includes a Georgia promotional logo.

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“标志”

leftover.def_en: A fishing method where a line with baited hooks is used to catch fish. A line of things or people that is long and unbroken. In computing, a line of text that goes on without a break.
leftover.mnemonic: Longline 是 long 和 line 的复合词，在时尚领域描述长款服装如 longline T-shirts，或在钓鱼中指长线钓具。
example: Fishermen use longlines to catch tuna and other large fish species.
渔民使用延绳钓捕捞金枪鱼和其他大型鱼类。

leftover.def_en: having existed for a long time continuing for a long period without change well-established over time
example: There is a longstanding tradition of celebrating the harvest festival in this village.
这个村庄有庆祝丰收节的悠久传统。

leftover.def_en: to make something less tight or fixed; to become less tight to make clothing or hair less tight when tied to hold something or someone less tightly to make something less strict or controlled
leftover.mnemonic: loosen 源于 loose 意为松的，加上后缀 -en 表示使...变得，因此描述使某物变松或放松的过程。
example: You need to loosen the lid before you can open the jar.
你需要先拧松盖子，才能打开罐子。

leftover.def_en: Uneven, with one side lower or smaller than the other. Unbalanced, favoring one side more than the other.
leftover.mnemonic: lopsided 由 lop 和 sided 组成，lop 指砍伐，sided 指侧面，合起来形容不平衡或一边倒的状态。
example: He had a lopsided smile after the accident.
事故后，他的笑容变得歪斜。

leftover.def_en: A man of high rank in the UK nobility or someone given the title as an honor. The title used by a lord in the UK. A title for some high UK officials. A respectful title for UK judges, bishops, or nobles. A powerful landowner in medieval Europe. A title for God or Christ. A title for Christ. The non-elected part of UK Parliament. The building where UK Lords meet. to act in a way that shows you have power or authority over others, often in an arrogant manner to live or behave as if you are a lord, enjoying luxury and leisure
leftover.mnemonic: 词源是古英语 hlaford，hlaf 意为面包， weard 是守护者，合起来指提供食物的领主或贵族。
example: The lord welcomed guests to his grand castle.
领主欢迎客人来到他的宏伟城堡。

kaoyan_ex.text: His status in Lord Wellington’s headquarters and the recognition given to him for his work were bound up with the class…

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“勋爵”

leftover.def_en: a big truck for carrying heavy things on roads
leftover.mnemonic: lorry 在英式英语中表示卡车，可能源自方言或专有名词，指大型运输车辆，类似美式英语的 truck。
example: The lorry carried many boxes to the store.
卡车把许多箱子运到了商店。

leftover.def_en: to apply oil or grease to make parts move smoothly
leftover.mnemonic: 词根源于拉丁语 lubricus，意思是滑的，后缀 -ate 表示动作，因此是添加润滑剂以减少摩擦的过程，常用于机械维护。
example: You should lubricate the bicycle chain regularly to keep it running quietly.
你应该定期给自行车链条上油，以保持其安静运行。

leftover.def_en: making a lot of money
leftover.mnemonic: lucrative 源自拉丁语 lucrum 利润，后缀 -ative 表示产生收益的，指能带来丰厚利润的商业机会或投资。
example: The business became very lucrative after they found a new way to sell their products.
在找到销售产品的新方法后，这项生意变得非常赚钱。

leftover.def_en: related to the moon
leftover.mnemonic: lunar 直接来自拉丁语 luna，指月亮的，常用于描述月球相关现象如 lunar eclipse。
example: The lunar surface is covered with craters from meteor impacts.
月球表面布满了流星撞击形成的陨石坑。

leftover.def_en: one of the two organs in your chest that help you breathe
leftover.mnemonic: 单词 lung 源于古英语 lungen，专指人体的呼吸器官肺，它在呼吸过程中负责氧气交换。
example: The doctor checked his lung to make sure it was healthy.
医生检查了他的肺部以确保其健康。

leftover.def_en: full and thick, looking attractive having a lot of something pleasant or beautiful
leftover.mnemonic: luxuriant 源于拉丁语 luxuriare 过度生长，与 luxury 奢侈相关，形容植物茂盛或头发浓密，暗示丰饶和繁茂。
example: The garden was filled with luxuriant flowers.
花园里开满了茂盛的花朵。

leftover.def_en: the words of a song a short poem that expresses personal feelings expressing personal feelings and thoughts related to singing or songs
leftover.mnemonic: lyric 源于希腊语 lyrikos（为里拉琴而作的），指抒情诗歌或歌词，常与音乐艺术关联。
example: She wrote the lyric for the new pop song.
她为这首新流行歌曲写了歌词。

leftover.def_en: the grand and beautiful quality of something a title for a king or queen the power of a king or queen
leftover.mnemonic: majesty 的词源是拉丁语 majestas，根词 maj- 源于 magnus 表示大，后缀 -ty 表状态，指庄严或至高无上的威严，常用于尊称君主。
example: The majesty of the mountains took our breath away.
山脉的壮丽令我们叹为观止。

leftover.def_en: cosmetics applied to the face to enhance or alter appearance the combination of things that form something a test taken again by someone who missed or failed the original one
example: She never leaves the house without putting on her makeup.
她出门前从不化妆。

kaoyan_ex.text: Not only does understanding the equines’ genetic makeup help reveal their contribution to human history, but it also might…

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“化妆品”

leftover.def_en: improper or illegal actions by a professional person
leftover.mnemonic: malpractice 由前缀 mal 表示坏的，加上 practice 指实践，合起来描述专业领域中的不当行为或疏忽。
example: The doctor was sued for malpractice after making a serious error during surgery.
医生在手术中犯下严重错误后被起诉医疗事故。

kaoyan_ex.text: Scopus itself has all the data necessary to detect this malpractice.

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“渎职”

leftover.def_en: a book or document before it is printed an old book or document written by hand
leftover.mnemonic: manuscript 由 manu 手和 script 写组成，词源拉丁语，指手写文档，在历史中常用于古籍或原创文本。
example: The author sent her manuscript to the publisher for review.
作者将她的手稿寄给出版商审阅。

leftover.def_en: very long and tiring a very long running race of 42 kilometers any very long and difficult activity
leftover.mnemonic: marathon 源自希腊马拉松战役，纪念一名士兵长跑报信的故事，现在指长距离事件或耐力比赛。
example: She finished the book in one marathon reading session.
她一口气读完了这本书，像跑马拉松一样。

leftover.def_en: The art of creating designs on furniture or other objects by inlaying small pieces of different types of wood.
leftover.mnemonic: marquetry 源自法语 marqueterie，指木制品的镶嵌装饰艺术，常用于家具设计。
example: The antique table was adorned with intricate marquetry patterns.
古董桌上装饰着精美的镶嵌图案。

kaoyan_ex.text: …in 1879, where elaborate wall and ceiling stenciling and marquetry floors decorated the office of the Secretary.

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“镶嵌细工”；常见搭配 of

leftover.def_en: the cruel killing of many people a very big loss in a game or contest to kill many people cruelly to defeat someone by a very high score
leftover.mnemonic: massacre 源自法语 massacrer，可能源于 mass 指大量，但现在泛指大规模屠杀事件。
example: The massacre in the village left no survivors.
村庄里的大屠杀无一幸存者。

leftover.def_en: someone who helps people find a romantic partner
leftover.mnemonic: matchmaker 由 match 匹配和 maker 制造者组成，指安排婚姻或配对的人，如媒人角色。
example: The matchmaker arranged for the young couple to meet at a local coffee shop.
媒人安排这对年轻人在当地一家咖啡馆见面。

leftover.def_en: being average or not very good a person who is average or not very good at something
leftover.mnemonic: Mediocrity 来自拉丁语 mediocris，medi- 表示中间，描述平庸或中等水平，常用于批评普通表现。
example: The company's products fell into mediocrity after the founder left.
创始人离开后，公司的产品变得平庸。

kaoyan_ex.text: Yet mediocrity is no longer enough to justify a dismissal.

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“平庸”

leftover.def_en: A huge stone, often used in ancient times for religious or cultural ceremonies.
leftover.mnemonic: 由希腊词根 mega 大和 lith 石头组成，指史前巨石结构如巨石阵
example: The archaeologists discovered a megalith that had been part of a prehistoric monument.
考古学家发现了一块巨石，它曾是史前纪念碑的一部分。

leftover.def_en: a large round fruit with sweet juicy flesh inside and a hard skin
leftover.mnemonic: melon 源于希腊语 melopepon，指瓜类水果如 watermelon 西瓜，与夏季饮食相关。
example: I ate a sweet slice of melon for breakfast
我早餐吃了一片甜瓜。

leftover.def_en: to turn from solid to liquid when heated to become or make feelings less strong to feel very hot
leftover.mnemonic: melt 源自古英语 meltan，指固体如冰或金属在受热时转化为液体的物理现象，常见于自然或工业场景。
example: The ice cream will melt if you leave it in the sun.
如果你把冰淇淋放在阳光下，它会融化。

kaoyan_ex.text: They melt into sludge.

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作v.；意为“融化”；常见搭配 into

leftover.def_en: being part of a group or club all the members of a group or club
leftover.mnemonic: membership 由 member 和 后缀 ship 组合而成，member 表示成员，ship 表示状态，整体指成员身份，常见于俱乐部或在线社区。
example: You need a membership to use the gym.
你需要会员资格才能使用健身房。

kaoyan_ex.text: Requiring companies to make gender the primary qualification for board membership will inevitably lead to less experienced…

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“成员身份”

leftover.def_en: An experienced person who guides and helps someone with less experience. An experienced person who trains and advises new workers or students. To guide and help a less experienced person over time.
leftover.mnemonic: mentor 一词来自荷马史诗中的角色 Mentor，他是奥德修斯的智慧顾问，现泛指经验丰富的指导者。
example: He became a mentor to many young professionals starting their careers.
他成为许多初入职场年轻人的导师。

leftover.def_en: without any pity or compassion
leftover.mnemonic: mercilessly 由 mercy（仁慈）、后缀 -less（无）和 -ly（地）组成，意为无情地，形容残酷或不带怜悯的行为。
example: The soldiers fought mercilessly, showing no mercy to their enemies.
士兵们无情地战斗，对敌人毫不留情。

leftover.def_en: A system where the most talented or hardworking people are chosen for jobs or positions of power. The group of people who are in power because they are considered the most talented or hardworking.
leftover.mnemonic: meritocracy 由 merit 词根指优点，来自拉丁语 meritum，和 -cracy 后缀表示统治，合起来描述基于功绩的社会体系。
example: In a true meritocracy, the best person for the job would be chosen, regardless of their background.
在一个真正的精英管理制度中，无论背景如何，最适合该职位的人都会被选中。

kaoyan_ex.text: …to keep them in check; between new forces of science and meritocracy and old ones of conservatism and birth.

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“精英制度”；常见搭配 of

leftover.def_en: A system where people are chosen for jobs or positions based on their abilities and achievements, not because of who they are or where they come from.
leftover.mnemonic: meritocratic 结合 merit（功绩）和 -cratic（统治），描述社会或系统基于才能而非出身分配机会。
example: In a meritocratic society, everyone has the opportunity to succeed based on their talents and hard work.
在精英管理的社会中，每个人都有机会凭借自己的才能和努力获得成功。

leftover.def_en: a person who carries and delivers messages or packages
leftover.mnemonic: messenger 基于 message，来自拉丁语 mittere 发送，后缀 er 表示人，指送信者或使者，如 email messenger 电子邮件信使，体现信息传递角色。
example: The messenger brought an important letter to the office.
信使给办公室带来了一封重要的信。

leftover.def_en: the study of how to make and use metals
leftover.mnemonic: metallurgy 由希腊语 metallon 金属和 ergon 工作组合而成，指冶金学，这门科学专注于金属提取和加工的技术。
example: In metallurgy, learning how to combine different metals is fundamental.
在冶金学中，学习如何结合不同的金属是基础。

leftover.def_en: a word or phrase that describes something by comparing it to something else with similar qualities
leftover.mnemonic: metaphor 源于希腊语 metaphora，由 meta-（超越）和 pherein（携带）构成，意为通过比喻转移概念，是文学中常见的修辞手法
example: The author used a metaphor to describe the city as a sleeping giant
作者用了一个比喻，把这座城市描述成一个沉睡的巨人。

leftover.def_en: in a way that follows a system or plan
leftover.mnemonic: methodically 来自 method 方法加上副词后缀 -ically，表示以系统、有条理的方式行动。
example: She methodically went through the checklist to ensure nothing was missed.
她有条不紊地检查清单，确保没有遗漏。

leftover.def_en: a person who has at least one million dollars or pounds
leftover.mnemonic: millionaire 来自法语 millionnaire，million 指百万，后缀 aire 表示拥有者，整体描述财富达到百万级别的人。
example: The lottery winner became an instant millionaire overnight.
彩票中奖者一夜之间成了百万富翁。

leftover.def_en: One thousandth of a second.
leftover.mnemonic: milli- 来自拉丁语 mille（千分之一），second 是时间单位，组合为毫秒，即千分之一秒的时间量度。
example: I hesitated for just a millisecond before reacting.
我犹豫了仅仅一毫秒就做出了反应。

leftover.def_en: to incorrectly use something in a way that it was not meant to be used
leftover.mnemonic: misapply 拆解为 mis- 表示错误和 apply 表示应用，意为误用或滥用，词源来自拉丁语，常用于描述不当地使用资源或方法。
example: He was accused of misapplying the funds meant for charity.
他被指控挪用本应用于慈善的资金。

leftover.def_en: When two things don't fit well together or are not right for each other. When things or people are not a good match or do not fit well together.
leftover.mnemonic: mismatch 由 mis 表示错误或不良，match 表示匹配，合起来指不协调或不匹配，常用于数据或人际关系。
example: Their personalities mismatch, which causes a lot of arguments.
他们的性格不合，导致了很多争吵。

leftover.def_en: not in the right or intended position given to someone who does not deserve it
leftover.mnemonic: mis- 前缀指错误地，placed 表示放置，合起来形容物品放错位置或情感投注不当的情况。
example: He made a misplaced attempt at reconciliation, which only made the situation worse.
他进行了一次不合时宜的和解尝试，反而使情况更糟。

leftover.def_en: A weapon that flies through the air and explodes when it hits its target An object thrown at someone to hurt them
leftover.mnemonic: 词根 miss 取自拉丁语 mittere，意思是发送或投掷，后缀 -ile 表示能够的物体，因此指可发射的武器或投射物。
example: The missile was launched to destroy the enemy base from a long distance.
导弹被发射以从远距离摧毁敌方基地。

leftover.def_en: related to the mitochondria, which are small structures inside cells that produce energy
leftover.mnemonic: mitochondrial 指线粒体的，词源为希腊语 mitos 线和 chondrion 颗粒，描述这种细胞器像线状颗粒，为细胞提供能量。
example: The study of mitochondrial diseases is crucial for understanding cellular energy production.
对线粒体疾病的研究对于理解细胞能量产生至关重要。

leftover.def_en: A part of a course of study at a school or university. A part of a computer system or program that does a specific job. A piece that can be connected to other pieces to build something. A part of a spacecraft that can work on its own.
leftover.mnemonic: module 来自拉丁语 modulus（小度量单位），由 modus（尺度）演变，指独立单元或组件，如软件模块或建筑部件。
example: Students must complete each module to finish the program.
学生必须完成每个模块才能完成课程。

leftover.def_en: only using or speaking one language a person who only speaks one language
leftover.mnemonic: monoglot 由前缀 mono- 表示单一和后缀 -glot 指语言组成，源自希腊语，描述只会一种语言的人。
example: In a multilingual country, some people are monoglot, meaning they only speak their native language.
在多语言国家，有些人是单语者，即他们只会说母语。

kaoyan_ex.text: David Graddol concludes that monoglot English graduates face a bleak economic future as qualified multilingual youngsters from…

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作adj.；意为“单语”

leftover.def_en: to control most of something and prevent others from having it to take all of someone's attention or time so they cannot help others
leftover.mnemonic: monopolize 源于希腊语 mono-（单一）和 polein（卖），意思是垄断市场或独占资源。
example: The large company tried to monopolize the market by buying all the smaller businesses.
这家大公司试图通过收购所有小企业来垄断市场。

leftover.def_en: a picture or pattern made from small colored pieces of glass, stone, or other materials
leftover.mnemonic: mosaic 词源是拉丁语 musaicum，与缪斯女神相关，指用小块材料拼贴的艺术形式，现在也用于描述数字图像中的像素化效果。
example: The ancient mosaic on the floor shows a beautiful pattern of birds and flowers.
地板上的古代马赛克呈现出美丽的鸟与花图案。

leftover.def_en: A small flying insect that bites people and animals to drink blood.
leftover.mnemonic: mosquito 源于西班牙语 mosquito，拆解为 mosca（苍蝇）加上指小后缀 -ito，表示小苍蝇。
example: The mosquito buzzed near my ear while I tried to sleep.
我正要睡觉时，蚊子在我耳边嗡嗡叫。

leftover.def_en: A small, simple plant that is usually green and grows in damp places. It doesn't have flowers or seeds.
leftover.mnemonic: moss 源自古英语 mos，指苔藓类植物，常生长在潮湿环境，其简单词根帮助记忆自然界的绿色覆盖物。
example: The old tree was covered in a thick layer of moss.
那棵老树覆盖着一层厚厚的苔藓。

leftover.def_en: The part of a device like a phone or radio that you speak into. The part of a musical instrument that you blow or buzz into to make sound. A person, newspaper, etc. that speaks for someone else or a group of people.
leftover.mnemonic: mouthpiece 字面是 mouth 嘴和 piece 部分，指乐器吹口或代言人；可选联系是在法律和政治中常比喻为发言人，代表他人发声。
example: He whispered into the mouthpiece so others wouldn't hear.
他对着话筒低声说话，以免别人听到。

leftover.def_en: More than two billion of something, often used to show how big something is.
leftover.mnemonic: multi- 表示多个，billion 是十亿，组合起来形容数额巨大的，比如企业市值或投资规模。
example: The government has a multibillion budget for infrastructure projects.
政府有数十亿的基础设施项目预算。

leftover.def_en: An old story that explains how things began or tells about gods and heroes. A false idea that many people believe is true.
leftover.mnemonic: myth 源于希腊语 mythos，指传统故事或传说，常与古代神灵和英雄相关
example: The Greek myth about Pandora's box explains why bad things happen in the world.
关于潘多拉魔盒的希腊神话解释了世界上为什么会有坏事发生。

leftover.def_en: without clothes not covered by anything plain and honest, not hidden not protected and easily hurt
leftover.mnemonic: 这个词来自古英语 nacod，表示赤裸状态，强调无遮盖的身体或物体。
example: The baby was completely naked after his bath.
婴儿洗完澡后全身赤裸。

leftover.def_en: a short sleep, often in the day soft, short threads on cloth expert tip on which horse will win to sleep briefly, usually in the day
leftover.mnemonic: nap 指短时间的小睡，源于中古英语 nappen，表示短暂休息。
example: A quick nap helps me feel rested.
快速小睡一下能让我精神焕发。

leftover.def_en: behaving badly or not following rules slightly rude or about sex
leftover.mnemonic: naughty 源自古英语 naught，意为无价值或零，含义演变为形容顽皮或不端行为，暗示这些行为被视为无益。
example: The naughty child did not listen to his parents.
那个顽皮的孩子不听父母的话。

leftover.def_en: about or related to ships, sailing, or sailors
leftover.mnemonic: nautical 来自希腊语 nautes（水手），通过拉丁语 nauticus 演变，用于描述与航海或海洋相关的事物，如 nautical mile 这种单位。
example: He bought a nautical guide to help with his journey at sea.
他买了一本航海指南，以帮助他的海上航行。

leftover.def_en: A country's sea fighting force and its ships. A very dark blue color.
leftover.mnemonic: 源于拉丁语 navis，意为船，词根 nav- 与航海相关，现在引申为海军或深蓝色，因为海军制服常用这种颜色。
example: The navy protects the country's waters and shores.
海军保护国家的领水和海岸。

kaoyan_ex.text: Mullett, it was built from 1871 to 1888 to house the growing staffs of the State, War, and Navy Departments, and is considered…

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“海军”

leftover.def_en: to make something needed or required
leftover.mnemonic: necessitate 来自 necessity 一词，词根 necess- 表示不可避免的，后缀 -ate 使动词化，含义为使某事成为必需，常用于强调必要性。
example: The heavy rain will necessitate the use of umbrellas.
大雨将使得使用雨伞成为必要。

kaoyan_ex.text: In 1866, the construction of the North Wing of the Treasury Building necessitated the demolition of the State Department building.

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作v.；意为“需要”；常见搭配 of；以 -ed 形式出现

leftover.def_en: the son of your brother or sister
leftover.mnemonic: nephew 源于拉丁语 nepos，经古法语 neveu 演变而来，原指兄弟或姐妹的儿子，在家族关系中固定为侄子。
example: My nephew is coming to visit us this weekend.
我的侄子这个周末要来看我们。

leftover.def_en: just born a baby or animal that has just been born
leftover.mnemonic: 组合 new（新）和 born（出生），特指刚出生的事物，尤指婴儿，强调新鲜和初始状态。
example: The newborn kittens are sleeping.
新生的小猫正在睡觉。

kaoyan_ex.text: …in relationships, including that between mothers and their newborn babies.

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作adj.；意为“刚出生的”

leftover.def_en: a person who has recently married recently married
example: The newlyweds are planning a honeymoon in Italy.
新婚夫妇正计划去意大利度蜜月。

leftover.def_en: A type of low-cost, lightweight paper that is used for printing newspapers and other publications.
leftover.mnemonic: newsprint 由 news 新闻和 print 印刷构成，指用于报纸印刷的廉价纸张。
example: The newspaper was printed on thin, inexpensive newsprint to keep costs down.
报纸印在薄而便宜的白报纸上以降低成本。

leftover.def_en: A place where people work to gather and prepare news for newspapers, radio, or TV.
leftover.mnemonic: newsroom 是复合词 news 新闻和 room 房间，指报社或电视台的编辑室，记者们在此工作。
example: In the newsroom, journalists were busy writing articles for the morning edition.
在新闻编辑室里，记者们正忙着为早报撰写文章。

leftover.def_en: a small structure or table in a public place where newspapers and magazines are sold a business that sells newspapers and magazines
leftover.mnemonic: newsstand 是 news（新闻）和 stand（摊位）的组合，指街头售卖报纸和杂志的固定点，体现了英语复合词的直观构造。
example: I bought a magazine from the newsstand at the train station.
我在火车站的报刊亭买了一本杂志。

leftover.def_en: A hard, silver-white metal used to make steel stronger. A US or Canadian coin worth five cents.
leftover.mnemonic: 词源是德语 Kupfernickel，意为恶魔的铜，因为矿工误以为它是铜矿，后来用于命名金属元素镍，常见于硬币材料。
example: This metal contains nickel to make it stronger and last longer.
这种金属含有镍，使其更坚固、更耐用。

leftover.def_en: a fun or friendly name for someone, often based on their real name, looks, or personality to give someone a fun or friendly name
leftover.mnemonic: nickname 源于中古英语 an eke name，其中 eke 表示‘也’或‘额外’，所以是‘另一个名字’，演变为非正式的爱称或别名。
example: My nickname 'Shorty' came from being the smallest in my family.
我的绰号“矮子”源于我是家里个子最小的。

leftover.def_en: Your brother's or sister's daughter
leftover.mnemonic: 来自古法语 niece，源头是拉丁语 neptis 侄女，通常指兄弟或姐妹的女儿，与 nephew 侄子形成对应关系。
example: My niece loves to play with her new puppy in the park.
我的侄女喜欢在公园里和她的新小狗玩耍。

leftover.def_en: A gas that makes up most of the air we breathe.
leftover.mnemonic: nitrogen 源自希腊语 nitron 指硝石，genes 指产生，因为它最初从硝石中分离，是空气中占比最高的气体。
example: Plants need nitrogen from the soil to grow healthy and strong.
植物需要土壤中的氮才能健康茁壮地生长。

leftover.def_en: the quality of being noisy or making a lot of sound the state of being full of unwanted or distracting sounds
example: The noisiness of the construction site made it difficult to concentrate.
建筑工地的嘈杂使人难以集中注意力。

leftover.def_en: Not expressing a clear opinion or choice; avoiding taking a stand.
leftover.mnemonic: 前缀 non 表示否定，committal 源于 commit 的承诺含义，因此 non-committal 形容人避免明确表态的含糊态度。
example: When asked about the new policy, she remained non-committal.
当被问及新政策时，她仍然不置可否。

leftover.def_en: in spite of that
leftover.mnemonic: nonetheless 由 none（无）、the（定冠词）和 less（少）组合而成，表达尽管有障碍或差异，依然坚持的含义。
example: The weather was bad; nonetheless, we had a good time.
天气不好，尽管如此，我们还是玩得很开心。

kaoyan_ex.text: Even if families don’t sit down to eat together as frequently as before, millions of Britons will nonetheless have got a share…

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作adv.；意为“尽管如此”

leftover.def_en: located in or coming from the northeast part of a region or country relating to or characteristic of the northeast
example: The northeastern states of the US often experience harsh winters.
美国东北部各州经常经历严冬。

leftover.def_en: located in or characteristic of the northwest part of a region or country a person from or resident of the northwestern region
example: The northwestern part of the state has beautiful mountain ranges.
该州的西北部有美丽的山脉。

leftover.def_en: in spite of; regardless of nevertheless; however even though; although
leftover.mnemonic: 组合 not 和 withstanding（承受），表示尽管或不顾某种情况，常用于让步语境。
example: The rain notwithstanding, we had a wonderful picnic.
尽管下雨，我们的野餐还是很愉快。

leftover.def_en: Not able to feel anything in a body part, often because of cold. Unable to feel, think, or react normally, usually because of shock. To make a body part unable to feel anything, often because of cold. To make someone unable to feel, think, or react normally, often because of emotional shock.
leftover.mnemonic: numb 可能源于古英语词汇表示被剥夺感觉，描述身体或情感麻木的状态，常与失去知觉相关。
example: After sitting in the cold, my toes were numb and I couldn't feel them.
在寒冷中坐了一段时间后，我的脚趾麻木了，感觉不到它们。

leftover.def_en: A strong man-made material used to make clothes, ropes, and other items. Women's stockings or tights made from nylon.
leftover.mnemonic: nylon 是合成词 由 New York 和 London 缩写而成 因杜邦公司在两地研发这种人造纤维 常见于服装和工业材料
example: This jacket is made of nylon, so it is light and strong.
这件夹克是尼龙做的，所以又轻又结实。

leftover.def_en: A large tree that grows acorns and lives a long time. The strong wood from the oak tree.
leftover.mnemonic: oak 直接来自古英语 ac，是一种硬木橡树，象征 strength 和 durability，常见于森林生态和家具制作。
example: We sat under a big oak tree in the park.
我们坐在公园里一棵大橡树下。

leftover.def_en: to do what someone tells you to do
leftover.mnemonic: obey 来自拉丁语 obedire，ob- 前缀表示朝向，audire 是听的意思，因此 obey 指听从指令或遵守规则。
example: Children should obey their parents' rules at home.
孩子在家应该遵守父母的规矩。

leftover.def_en: to make someone do something because it is required by law or duty to help someone by doing what they ask or need
leftover.mnemonic: 单词 oblige 源于拉丁语 obligare，由 ob- 向和 ligare 绑定组合，意为施加义务或帮助他人，如社交礼节中常见。
example: The law obliges parents to send their children to school.
法律强制父母送子女上学。

kaoyan_ex.text: …service asks you to add inappropriate references, do not oblige and do report the request to the journal.

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作v.；意为“迫使”

leftover.def_en: a building where scientists watch and study the stars, planets, or weather
leftover.mnemonic: observatory 来自 observe 和 -ory 后缀，-ory 表示场所，observe 源于拉丁语 observare，所以是专门用于天文观察的站点。
example: The new observatory has a powerful telescope for studying distant galaxies.
新天文台配备了一台强大的望远镜，用于研究遥远的星系。

kaoyan_ex.text: Protests have erupted over construction of the Thirty Meter Telescope (TMT), a giant observatory that promises to…

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“天文台”；后接 that 从句

leftover.def_en: a smell, especially a bad one
leftover.mnemonic: odor 来自拉丁语，直接表示气味，特别强调嗅觉感受，常指难闻的气味，如化学物质的味道。
example: The strong odor from the garbage made me hold my nose.
垃圾的强烈气味让我捂住了鼻子。

kaoyan_ex.text: …characteristic: Each plant or tree has its own particular odor signature.

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“气味”

leftover.def_en: by someone in authority or in a public way according to rules or laws as stated publicly, but possibly not true
leftover.mnemonic: officially 来自 official，源于拉丁语 officium 职责或办公室，意思是以正式或官方身份行事或声明。
example: The mayor officially opened the new park.
市长正式为新公园揭幕。

kaoyan_ex.text: The journey officially began in Ogden, Utah, on June 8, 1871.

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作adv.；意为“正式地”；常见搭配 in

leftover.def_en: Not connected to the internet or a computer system. In a state of not being connected to the internet or a computer system.
leftover.mnemonic: off 表示脱离，line 指线路或连接，组合起来描述未联网的状态，常用于数字语境。
example: You can still work on your document offline.
你仍然可以在离线状态下处理你的文档。

leftover.def_en: A creature or person that eats both plants and meat.
leftover.mnemonic: 词根 omni 源于拉丁语意为所有，vorare 意为吃，因此描述杂食动物，吃多种食物来源，在生态学中常见。
example: Humans are considered omnivores because they eat a variety of foods, including fruits, vegetables, and meat.
人类被认为是杂食动物，因为他们吃各种各样的食物，包括水果、蔬菜和肉类。

leftover.def_en: Refers to the same person as the subject. Used to emphasize the subject.
leftover.mnemonic: oneself 由 one 和 self 组合而成，one 源于古英语，指一个个体，self 意为自身，整体强调自我或独立身份，词源简单易记。
example: One should always believe in oneself.
一个人应该始终相信自己。

leftover.def_en: related to how a business, machine, or system works ready to be used related to a military mission
leftover.mnemonic: operational 源于 operate，词根 oper- 表示工作，加上后缀 -ational 构成形容词，指事物可运行或处于功能状态，常用于描述系统或设备的可用性。
example: The operational costs of running the factory are very high.
运营这家工厂的成本非常高。

leftover.def_en: To make something work better or more efficiently. To improve the performance or quality of something, like a computer program or a website.
leftover.mnemonic: optimize 基于拉丁语 optimus（最好的），加上后缀 -ize，意思是使某事物达到最佳状态，常用于工程或商业领域提升效率。
example: We need to optimize our workflow to save time.
我们需要优化工作流程以节省时间。

kaoyan_ex.text: Companies can also optimize their own energy use and cut down on the cost of electricity.

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作v.；意为“优化”

leftover.def_en: a piece of land where fruit trees grow
leftover.mnemonic: 源自古英语 orceard，可能来自拉丁语 hortus 花园，特指种植果树的专用园地。
example: We visited an apple orchard to pick fresh fruit.
我们参观了一个苹果园，采摘新鲜水果。

leftover.def_en: used to say what is right to do used to say what you expect to happen used to give advice used to say what is likely true
leftover.mnemonic: ought to 表示应该或义务，ought 来自古英语 agan 意思是欠债，经过演变表示责任，to 是介词，共同构成情态动词短语。
example: You ought to tell the truth.
你应该说实话。

leftover.def_en: To live longer than someone or something else. To continue existing after something else has ended.
leftover.mnemonic: out- 表示超过，live 意为生活，合起来指活得比某人更长，常用于比较寿命。
example: He outlived his wife by three years, continuing to live after she passed away.
他比妻子多活了三年，在她去世后继续生活。

leftover.def_en: To make something old-fashioned or no longer popular. To become no longer in style or useful.
leftover.mnemonic: outmode 由 out（超出）和 mode（模式）组成，意为使某物过时或不流行，常用于描述技术或时尚淘汰
example: New smartphones have outmode the older models quickly.
新智能手机很快使旧型号过时了。

leftover.def_en: to do better than someone or something else
leftover.mnemonic: outperform 由 out（超出）和 perform（表现）组合而成，表示在性能或结果上优于其他事物，常用于商业或体育语境。
example: The local sports team has been outperforming their opponents all season.
当地运动队整个赛季的表现都优于对手。

kaoyan_ex.text: One company in the UK, Phrasee, claims their software can outperform humans by up to 10 percent when it comes to email open rates.

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作v.；意为“胜过”；常见搭配 by

leftover.def_en: to hire another company to do work or provide services that your own company needs
leftover.mnemonic: outsource 由 out（外部）和 source（来源）组成，表示将业务或服务外包给外部供应商，商业管理中常见这种策略。
example: The company decided to outsource their marketing to a specialized agency.
公司决定将营销业务外包给一家专业机构。

kaoyan_ex.text: …Arabic or Mandarin grows and international business process outsourcing in other languages such as Japanese, French and German, spreads.

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作v.；意为“外包”；常见搭配 in；以 -ing 形式出现

leftover.def_en: The part of a woman's body that produces eggs and hormones. The part of a flower that contains the seeds.
leftover.mnemonic: ovary 源自拉丁语 ovarium，ovum 意为蛋，指女性生殖系统中的卵巢，负责产生卵子。
example: The doctor checked the woman's ovary to ensure it was functioning properly.
医生检查了该女性的卵巢以确保其功能正常。

leftover.def_en: Exaggerated or too much of something, not as good as it seems. Old and not as fresh or beautiful as before.
leftover.mnemonic: 词根 over- 表示过度，blown 来自 blow 吹，含义演变指夸张或过分渲染，常用于形容言过其实的言论。
example: The movie had overblown special effects that took away from the story.
这部电影的特效过于夸张，削弱了故事本身。

leftover.def_en: a long, warm coat worn over other clothes in cold weather
leftover.mnemonic: overcoat 拆解为 over 和 coat，over 表示上面 coat 指外套，合起来指穿在外衣之上的大衣，用于防寒或正式着装。
example: He put on his thick overcoat before going outside in the snow.
他在雪天出门前穿上了厚大衣。

leftover.def_en: having too many people or things in one place
leftover.mnemonic: overcrowded 包含前缀 over 过度，加上 crowded 拥挤的，描述空间过于饱和的状态。
example: The bus was overcrowded with passengers during rush hour.
高峰时段，公交车里挤满了乘客。

kaoyan_ex.text: A series of fires (including those set by the British in 1814) and overcrowded conditions led to the construction of the…

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作adj.；意为“拥挤”；常接 to 不定式/介词 to；常见搭配 of；以 -ed 形式出现

leftover.def_en: to wear clothes that are too formal or elaborate for the occasion a dress worn over another dress or garment
example: She tends to overdress for casual parties.
她倾向于在休闲派对上穿得过于正式。

leftover.def_en: to think something is bigger, better, or more important than it really is a guess that is too high about size, cost, or value
leftover.mnemonic: over- 表示过度，estimate 意为估计，合起来就是高估，提醒人们避免过分乐观的判断。
example: Don't overestimate how much time you need for the project.
不要高估你完成这个项目所需的时间。

leftover.def_en: very happy or excited about something
leftover.mnemonic: 由 over（过度）和 joyed（高兴的）组合，overjoyed 意为喜出望外的极度喜悦。
example: When she got the job offer, she was overjoyed and couldn't stop smiling.
当她得到那份工作邀请时，她欣喜若狂，笑个不停。

leftover.def_en: To wrap something in more packaging than needed. To put too much in a container, making it too full. An extra container that protects the original packaging.
leftover.mnemonic: 合成词 over 表示过度，pack 意为打包，合起来指旅行时塞太多东西进箱子，容易导致行李超重。
example: The store overpacked the toy, making it hard to open.
商店把玩具包装得太严实了，很难打开。

kaoyan_ex.text: Another factor may be that more people are trying to overpack their carry-on bags to avoid checkedbaggage fees, though the…

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作v.；意为“过度包装”；常见搭配 on

leftover.def_en: to give someone more money than they should receive, usually for their job or service
leftover.mnemonic: overpay 拆解为 over（超过）和 pay（支付），意为支付过多金额，提醒在交易中避免不必要的超额支出。
example: I believe they overpay him for the work he does.
我认为他们付给他的工资过高了。

leftover.def_en: to do more than you should or are allowed to do
leftover.mnemonic: 由 over- 过度和 step 步组成，表示跨越界限或逾越规则，常用于描述行为失当。
example: When you overstep, you do something that you're not supposed to do. For example, if you overstep in a game, you might break a rule.
当你越界时，你做了你不该做的事。例如，如果你在游戏中越界，你可能违反了规则。

leftover.def_en: to consider something to be more important or valuable than it really is
leftover.mnemonic: overvalue 由前缀 over-（过度）和 value（价值）构成，指对事物评价过高，可能导致经济泡沫，如股票市场中的估值错误。
example: We shouldn't overvalue material possessions.
我们不应该高估物质财富。

leftover.def_en: because of something
leftover.mnemonic: owing 来自 owe 欠， to 到，这个短语表示由于或归因于，演变自债务关系到因果关系。
example: The flight was delayed owing to bad weather.
航班因天气恶劣而延误。

leftover.def_en: a bird with big round eyes that hunts small animals at night
leftover.mnemonic: 源自古英语 ūle，指夜行性鸟类猫头鹰，在文化中常象征智慧，如希腊神话中的雅典娜标志。
example: The owl caught a mouse in the dark forest.
猫头鹰在黑暗的森林里抓住了一只老鼠。

leftover.def_en: the state of having something that belongs to you
leftover.mnemonic: owner（所有者）加后缀 ship，表示拥有权或控制权，强调对财产或事物的归属关系。
example: Taking ownership of your mistakes helps you learn and grow.
为自己的错误负责有助于你学习和成长。

leftover.def_en: A gas in air that living things need to breathe and stay alive.
leftover.mnemonic: oxygen 源自希腊语 oxys（尖锐或酸）和 genes（产生），组合意为产生酸的元素，最初因氧气参与酸的形成而得名，在生物学中它也是维持生命的关键气体。
example: Plants produce oxygen during the day, which helps us breathe.
植物在白天产生氧气，这有助于我们呼吸。

leftover.def_en: A gas that is a form of oxygen, has a strong smell, and can be harmful. Fresh, clean air near the ocean that people enjoy breathing.
leftover.mnemonic: ozone 来自希腊语 ozein，意为闻，因为臭氧有特殊气味，现在常用于指臭氧层。
example: Ozone forms when electricity passes through oxygen in the air.
当电流通过空气中的氧气时，就会形成臭氧。

leftover.def_en: A tool with bristles attached to a handle, used for applying paint to a surface.
leftover.mnemonic: 单词 paintbrush 是复合词，paint 油漆 和 brush 刷子，直接描述绘画工具，演变自其功能用途。
example: She picked up a paintbrush and began to create a beautiful landscape on the canvas.
她拿起画笔，开始在画布上创作一幅美丽的风景画。

leftover.def_en: a small, thin book with a paper cover that gives information about something
leftover.mnemonic: Pamphlet 源于中世纪拉丁语 Pamphilus，原本是一部流行诗作的名称，后来演变为泛指小册子或传单，常用于宣传或信息分发。
example: The health center gives out a free pamphlet about flu prevention.
健康中心免费发放一本关于预防流感的小册子。

leftover.def_en: a wide view of a large area of land a complete picture or description of all parts of a subject or event
leftover.mnemonic: 来自希腊语 pan 全部和 horama 景象，合起来表示全景视图，常用于摄影或 panorama apps 全景应用。
example: From the hilltop, we saw a beautiful panorama of the valley below.
从山顶上，我们看到了下方山谷的美丽全景。

kaoyan_ex.text: Dickens crafted complex plots and striking characters that capture the panorama of English society.

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“全景”；常见搭配 of

leftover.def_en: underwear worn on the lower body clothing that covers both legs separately something that is very bad or worthless
leftover.mnemonic: pants 缩写自 pantaloons，源于意大利喜剧角色 Pantalone，现指裤子，是日常穿着的基本服装。
example: I need to buy new pants because my old ones are worn out.
我需要买条新裤子，因为我的旧裤子穿破了。

leftover.def_en: a book with a soft paper cover
leftover.mnemonic: paperback 由 paper 纸和 back 背面组合而成，表示平装书的软封面形式，与精装书相对。
example: I prefer buying paperback books because they are lighter and cheaper than hardcover ones.
我更喜欢买平装书，因为它们比精装书更轻更便宜。

leftover.def_en: A cloth device that lets people or objects fall slowly and safely from the air. To jump from an aircraft using a parachute. To drop someone or something from an aircraft using a parachute. To bring someone into a job from outside the group.
leftover.mnemonic: parachute 借自法语，para- 意为防止，chute 意为掉落，整体设计用于减缓坠落，发明于 18 世纪并广泛应用于航空安全。
example: The soldier used a parachute to land safely from the plane.
士兵使用降落伞从飞机上安全着陆。

leftover.def_en: Something that has two opposite qualities and seems strange A statement with two opposite ideas that seems impossible but may be true
leftover.mnemonic: 词根来自希腊语 paradoxon，para- 意为旁边或超越，doxa 是意见，合指看似矛盾但真实的陈述，在逻辑学中常见。
example: The paradox is that the quietest person in the room often has the most interesting thoughts.
矛盾的是，房间里最安静的人往往拥有最有趣的想法。

kaoyan_ex.text: Indeed, in “An International Perspective on New Zealand’s Productivity Paradox” (2014), the Productivity Commission singled…

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“悖论”

leftover.def_en: The loss of ability to move or feel in a body part, usually from nerve damage. A state where something cannot move, work, or function normally.
leftover.mnemonic: paralysis 源于希腊语 paralysis，其中 para-（旁）和 lysis（松开）指身体功能丧失或瘫痪状态。
example: The accident caused paralysis in his legs, making him unable to walk.
事故导致他双腿瘫痪，无法行走。

leftover.def_en: to make someone unable to move or feel part of their body to stop something from working normally
leftover.mnemonic: 源于希腊语 paralysis，para- 表示 旁侧，lysis 表示 松开，paralyze 指使瘫痪，引申为麻痹行动。
example: The accident may paralyze his legs permanently.
这场事故可能会永久瘫痪他的双腿。

leftover.def_en: a rule or limit that controls how something is done
leftover.mnemonic: parameter 源自希腊语 para 和 metron，para 表示旁侧，metron 指测量，合起来意为设定的界限，在数学和编程中用作参数。
example: The team must follow the parameter set by management for this project.
团队必须遵循管理层为这个项目设定的参数。

leftover.def_en: A craft where small pieces of fabric are sewn together to make a design. A complex thing made of many different parts or elements.
leftover.mnemonic: patchwork 由 patch 补丁和 work 工作组合而成，指用碎布片缝合的手工艺品，常用于描述拼布艺术或比喻零散的事物。
example: She made a beautiful patchwork quilt for the bed.
她为床做了一床漂亮的拼布被子。

leftover.def_en: Able to be patented; meeting the legal requirements for a patent. Suitable or eligible for patent protection.
example: The invention must be novel and non-obvious to be considered patentable.
该发明必须具有新颖性和非显而易见性，才能被视为可专利。

leftover.def_en: relating to a father or his qualities related to your father's side of the family
leftover.mnemonic: 源于拉丁语 pater 父亲，后缀 -al 形成形容词，指父亲的或父系的，与 maternal 母亲的相对。
example: He showed a paternal concern for the younger workers.
他对年轻员工表现出父亲般的关怀。

kaoyan_ex.text: His paternal grandparents, a steward and a housekeeper possessed even less status, having been servants, and Dickens later…

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作adj.；意为“父亲的”

leftover.def_en: The state of being a father, especially to a specific child.
leftover.mnemonic: paternity 源自拉丁语 pater 父亲加后缀 -ity，指父亲身份或亲子关系，常用于法律或生物学。
example: The court confirmed his paternity after the DNA test.
DNA检测后，法院确认了他的父亲身份。

leftover.def_en: showing strong love and support for your country
leftover.mnemonic: patriotic 来源于希腊语 patriotes（同胞），词根 patri（父亲、祖国）和 otic（形容词后缀），表示热爱祖国的情感，与国家自豪感紧密联系。
example: Many people feel patriotic when they see their country's flag flying.
许多人看到自己国家的国旗飘扬时会感到爱国之情。

leftover.def_en: A farmer who works on a small piece of land, often in poor areas or in the past A rude or uneducated person
leftover.mnemonic: 来自古法语 paysant 指农民，常描述传统农业劳动者
example: The peasant worked hard in the fields to grow food for his family
这位农民在田里辛勤劳作，为家人种植粮食。

leftover.def_en: a small, smooth, round stone often found near water
leftover.mnemonic: 词源可追溯到古英语，指小而光滑的石头，常见于河滩或装饰用途。
example: I picked up a smooth pebble from the riverbank.
我从河岸捡起一块光滑的鹅卵石。

leftover.def_en: to remove the outer skin from fruits or vegetables to remove a covering from a surface or to come off a surface to come off in small pieces to lose small pieces of skin or covering the outer skin of fruits or vegetables the skin removed from fruits or vegetables
leftover.mnemonic: peel 意为剥皮，词源可追溯到拉丁语 pilare，与去除外层或果皮的动作联系。
example: Remember to peel the apples before you eat them.
吃苹果之前记得削皮。

leftover.def_en: a person who is similar to you in age or social group a noble person in the UK, often in the House of Lords to look at something carefully, especially when it is hard to see
leftover.mnemonic: peer 来自古法语 per，意为平等的人，演变出同龄人或贵族成员的含义，强调社会地位对等。
example: My peer at school helps me with homework.
我的同学帮我做家庭作业。

kaoyan_ex.text: The peer-reviewed results showed that the target group of pupils drew on a wider vocabulary, used words “classed as more…

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“同龄人”；后接 that 从句

leftover.def_en: a weight on a rod that swings back and forth, often used in clocks
leftover.mnemonic: pendulum 源于拉丁语 pendulus（悬挂的），来自 pendere（悬挂），描述钟摆等悬挂物体的摆动运动。
example: The pendulum in the old clock swings from side to side to keep time.
旧钟里的钟摆左右摆动以保持时间。

leftover.def_en: A small British coin. 100 pennies make one pound. An old British coin used before 1971. 12 pennies made one shilling. Another word for a cent, the smallest US coin.
leftover.mnemonic: 来自古英语 penig，指小硬币，作为英国货币单位 penny 便士，常用于日常交易中。
example: I found a shiny penny on the street.
我在街上发现了一枚闪亮的便士。

kaoyan_ex.text: Most of the money would come from a penny-perletter permanent rate increase and from shifting postal retirees into Medicare.

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“便士”；常见搭配 from

leftover.def_en: relating to a word or phrase that performs the action it describes, such as 'I promise' or 'I apologize'
leftover.mnemonic: performative 从 perform 表演派生而来，加上后缀 -ative，在语言学中特指言语本身即构成行为的表达方式。
example: The use of performative language in the ceremony made the event feel more meaningful.
在仪式中使用表演性语言让活动显得更有意义。

leftover.def_en: causing serious harm in a way that is not immediately obvious
leftover.mnemonic: pernicious 源自拉丁语 perniciosus，per 意为彻底，nic 与死亡相关，形容极具破坏性或致命的事物。
example: The pernicious effects of pollution on the environment are becoming more evident every day.
污染对环境的恶劣影响日益明显。

kaoyan_ex.text: …likely than those who eat less to suffer late in life from pernicious anaemia.

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作adj.；意为“有害的”

leftover.def_en: to keep trying even when it's hard
leftover.mnemonic: persevere 词根为拉丁语 per-（通过）和 severus（严格），强调在困难中坚持到底的精神。
example: She had to persevere through many challenges to finish her project.
她必须坚持克服许多挑战才能完成她的项目。

leftover.def_en: a thick, dark liquid found underground that is used to make fuel and other products
leftover.mnemonic: petroleum 源于拉丁语 petra（岩石）和 oleum（油），指从地下岩石中提取的天然油类，是现代能源工业的核心资源。
example: Many countries depend on petroleum to power their cars and factories.
许多国家依赖石油为汽车和工厂提供动力。

leftover.def_en: The highest ruler in ancient Egypt, like a king or queen.
leftover.mnemonic: pharaoh 源自古埃及语，意为大房子，最初指法老的宫殿，后来演变为统治者的称号。
example: The pharaoh was a powerful and respected leader in ancient Egypt.
法老是古埃及一位强大而受人尊敬的领袖。

leftover.def_en: The industry that makes and sells medicines.
leftover.mnemonic: pharma 是 pharmaceutical（制药的）的缩写，特指制药行业，在医药领域广泛使用，如 Big Pharma 指大型制药公司。
example: The new law is expected to benefit the pharma industry, but critics worry about the cost for patients.
新法律预计将使制药行业受益，但批评者担心患者的成本。

kaoyan_ex.text: If software promises to save lives on the scale that drugs now can, big data may be expected to behave as a big pharma has done.

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“制药业”

leftover.def_en: relating to or denoting orchestras or musical institutions
leftover.mnemonic: philharmonic 结合希腊词根 philo-（爱）和 harmonic（和谐），指爱好音乐的，尤其关联到 Philharmonic Orchestra 如维也纳爱乐乐团。
example: The Berlin Philharmonic is one of the most famous orchestras in the world.
柏林爱乐乐团是世界上最著名的管弦乐团之一。

leftover.def_en: related to the study of ideas about life and knowledge calm and accepting when facing problems or disappointment
leftover.mnemonic: 基于 philosophy，来自希腊语 philosophia，philo- 表示爱，sophia 表示智慧，意为热爱智慧的。
example: We had a philosophical discussion about the meaning of life.
我们进行了一场关于人生意义的哲学讨论。

leftover.def_en: relating to photos or photography
leftover.mnemonic: photographic 源于 photograph（照片），词根 photo-（光）和 graph（写）组成，后缀 -ic 构成形容词，形容逼真如照片的记忆或技术。
example: Her photographic memory helped her remember every detail of the event.
她的照相式记忆帮助她记住了事件的每一个细节。

kaoyan_ex.text: Even Mark Twain, a man who enjoyed a hearty laugh, said that when it came to photographic portraits there could be “nothing…

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作adj.；意为“摄影的”

leftover.def_en: The overall body shape and size of a person.
leftover.mnemonic: physique 借自法语，词源可追溯到希腊语 physikos 意为自然的，专指人的体格或体魄，常与健身和健康相关。
example: The personal trainer was impressed by the athlete's strong physique.
私人教练对这位运动员强健的体魄印象深刻。

leftover.def_en: a common bird with a plump body, often gray and white, found in cities and countryside
leftover.mnemonic: pigeon 源自拉丁语 pipio，原指小雏鸟，后来演变为指代鸽子，这种鸟常被用于信使或和平象征。
example: The pigeon perched on the windowsill, looking for food.
鸽子栖息在窗台上寻找食物。

leftover.def_en: a person who travels to a holy place for their religion one of the English people who sailed to America on the Mayflower in 1620 and started a colony
leftover.mnemonic: pilgrim 源自拉丁语 peregrinus 旅行者，特指前往圣地的朝圣者，常与宗教或历史旅程相关。
example: The pilgrim walked for days to reach the holy temple.
朝圣者走了好几天才到达圣殿。

kaoyan_ex.text: …for safety reasons, such as merchants, travellers or pilgrims.

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“朝圣者”

leftover.def_en: A type of tree with needle-like leaves that stays green all year The light-colored wood from pine trees, often used for furniture To feel very sad and miss someone who is gone
leftover.mnemonic: 作为名词源于拉丁语 pinus（松树），作为动词来自古英语 pinian（渴望），表示强烈思念或向往。
example: We sat under a tall pine tree for shade
我们坐在一棵高大的松树下乘凉。

leftover.def_en: copying someone else's work and saying it is your own
leftover.mnemonic: plagiarism 来自拉丁语 plagium，原意是绑架或偷窃，现指学术或创作中的剽窃行为，强调原创性的重要性。
example: The student was punished for plagiarism after copying an essay from the internet.
该学生因从网上抄袭文章而被处罚抄袭。

leftover.def_en: a person who starts a legal case in court against someone else
leftover.mnemonic: plaintiff 源自古法语 plaintif，意为 '抱怨者'，源于拉丁语 plangere 打击或哀悼，指在法律诉讼中发起控诉的当事人。
example: The plaintiff claimed that the company broke their contract.
原告声称该公司违反了合同。

leftover.def_en: A word form meaning more than one. Describing a word form for more than one. Involving more than one.
leftover.mnemonic: plural 由词根 plur- 表示多个和后缀 -al 结合，形成形容词指代复数形式，区别于单数概念。
example: The plural of 'cat' is 'cats'.
'cat'的复数形式是'cats'。

leftover.def_en: a serious lung illness that makes it hard to breathe
leftover.mnemonic: pneumonia 源于希腊语词根 pneumo 表示呼吸，后缀 ia 指疾病状态，因此描述肺部炎症的疾病。
example: The doctor said he has pneumonia and needs to rest.
医生说他得了肺炎，需要休息。

leftover.def_en: A substance used to make surfaces smooth and shiny The act of making something smooth and shiny The shiny look of something after polishing High quality performance done with great skill Good manners and polite behavior To make something smooth and shiny by rubbing To improve something by making small changes
leftover.mnemonic: polish 来自拉丁语 'polire'，意为磨光或使光滑，不同于国家名称 Poland。
example: Use this polish to make your shoes shine.
用这种鞋油让你的鞋子闪闪发亮。

kaoyan_ex.text: A Polish digital artist who uses classical painting styles to create dreamy fantasy landscapes, Greg Rutkowski has made…

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“抛光剂”

leftover.def_en: a small body of still water, often made by people the Atlantic Ocean
leftover.mnemonic: pond 一词可能源自拉丁语 pondus（重量），但演变为指小型静水水体，常用于描述人工或天然池塘。
example: The children like to feed the ducks at the pond in the park.
孩子们喜欢在公园的池塘边喂鸭子。

leftover.def_en: A hard, white, shiny material made from baked clay, used to make cups, plates, and other items.
leftover.mnemonic: porcelain 源自意大利语 porcellana，原指贝壳，因其光滑表面与早期瓷器相似而得名，后来演变为专指瓷器，反映了东西方贸易中对这种精致工艺品的描述演变。
example: This beautiful porcelain vase was made in China over 200 years ago.
这个精美的瓷花瓶是200多年前在中国制造的。

leftover.def_en: A card with a picture on one side that you can write a message on and mail without an envelope.
leftover.mnemonic: post 来自邮政系统，card 表示卡片，组合为明信片，常用于旅游纪念。
example: I bought a postcard with a beautiful beach scene to send to my friend.
我买了一张印有美丽海滩风景的明信片，准备寄给我的朋友。

leftover.def_en: A type of fertilizer that contains potassium, which helps plants grow and is also used in making soap.
leftover.mnemonic: potash 源于 pot 锅和 ash 灰，因为历史上钾碱从草木灰中提取，现在作为肥料成分用于农业。
example: Farmers often use potash to increase crop yields and improve soil quality.
农民经常使用钾肥来提高作物产量和改善土壤质量。

leftover.def_en: a professional who works in a specific field, like a doctor or lawyer someone who regularly does an activity that needs skill
leftover.mnemonic: practitioner 来自 practice（实践）加上后缀 -er（表示执行者），词源可追溯到中世纪英语，指在专业领域如医疗或法律中实际操作的人。
example: The medical practitioner helped many patients each day.
这位医生每天帮助许多病人。

leftover.def_en: A large, flat area with few trees and lots of grass, found in North America.
leftover.mnemonic: prairie 借自法语 prairie，其词源可追溯到拉丁语 pratum (草地)，描述北美广阔平坦的草原地貌。
example: The bison roamed across the vast prairie, a symbol of the wild west.
野牛在广阔的草原上漫步，象征着狂野的西部。

leftover.def_en: an introduction at the start of a book that explains the author's purpose to add an introduction to a book or writing to say something before speaking or answering
leftover.mnemonic: preface 源于拉丁语 praefatio，意为前言或引语，书籍开头部分常以此命名。
example: The author explains her goals in the preface to the book.
作者在书的序言中解释了她的目标。

leftover.def_en: relating to or situated in the front part of the brain, especially the frontal lobes located in front of the frontal bone or region a prefrontal bone or scale in anatomy or zoology
example: The prefrontal cortex is involved in complex cognitive behavior and decision-making.
前额叶皮层参与复杂的认知行为和决策。

leftover.def_en: having a baby growing inside the body full of meaning or emotion
leftover.mnemonic: pregnant 源自拉丁语 praegnans，由 prae- 表示前和 gnasci 表示出生演变，描述怀孕的阶段
example: She is pregnant with her first child.
她怀了第一个孩子。

leftover.def_en: thinking or worrying so much about something that you don't notice other things
leftover.mnemonic: preoccupied 词根 pre- 表示提前，occupare 意为占据，演变后描述心思被某事占用的状态。
example: She was so preoccupied with her phone that she didn't hear me calling her name.
她太专注于手机，以至于没听到我叫她的名字。

kaoyan_ex.text: …the image that makes us re-evaluate the past, I’ve become preoccupied with looking for photographs that show our Victorian ancestors smiling (what…

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作adj.；意为“全神贯注”；后接 that 从句；常见搭配 for；以 -ed 形式出现

leftover.def_en: A piece of paper with information that has been printed from a computer.
leftover.mnemonic: 复合词 print 打印加 out 出，指从计算机或打印机输出的纸质文档，是数字时代的常见产物。
example: She handed me a printout of the meeting agenda.
她递给我一份会议议程的打印件。

leftover.def_en: to say something important in a public and official way to show something clearly
leftover.mnemonic: pro- 向前和 claim 声明结合，proclaim 指公开宣布或宣告，类似于官方声明的形式，词源强调向外传播信息。
example: The leader will proclaim the new law to everyone tomorrow.
领导人明天将向所有人宣布新法律。

leftover.def_en: to make something last longer
leftover.mnemonic: prolong 由 pro- 前缀表示向前和 long 词根表示长组成，意思是延长或拖延时间。
example: The medicine helped prolong the patient's life.
这种药有助于延长病人的生命。

kaoyan_ex.text: A federal appeals court weighed in again Tuesday, but instead of providing a badly needed resolution, it only prolonged the fight.

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作v.；意为“延长”；以 -ed 形式出现

leftover.def_en: A word used instead of a noun to avoid repetition.
leftover.mnemonic: pronoun 来自拉丁语 pronomen，pro- 表示代替，nomen 是名字，因此在语法中代替名词的词，如 I 或 they 避免重复。
example: In the sentence 'She likes apples', 'she' is a pronoun that replaces a person's name.
在句子“She likes apples”中，“she”是一个代词，用来代替人名。

leftover.def_en: information that is often biased or misleading, used to promote a particular political cause or point of view
leftover.mnemonic: 源自拉丁语 propagare，意思是传播，最初用于宗教宣传，现演变为指有偏见的信息推广。
example: The government used propaganda to influence public opinion during the war.
战争期间，政府利用宣传来影响公众舆论。

leftover.def_en: A person sent by God to teach people and share God's messages. Muhammad, who received the Koran and completed the Islamic faith. A person who says they know what will happen in the future. A person who teaches or supports a new idea or belief. The name for some books in the Old Testament and Hebrew Bible.
leftover.mnemonic: prophet 源于希腊语 prophetes，pro 前 phetes 说话者，合指预言未来的人，在宗教中常见。
example: The prophet warned the people to follow God's ways.
先知警告人们要遵循上帝的道路。

kaoyan_ex.text: …images,” says Heather Hansen, journalist and author of Prophets and Moguls, Rangers and Rogues, Bison and Bears: 100 Years of the National Park…

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“先知”

leftover.def_en: A natural substance in all living things that helps build and repair the body. It is important for growth and health.
leftover.mnemonic: protein 源于希腊语 proteios，意为首要的，由化学家命名，在生物学中表示蛋白质这一基本营养元素。
example: Eggs are a good source of protein that helps muscles grow strong.
鸡蛋是蛋白质的良好来源，有助于肌肉强壮生长。

leftover.def_en: the first model of something that is used as an example for making later versions
leftover.mnemonic: prototype 的前缀 proto- 表示原始，加上 type（类型），指最初的设计模型，在工程和科技领域广泛使用。
example: The team built a prototype of the new device to test how it works.
团队制作了新设备的原型来测试其工作原理。

leftover.def_en: A short, well-known saying that gives advice or shares a common truth.
leftover.mnemonic: proverb 源自拉丁语 pro（前面）和 verb（词），指代像谚语这样流传已久的智慧格言。
example: This proverb teaches us to be careful: 'Look before you leap.'
这句谚语教导我们要小心：'三思而后行。'

leftover.def_en: acting very shocked or offended by anything related to sex
leftover.mnemonic: 基于 prude，源自法语 prude 意为过分拘谨，后缀 -ery 表示行为或状态，描述虚伪的端庄。
example: Her prudery made it difficult to discuss more intimate topics openly.
她的拘谨使得公开讨论更私密的话题变得困难。

kaoyan_ex.text: …(what better way to shatter the image of 19thcentury prudery?).

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“假正经”

leftover.def_en: a person or company that makes books, magazines, or newspapers available to the public
leftover.mnemonic: publisher 从 publish 派生，publish 来自拉丁语 publicare，意思是使公开，因此 publisher 指出版者或发行者。
example: The publisher released the new book last week.
