出版商上周发行了这本新书。

kaoyan_ex.text: …operating with reduced credit terms from PRH, the only publisher in the UK to place any limitations on our ability to trade.

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“出版商”；常见搭配 in

leftover.def_en: a sweet food eaten after a meal a sweet baked food made with flour, fat, eggs, and often fruit or jam a baked food with soft pastry and meat inside a soft, cold sweet food that tastes like fruit or chocolate
leftover.mnemonic: 可能来自古法语 boudin，最初指香肠类食物，经过演变现在主要指英式甜点布丁。
example: We had chocolate pudding for dessert after dinner.
晚餐后我们吃了巧克力布丁作为甜点。

kaoyan_ex.text: …as acting like “children who pick the plums out of their pudding to eat them at once” rather than putting them aside to be eaten last.

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“布丁”；常接 to 不定式/介词 to；常见搭配 at；以 -ing 形式出现

leftover.def_en: a toy that looks like a person or animal and can be moved by strings or by putting your hand inside it a person or group that is controlled by someone else and does what they say
leftover.mnemonic: puppet 源自法语 poupette 表示小玩偶，现在指被人操控的木偶或傀儡，常用于政治比喻。
example: The child played with a string puppet that danced when she pulled the strings
孩子玩着一个线偶，她一拉线，木偶就跳起舞来。

leftover.def_en: to measure or count something as a number
leftover.mnemonic: 词根 quant- 源于拉丁语 quantus 表示多少，后缀 -ify 意为使成为，指测量或表达数量
example: Scientists try to quantify how much pollution affects our health.
科学家试图量化污染对我们健康的影响程度。

leftover.def_en: A unit for measuring liquid. In the UK and Canada, it is about 1.14 liters. In the US, it is about 0.95 liters.
leftover.mnemonic: 源自拉丁语 quarta（第四），因为一加仑等于四夸脱，这个单位用于测量液体体积，如 a quart of milk（一夸脱牛奶）。
example: The recipe calls for one quart of milk.
食谱需要一夸脱牛奶。

leftover.def_en: a question asking for information a question mark showing something is not decided to question if something is correct to ask someone a question
leftover.mnemonic: query 源自拉丁语 quaerere 询问，表示提出问题或查询信息的行为，在数据库和日常对话中常见
example: Please send your query to our support team for help.
请将您的疑问发送给我们的支持团队以获取帮助。

leftover.def_en: a long search for something important to search for something hard to find
leftover.mnemonic: quest 来自拉丁语 quaerere 意为寻求，通过古法语演变，指探索或冒险任务，如游戏中的 quest 系统。
example: She began her quest to find true happiness.
她开始了寻找真正幸福的旅程。

kaoyan_ex.text: …Pedro Domingos, author of The Master Algorithm: How the Quest for the Ultimate Learning Machine Will Remake Our World and a computer science…

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“追寻”；常见搭配 for

leftover.def_en: words taken from a book, speech, or other source and repeated the act of repeating words from another source a price given for a job or service the current price of stocks or goods
leftover.mnemonic: quotation 来自动词 quote，拉丁语 quotare 意为标记引用，现指引用的文字或商业报价。
example: The author used a quotation from Shakespeare to start the chapter.
作者引用莎士比亚的一句话作为章节的开头。

leftover.def_en: A system that uses radio waves to detect and locate objects like planes and ships.
leftover.mnemonic: radar 是 Radio Detection And Ranging 的缩写，用于无线电探测和测距技术。
example: The radar detected the approaching storm.
雷达探测到正在逼近的暴风雨。

kaoyan_ex.text: Battles increasingly depended on new military technologies such as radar and the proximity fuze.

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“雷达”

leftover.def_en: giving off dangerous energy from breaking atoms
leftover.mnemonic: radio- 词根源于辐射，active 表示活跃的，组合形容物质具有放射性，涉及核物理领域。
example: The material is radioactive and can harm people if not handled carefully.
这种材料具有放射性，如果处理不当会伤害人。

leftover.def_en: A straight line from the center of a circle to its edge, or how long that line is. A round area around a center point, measured by distance from that point. The shorter bone in your lower arm, on the thumb side.
leftover.mnemonic: 拉丁语原意为射线，几何学中指从圆心到圆周的距离，也用于描述范围或影响区域。
example: The radius of the circle is 3 inches.
这个圆的半径是3英寸。

leftover.def_en: a tool for shaving hair off the skin
leftover.mnemonic: razor 源于古法语 rasor，词根来自拉丁语 radere 刮削，指剃须刀，联系到安全 razor 的日常使用。
example: He uses a sharp razor to shave his face every morning.
他每天早上用锋利的剃须刀刮脸。

leftover.def_en: Easy to read, with clear and interesting content. Clear enough to be read and understood.
leftover.mnemonic: readable 由 read 加后缀 -able 构成，-able 表示能力，描述文本或内容易于阅读和理解。
example: The book was written in a style that made it very readable for beginners.
这本书的写作风格使其对初学者来说非常易读。

leftover.def_en: given or done in return, or shared equally between two people or groups
leftover.mnemonic: Reciprocal 来自拉丁语 reciprocus，re- 回，pro- 向前，表示相互的或对等关系如数学中的倒数。
example: Their friendship is based on reciprocal respect and support.
他们的友谊建立在相互尊重和支持的基础上。

leftover.def_en: a four-sided flat shape with opposite sides equal and all angles 90 degrees
leftover.mnemonic: rectangle 由 rect-（直的，来自拉丁语 rectus）和 angle（角）组合，描述有四个直角的几何形状。
example: The table is a perfect rectangle with two long sides and two short sides.
这张桌子是一个完美的长方形，有两条长边和两条短边。

kaoyan_ex.text: …other items as well as a few dozen “nature carpets”—large rectangles decorated with foam pumpkins, cabbages, and watermelons.

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“矩形”；常见搭配 with

leftover.def_en: to happen again or many times
leftover.mnemonic: 源于拉丁语 recurrere，其中 re- 表示回，cur 源于 currere 意为跑动，组合起来表示再次发生或重现
example: The same problem may recur if we don't fix it properly.
如果我们不妥善解决，同样的问题可能会再次出现。

leftover.def_en: To come across something again that you had forgotten or lost.
leftover.mnemonic: 前缀 re- 表示再次，加上 discover 意为发现，整个词指重新找到或意识到某物，在科学探索中常见。
example: She rediscovered her love for painting when she visited the art gallery.
当她参观美术馆时，她重新发现了对绘画的热爱。

leftover.def_en: The idea that complex things can be understood by breaking them down into simpler parts.
leftover.mnemonic: reductionism 拆解为前缀 re- 表示回，词根 ducere 表示引导，后缀 -ism 指主义，整体指一种将复杂现象简化到基本元素的哲学方法。
example: Critics of reductionism argue that it oversimplifies the complexity of human behavior.
还原论的批评者认为，它过度简化了人类行为的复杂性。

kaoyan_ex.text: Scientific method, reductionism and the questioning of Church ideals was to be encouraged, as were ideas of liberty, tolerance…

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“还原论”；常见搭配 of

leftover.def_en: A quick, automatic action your body does in response to something, without you having to think about it.
leftover.mnemonic: reflex 来自拉丁语 reflectere，原义是反射，在生物学中指无意识的自动反应，如膝跳反射。
example: When the bright light flashed, her reflex made her blink immediately.
当强光闪过时，她的反射使她立刻眨眼。

kaoyan_ex.text: Their reactions may be a complex combination of instant reflexes, input from past driving experiences, and what their eyes and…

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“反射动作”；常见搭配 from

leftover.def_en: A machine that keeps food cold to prevent spoiling.
leftover.mnemonic: refrigerator 来自拉丁语 refrigerare，由 re-（再）和 frigerare（冷却）组成，是现代家用冰箱的英文名称，用于食物保鲜。
example: Put the milk back in the refrigerator to keep it fresh.
把牛奶放回冰箱以保持新鲜。

leftover.def_en: Money given back to you when you return something or pay too much. To give money back to someone, especially when they return something or are not satisfied.
leftover.mnemonic: refund 词根 re 表示回 fund 指资金 来自拉丁语 refundere 意为返还 引申为退款 在商业交易中常见
example: If you are not happy with the product, you can ask for a refund.
如果你对产品不满意，可以要求退款。

leftover.def_en: without considering or being affected by something
leftover.mnemonic: regardless of 结合 regard（源自古法语 regarder，re- 回加 garder 看护）和 -less（无），表示不顾或忽略某事物，强调无条件性。
example: The company provides equal opportunities to all employees regardless of their background or experience.
公司为所有员工提供平等机会，无论其背景或经验如何。

leftover.def_en: causing something to grow or improve again
leftover.mnemonic: 前缀 re- 表示再，generate 来自拉丁语 generare（生成），-ive 是形容词后缀，指能再生的或恢复的，在生物学中常见。
example: The new treatment has regenerative properties that help heal damaged tissues.
这种新疗法具有再生特性，有助于修复受损组织。

leftover.def_en: Einstein's theory that motion and time are relative to the observer the quality of being understood only in comparison to something else
leftover.mnemonic: 从 relative 相对的派生，后缀 -ity 表示概念，指相对性理论，这个词与 Einstein 爱因斯坦的物理学革命紧密联系。
example: Einstein's theory of relativity changed how we understand space and time.
爱因斯坦的相对论改变了我们对空间和时间的理解。

leftover.def_en: not stopping or slowing down, continuing without change not feeling or showing regret for something bad you have done
leftover.mnemonic: remorseless 由 remorse 加上后缀 -less 构成，remorse 本身来自拉丁语 remorsus，意思是咬噬，比喻内心不安，因此 remorseless 表示毫无悔意的冷酷。
example: The remorseless heat of the summer made it difficult to breathe.
夏天无情的酷热让人呼吸困难。

leftover.def_en: in a way that is fair and legal
leftover.mnemonic: rightfully 由 right 加上后缀 -ful 和 -ly 构成，right 本身源于古英语 riht 表示正确，整个词意思正当地或依法应得。
example: She rightfully demanded her inheritance, as she was the eldest child.
她理所当然地要求继承遗产，因为她是长女。

leftover.def_en: being very careful and paying close attention to details being strict or harsh the hard and difficult parts of something
leftover.mnemonic: rigor 源于拉丁语 rigor 意为严格或僵硬 描述学术或规则上的严谨性
example: Scientific rigor requires checking every detail carefully.
科学严谨性要求仔细检查每一个细节。

leftover.def_en: a circular road junction where traffic moves around a center island a spinning playground ride that children sit on a spinning amusement ride with seats for children not direct or straightforward
leftover.mnemonic: roundabout 由 round 和 about 组合而成，形容一种绕圈或间接的路径，例如交通中的环岛设计。
example: Always yield to traffic already in the roundabout before entering.
进入环岛前，务必让行已在环岛内的车辆。

leftover.def_en: a thick piece of fabric used to cover or decorate a floor a thick, warm blanket used to wrap around your legs for warmth a small piece of artificial hair worn to cover a bald spot
leftover.mnemonic: rug 源自古斯堪的纳维亚语 rogg，指粗糙的地毯或覆盖物，用于家庭装饰如小地毯。
example: The soft rug kept my feet warm on the cold floor.
柔软的地毯在冰冷的地板上让我的脚保持温暖。

kaoyan_ex.text: …and Secretary’s office decorated with carved wood, Oriental rugs, and stenciled wall patterns.

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“地毯”

leftover.def_en: a story or piece of information that people talk about but may not be true to be said or reported as a rumor, possibly not true
leftover.mnemonic: rumor 源自拉丁语 'rumor'，指未经证实的消息或传闻，易在社交中传播。
example: There's a rumor going around that the company is closing down.
有传言说这家公司要倒闭了。

leftover.def_en: Giving up something important to get something more important. Offering something to a god, often by killing an animal. To give up something important for something more important. To kill an animal or person as an offering to a god.
leftover.mnemonic: sacrifice 词根来自拉丁语 sacer 表示神圣，facere 表示做，合起来原意为使某物神圣化，后演变为为理想或他人放弃珍贵事物的行为。
example: Parents often make sacrifices for their children's future.
父母常常为孩子的未来做出牺牲。

leftover.def_en: A place where items are sold, especially in a store or at an auction.
example: The salesroom was bustling with customers looking for bargains.
销售厅里挤满了寻找便宜货的顾客。

leftover.def_en: using words that mean the opposite of what you really feel, especially to hurt someone's feelings or show anger
leftover.mnemonic: sarcastic 源于希腊语 sarkazein，意为撕咬或讥讽，形容言语尖刻带讽刺意味，常用来表达挖苦的幽默。
example: He made a sarcastic comment about my cooking, saying it was 'the best meal he'd ever had' with a fake smile.
他对我的厨艺发表了讽刺的评论，假笑着说我做的饭是“他吃过的最好的一顿”。

leftover.def_en: A machine sent into space to orbit Earth or another planet, used for communication, TV, and collecting data. A natural object in space that moves around a larger object, like a planet. A place or group controlled by a larger, more powerful one.
leftover.mnemonic: satellite 来自拉丁语 'satelles'（随从），现代用于卫星，如通信 satellite 支持全球网络。
example: Weather forecasts use data from a satellite to predict storms.
天气预报利用卫星数据来预测风暴。

kaoyan_ex.text: Ferraro analyzed satellite data showing annual forest loss from 2008 to 2012— including during Indonesia’s phase-in of the…

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“人造卫星”；常见搭配 from

leftover.def_en: a small, round, flat dish that holds a cup
leftover.mnemonic: 词根 sauce 指酱汁，saucer 原指盛酱的小碟子，后扩展为任何小型碟状物。
example: The tea cup sits on a small saucer to catch spills.
茶杯放在小碟子上，以防溢出。

leftover.def_en: The natural beauty of an area, like mountains, rivers, and forests. The painted background on a theater stage that shows places or buildings.
leftover.mnemonic: 从 scene 演变而来，后缀 -ry 表示整体集合，因此 scenery 指一片风景或舞台布景，强调视觉上的自然或艺术环境。
example: We stopped to enjoy the beautiful mountain scenery.
我们停下来欣赏美丽的山景。

leftover.def_en: a tool with two sharp blades and handles, used for cutting things like paper or cloth
leftover.mnemonic: scissors 来自拉丁语 cisoria 切割工具，由于双刀片设计，总是以复数形式出现，用于裁剪材料。
example: I used scissors to cut the paper into small pieces.
我用剪刀把纸剪成小块。

leftover.def_en: to speak angrily to someone, especially a child, for doing something wrong
leftover.mnemonic: scold 源于古英语，最初可能关联古挪威语 skald 意为诗人，但演变为严厉责备或批评的行为。
example: The mother had to scold her son for not doing his homework.
母亲不得不责骂儿子没有做作业。

leftover.def_en: Encouraging people to go against their government, usually by using words or actions.
leftover.mnemonic: 源于拉丁语 seditio，其中 se- 表示分开而 itio 指行走，整体描述煽动叛乱或颠覆政府的行为。
example: The group was accused of sedition for spreading false information about the government.
该团体因散布关于政府的虚假信息被指控煽动叛乱。

leftover.def_en: a young plant that grows from a seed
leftover.mnemonic: seedling 拆解为 seed（种子）和 -ling（小后缀），意为幼苗，指植物早期生长阶段的小型植株。
example: The gardener planted the seedling in rich soil to help it grow strong.
园丁把幼苗种在肥沃的土壤里，让它茁壮成长。

leftover.def_en: to separate people by race, religion, or gender and treat them differently to keep things or people apart from each other
leftover.mnemonic: 词根 se- 表示分离，greg- 来自拉丁语 grex 群体，加上动词后缀 -ate，意指将人群或事物隔离分开。
example: The law used to segregate people by skin color in public places.
这项法律过去在公共场所按肤色隔离人群。

leftover.def_en: not often; rarely
leftover.mnemonic: 源自古英语 seldan 意思是很少，表示不常发生
example: He seldom eats breakfast because he wakes up late.
他很少吃早餐，因为他起得晚。

kaoyan_ex.text: …information, given that those who produce these artifacts seldom make provision for their longterm preservation?

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作adv.；意为“很少”；常见搭配 for

再多缝一针，让接缝更牢固。

leftover.mnemonic: stockbroker 由 stock 股票和 broker 经纪人组成，broker 源于法语 broceur 指中介，表示在金融市场代理交易的人。
example: I talked to my stockbroker about investing some money in stocks.
我和我的股票经纪人谈过，想投资一些钱买股票。

kaoyan_ex.text: …from Lincolnshire have to subsidise the daily commute of a stockbroker from Surrey?

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“股票经纪人”；常见搭配 from

leftover.def_en: A long, thin piece of clothing that covers the leg and foot. A special sock that children hang for Santa to fill with gifts on Christmas Eve.
leftover.mnemonic: stocking 源自 stock 原指树干或存货，后缀 -ing 表示物品，因此是长筒袜，常与圣诞节挂袜传统关联。
example: She wore a black stocking under her dress.
她在裙子下穿了一条黑色长袜。

leftover.def_en: a big collection of something that is saved for later use to gather and save a large amount of something for future use
leftover.mnemonic: stockpile 由 stock（库存）和 pile（堆）构成，指大量积累的物资储备，常用于应急或战略目的。
example: The country has a large stockpile of medical supplies.
该国储备了大量医疗物资。

leftover.def_en: a seat without a back or arms solid waste from the body
leftover.mnemonic: stool 源自古英语 stōl，原义为凳子，后引申为医学中的粪便样本，体现了从家具到生理术语的含义演变。
example: He sat on a stool at the counter.
他坐在柜台前的凳子上。

leftover.def_en: in a way that is not normal or expected
leftover.mnemonic: strangely 是 strange 的副词形式，strange 源自拉丁语 extraneus（外来的），表示以陌生或奇特方式发生。
example: The cat behaved strangely, staring at the wall for hours without moving.
那只猫行为怪异，盯着墙几个小时一动不动。

leftover.def_en: a small, sweet red fruit with tiny seeds on the outside
leftover.mnemonic: strawberry 是组合词，straw 稻草指传统种植中用于铺垫的物料，berry 浆果描述其果实类型，反映农业实践。
example: I love eating fresh strawberry for dessert.
我喜欢吃新鲜草莓作为甜点。

leftover.def_en: to make something smooth so it moves easily through air or water to make a system work better and save money
leftover.mnemonic: Streamline 由 stream（溪流）和 line（线）组成，原意是使物体呈流线型以减少阻力，引申为简化流程或提高效率，如优化业务操作。
example: They streamlined the car's shape to make it go faster.
他们优化了汽车的形状，使其跑得更快。

leftover.def_en: very strict and must be followed having tough controls because of limited resources
leftover.mnemonic: stringent 源于拉丁语 stringere（拉紧），描述严格或苛刻的标准，如政策或规则，强调约束力。
example: The company has implemented stringent safety measures to protect its employees.
公司实施了严格的安全措施来保护员工。

kaoyan_ex.text: Stringent job dismissal regulations adversely affect productivity growth and hamper both prosperity and overall well-being.

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作adj.；意为“严格的”

leftover.def_en: A smaller title under a main title in a piece of writing, like in a book or an article.
leftover.mnemonic: subheading 由 sub- 表示次要或下，heading 指标题，组合起来用于文章中的副标题，帮助组织内容。
example: In the article, each subheading provided a clear overview of the section's main points.
在文章中，每个副标题都清晰概述了该部分的主要观点。

kaoyan_ex.text: subheading from the list A-G for each of the numbered paragraphs (41-45).

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“副标题”；常见搭配 for；以 -ing 形式出现

leftover.def_en: to take one number away from another number
leftover.mnemonic: subtract 的词根 sub- 意为下，tract 意为拉，源自拉丁语 subtractus，整体描述从总数中减去一部分的数学操作。
example: When you subtract 5 from 10, the answer is 5.
当你从10中减去5时，答案是5。

leftover.def_en: coming one right after another without a break
leftover.mnemonic: 词根 sub- 表示随后，cedere 是行走，组合意为连续发生的事件，强调顺序性。
example: The team won three successive games in a row.
该队连续赢得了三场比赛。

kaoyan_ex.text: Successive governments have permitted such increases on the grounds that the cost of investing in and running the rail network…

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作adj.；意为“连续的”；常见搭配 on

leftover.def_en: to pull liquid or air into your mouth using your lips to hold something in your mouth and pull on it with your lips and tongue to remove liquid or air from something to pull someone or something strongly in a certain direction to be very bad or unpleasant the action of sucking
leftover.mnemonic: 古英语 sūcan 演变，指用嘴吸入液体或空气的动作，如婴儿吸吮乳汁。
example: She used a straw to suck the juice from the cup.
她用吸管从杯子里吸果汁。

leftover.def_en: the act of intentionally ending one's own life an action that will likely ruin your career or social standing a person who ends their own life intentionally
leftover.mnemonic: suicide 源自拉丁语 sui 表示自己，加上 cidium 表示杀，组合起来指自我结束生命的行为，常用于心理学讨论预防措施。
example: The doctor discussed the warning signs of suicide with the patient.
医生与患者讨论了自杀的警示信号。

kaoyan_ex.text: Seymour made the change, went into his backyard, and expressed his displeasure by committing suicide.

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“自杀行为”

leftover.def_en: A yellow element that smells bad when burned and is used in medicine and industry.
leftover.mnemonic: sulfur 是硫元素的英文名称，源自拉丁语 sulphur，可能与阿拉伯语相关，在化学中广泛使用。
example: The rotten eggs smell like sulfur because of the chemical reaction.
由于化学反应，臭鸡蛋闻起来像硫磺。

leftover.def_en: more than needed; not necessary
leftover.mnemonic: Superfluous 源于拉丁语 superfluus，super- 超过和 fluere 流动，形容多余或不必要的东西
example: The extra decorations were superfluous and made the room look cluttered.
多余的装饰是累赘，让房间看起来杂乱无章。

leftover.def_en: A person with extraordinary abilities or talents.
leftover.mnemonic: superman 源自德语 'Übermensch'（超人），最初由尼采提出，后来在流行文化中成为 DC 漫画的经典角色 Superman。
example: He can lift heavy weights with ease, making him seem like a real-life superman.
他能轻松举起重物，让他看起来像现实生活中的超人。

leftover.def_en: A person who is very famous and successful in their field, like acting, singing, or sports.
leftover.mnemonic: Superstar 是 super（超级）和 star（明星）的组合词，指极其著名的演艺或体育人物，在流行文化中如 Michael Jackson 被视为典型代表。
example: After winning the competition, she became a superstar overnight.
赢得比赛后，她一夜之间成了超级明星。

leftover.def_en: to watch and manage people or work to make sure it is done right and safe
leftover.mnemonic: 来自拉丁语 supervidere，super- 在上和 videre 看，意思是监督；管理场景中上级负责监视和指导工作流程
example: The manager will supervise the team to ensure the project is completed correctly.
经理将监督团队，确保项目正确完成。

kaoyan_ex.text: Designed by Supervising Architect of the Treasury, Alfred B.

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作v.；意为“监督”；常见搭配 of；以 -ing 形式出现

leftover.def_en: The family name shared by all members of a family, usually written last in English names.
leftover.mnemonic: sur- 上或额外和 name 名字结合，surname 指在名字之上的姓氏，源于中世纪欧洲家族标识的演变。
example: In many cultures, children inherit their father's surname as their family name.
在许多文化中，子女继承父亲的姓氏作为自己的姓氏。

leftover.def_en: staying alive when it is hard or dangerous something old that still exists today
leftover.mnemonic: survival 由前缀 sur-（意为超越）和词根 viv（意为生活）组成，指在逆境中持续存活的状态，演变自 survive。
example: Finding clean water is key to survival in the desert.
在沙漠中，找到干净的水是生存的关键。

kaoyan_ex.text: …years, which could help pay for new vehicles, among other survival measures.

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“生存”

leftover.def_en: a weapon with a long sharp blade and a handle
leftover.mnemonic: 来自古英语 sweord，指冷兵器剑，常象征战斗或权力。
example: The knight carried a sharp sword for battle.
骑士携带一把锋利的剑用于战斗。

kaoyan_ex.text: “It’s a double-edged sword because wildfires are getting more severe and larger under climate change and we need this work…

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“剑”

leftover.def_en: A group of signs and symptoms that occur together and indicate a specific disease or condition. A pattern of behavior or characteristics that are typical of a particular situation or group of people.
leftover.mnemonic: syndrome 源于希腊语 syndromē，syn- 表示一起，dromos 意为跑，指一系列症状同时出现的医学综合征。
example: Down syndrome is a genetic condition that causes developmental delays.
唐氏综合征是一种导致发育迟缓的遗传病。

leftover.def_en: A wind that comes from behind and helps push things forward.
leftover.mnemonic: tailwind 由 tail 和 wind 组成，字面意思是尾部风，在航空中指顺风，能加速航行。
example: The tailwind helped the kite soar higher in the sky.
顺风帮助风筝在天空中飞得更高。

leftover.def_en: A place that sells food to take and eat elsewhere Food bought from a takeaway place The main point or lesson learned from something
leftover.mnemonic: 由 take 和 away 组合而成，字面意思是带走，在英式英语中常指外卖食物，在讨论中也可表示关键要点。
example: We ordered pizza from the takeaway down the street.
我们从街那头的外卖店订了披萨。

leftover.def_en: a person who pays money to the government as tax
leftover.mnemonic: 这个组合词由 tax（税）和 payer（支付者）构成，指依法向政府缴纳税款的公民或企业。
example: Every taxpayer has the right to know how their money is being used by the government.
每个纳税人都有权知道政府如何使用他们的钱。

kaoyan_ex.text: …be borne by those who use it, rather than the general taxpayer.

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“纳税人”

leftover.def_en: working together well as a group
leftover.mnemonic: team 源于古英语，指一群动物或人，work 表示工作，组合起来强调团队协作的精神，在体育或职场中都很重要。
example: Good teamwork helps us finish projects faster and better.
良好的团队合作帮助我们更快更好地完成项目。

leftover.def_en: describing someone between 13 and 19 years old
leftover.mnemonic: teenage 由 teen（青少年）和 age（年龄）构成，形容十三到十九岁之间的青少年时期，体现人生发展阶段。
example: Many teenage students enjoy playing sports after school.
许多青少年学生喜欢放学后做运动。

leftover.def_en: A way to send messages over long distances using wires and electrical signals. To send a message using a telegraph. To show what you plan to do, often without meaning to.
leftover.mnemonic: telegraph 源于希腊语 tele 远和 graph 写，指电报这种远距离通信方式，是早期电信技术的代表。
example: The telegraph was used to send important news quickly across the country.
电报曾被用来在全国快速传递重要新闻。

leftover.def_en: A person who pays to use a room, building, or land owned by someone else. To live or work in a place by paying rent.
leftover.mnemonic: 来自拉丁语 tenere 持有，意为租户或住户，指持有房产使用权的人，与 landlord 相对。
example: The tenant pays rent to the landlord every month.
租户每月向房东支付租金。

leftover.def_en: The position in a sequence that is one less than eleventh. A part of something that is divided into ten equal parts.
leftover.mnemonic: tenth 是数字 ten 的序数形式，来自古英语 teoþa，表示第十或十分之一，用于序列或比例场景。
example: She came in tenth place in the race.
她在比赛中获得了第十名。

leftover.def_en: the act of taking something that does not belong to you without permission
leftover.mnemonic: theft 来自古英语 theofth，与 thief（贼）同源，指非法取走他人财物的行为。
example: The police are investigating the theft of valuable items from the museum.
警方正在调查博物馆贵重物品被盗案。

kaoyan_ex.text: But look at what happened to Boston’s Gardner Museum theft in 1990, including the loss of Rembrandt, Vermeer, Manet, and other…

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“盗窃”；常见搭配 of

leftover.def_en: A tool that keeps the temperature steady by turning heating or cooling systems on or off.
leftover.mnemonic: thermostat 由 thermo-（热）和 -stat（稳定器）组成，源于希腊语，指自动调节温度的设备保持环境恒定。
example: She adjusted the thermostat to make the room cooler.
她调节了恒温器，让房间更凉爽。

leftover.def_en: The state of being thin or having a small thickness. The lack of body fat or muscle. The condition of air having less oxygen than usual. A lack of substance or depth in something.
leftover.mnemonic: 从 thin（瘦的）加 -ness（名词后缀）派生，直接描述薄、细或稀薄的状态。
example: The thinness of the paper made it easy to fold.
纸张很薄，容易折叠。

leftover.def_en: The bottom part of a doorway that you step over to enter a room or building. The point where something starts to happen or change. The beginning of something new or important.
leftover.mnemonic: Threshold 的古英语形式是 þrescold，可能与 thresh（打谷）相关，因为房屋入口曾用于谷物处理，现在比喻起点或临界点。
example: She paused at the threshold before entering the room.
她在门槛处停顿了一下，然后走进了房间。

kaoyan_ex.text: …excluding employees earning above a specified “high-income threshold” from the protection of its unfair dismissal laws.

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“门槛”；常见搭配 from

leftover.def_en: saving money and spending it carefully a sea plant with pink flowers
leftover.mnemonic: 与 thrive（繁荣）同源，表示通过节约资源实现经济上的兴盛。
example: Her thrift helped her save enough money to buy a house.
她的节俭帮助她攒够了买房的钱。

leftover.def_en: a flat piece of material used to cover walls or floors a flat piece used to cover roofs a small flat piece used in board games to cover a surface with tiles to arrange windows on a screen without overlapping
leftover.mnemonic: tile 源自古英语 tigele，指用于覆盖屋顶或地面的瓦片，也延伸至类似形状的物件如 floor tiles。
example: We used ceramic tile for the kitchen floor.
我们厨房地板铺了瓷砖。

kaoyan_ex.text: …in Washington, with nearly 2 miles of black and white tiled corridors.

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“瓷砖”；以 -ed 形式出现

leftover.def_en: easily scared or shy, lacking courage
leftover.mnemonic: timid 词根可追溯到拉丁语 timidus，意思是胆怯或易受惊吓，常形容性格内向的人。
example: The timid child hid behind his mother when meeting new people.
那个胆小的孩子见到陌生人时躲在妈妈身后。

leftover.def_en: dried leaves from a plant used for smoking
leftover.mnemonic: tobacco 源自美洲原住民语言，经西班牙语传入英语，直接指代烟草植物，与历史贸易相关
example: The farmer grows tobacco for making cigarettes.
农民种植烟草用于制造香烟。

leftover.def_en: A young child who is just learning to walk.
leftover.mnemonic: 由 toddle 派生，toddle 表示蹒跚学步，toddler 专指一至三岁的幼儿，描述他们走路不稳的阶段。
example: The toddler wobbled as he took his first steps towards his mother.
蹒跚学步的孩子摇摇晃晃地迈出第一步，走向他的母亲。

kaoyan_ex.text: Sixty toddlers were each introduced to an adult tester holding a plastic container.

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“学步儿童”

leftover.def_en: a large stone structure where a dead person is buried
leftover.mnemonic: tomb 来自希腊语 tymbos，意为坟墓，通过拉丁语 tumba 演变，指埋葬死者的地方，与历史遗迹如金字塔相关联。
example: We visited the ancient tomb of a king from long ago.
我们参观了一位远古国王的古墓。

kaoyan_ex.text: The team identified some techniques buildings, courtyards, a network of streets, and two chamber tombs.

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“坟墓”

leftover.def_en: A small handheld light that runs on batteries. A tool that produces a hot flame for burning or melting things. A long stick with fire at one end, carried for light. To deliberately set fire to something.
leftover.mnemonic: torch 源于拉丁语 torquere 扭曲，可能因为古代火炬由扭曲的布或材料制成，现在指照明工具。
example: Use the torch to see in the dark.
在黑暗中使用手电筒照明。

leftover.def_en: the business of providing services for people traveling for pleasure
leftover.mnemonic: 基于 tour（旅行），源自法语 tourner 意为转动，加后缀 -ism 表示旅游活动。
example: Tourism brings many visitors to our city each year.
旅游业每年为我们的城市带来许多游客。

kaoyan_ex.text: “A lot of workers are servicing the tourist industry, and the tourism industry is serviced by those people coming in short…

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“旅游业”；常见搭配 by

leftover.def_en: The residents of a town or city.
leftover.mnemonic: Townspeople 指城镇居民，由 town 城镇和 people 人组合而成，直接表示居住在城市中的居民群体。
example: The townspeople gathered in the square for the annual festival.
镇民们聚集在广场上参加一年一度的节日。

leftover.def_en: A special name, sign, or design that a company owns and uses only for its products. A special way someone acts or looks that makes them easy to recognize. To officially register a name or design as a trademark.
leftover.mnemonic: trademark 拆分为 trade 和 mark，trade 指贸易，mark 是标记，合起来表示商业中用于标识商品的专用符号。
example: The golden arches are McDonald's famous trademark.
金色拱门是麦当劳著名的商标。

leftover.def_en: a very sad event, often involving death or great loss a type of serious play that ends sadly, often with the death of the main character
leftover.mnemonic: tragedy 来自希腊语 tragoidia，可能源于 tragos 山羊和 oide 歌，原指山羊歌仪式，现指悲惨事件或戏剧类型，如 Shakespearean tragedy 莎士比亚悲剧。
example: The earthquake was a terrible tragedy that affected many families.
这场地震是一场可怕的悲剧，影响了许多家庭。

kaoyan_ex.text: …the creation of new forms under the incentive of classical tragedy and comedy.

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“悲剧”

leftover.def_en: very sad, often because of death or suffering related to tragedy in stories or plays
leftover.mnemonic: tragic 源于希腊语 tragikos（山羊歌），原为戏剧类型，后演变为形容灾难性事件的悲惨性质。
example: The tragic accident left many families heartbroken.
这场悲惨的事故让许多家庭心碎。

kaoyan_ex.text: …have downed over the Mediterranean Sea, provides another tragic reminder of why.

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作adj.；意为“悲惨的”；常见搭配 of

leftover.def_en: A device that changes the voltage of electricity, so you can use different electronic devices.
leftover.mnemonic: 词根 trans 源于拉丁语 意为跨越 form 指形状 合起来表示改变形状的装置 在电气工程中 是变压器 在流行文化中 Transformer 是变形金刚系列的英文名
example: The transformer allowed the power to be used for the new machine.
变压器使电力能够用于新机器。

leftover.def_en: A small electronic part that controls electric current in devices like computers and radios. A small radio that uses transistors instead of tubes.
leftover.mnemonic: transistor 是 transfer 转移和 resistor 电阻的组合，指电子学中的晶体管元件。
example: The transistor in this radio helps control the flow of electricity to make sound.
这台收音机里的晶体管有助于控制电流以产生声音。

leftover.def_en: a wheeled cart for carrying items a wheeled table for serving food or drinks an electric passenger vehicle that runs on rails
leftover.mnemonic: trolley 可能源于 troll，意为滚动，表示带轮子的推车，常与超市 trolley 或电车关联，体现移动工具的含义。
example: I used a shopping trolley to carry my groceries.
我用购物手推车搬运我的杂货。

leftover.def_en: Someone who frequently causes problems or disturbances, often by stirring up disagreements or conflicts.
leftover.mnemonic: troublemaker 指惹事生非的人，trouble 表示麻烦，maker 是制造者，整体强调主动引发问题或冲突的行为。
example: The new kid in class turned out to be a troublemaker, always starting fights and disrupting the peace.
班上新来的那个孩子原来是个捣蛋鬼，总是打架闹事，破坏安宁。

leftover.def_en: The main stem of a tree. The storage space in the back of a car. An elephant's long nose. Men's swimwear. A large storage box. The main part of the body without the head and limbs.
leftover.mnemonic: trunk 源于拉丁语 truncus，意思是树干或躯干，在英语中扩展为大象鼻子、汽车后备箱或旅行箱，展现了多义性。
example: The tree trunk was thick and strong.
树干又粗又壮。

leftover.def_en: An underground passage for roads, trains, or people to go through hills or under rivers. An underground passage made by animals or natural forces. To dig an underground passage.
leftover.mnemonic: 意思是隧道，词源可能来自法语 tonnel 小桶，因为隧道形状类似圆桶，表示地下通道。
example: The train goes through a long tunnel under the mountain.
火车穿过山下的长隧道。

leftover.def_en: a machine that spins when liquid or gas flows through it, creating power
leftover.mnemonic: 源于拉丁语 'turbo'，意为旋转或陀螺，指利用流体动力旋转的机械装置。
example: The water turns the turbine to make electricity.
水流转动涡轮来发电。

leftover.def_en: to shine with a light that flickers or sparkles to show happiness or excitement in your eyes a happy or excited look in someone's eyes a small, flickering light
leftover.mnemonic: twinkle 可能源于中古英语 twinklen，描述光快速闪烁，如星星 twinkle 在夜空中，常用于诗歌或儿歌。
example: The stars twinkle brightly in the night sky.
星星在夜空中明亮地闪烁。

leftover.def_en: A machine with keys that prints letters on paper when pressed.
leftover.mnemonic: typewriter 由 type（打字）和 writer（书写者）组合，指机械打字设备，曾是办公革命的关键工具。
example: She used a typewriter to write her novel before computers were common.
在电脑普及之前，她用打字机写小说。

leftover.def_en: a very strong and dangerous storm that forms over warm ocean waters
leftover.mnemonic: typhoon 可能源于中文 台风 或阿拉伯语 tufan，指猛烈的热带风暴，常与亚洲地区的自然灾害关联。
example: The typhoon brought heavy rain and strong winds that damaged many buildings.
台风带来了暴雨和强风，损坏了许多建筑物。

leftover.def_en: in a way that is hard to understand or explain; for an unknown reason
leftover.mnemonic: unaccountably 指无法解释地，由 un- 否定前缀加 account 源于古法语 aconter 意为计算或说明，再加副词后缀 ably 构成。
example: She felt suddenly and unaccountably cheerful, even though she had just received bad news.
她突然莫名其妙地高兴起来，尽管她刚刚收到坏消息。

leftover.def_en: not knowing about something
leftover.mnemonic: Unaware 由前缀 un- 否定和 aware 组成，aware 源于古英语 gewær，意为谨慎的，整体表示不知情的状态。
example: He was unaware of the surprise party planned for him.
他不知道为他准备的惊喜派对。

leftover.def_en: to think something is smaller or less than it really is to not see how good, strong, or difficult someone or something really is a guess that is too low about size, cost, or amount
leftover.mnemonic: 由 under 表示低于，加上 estimate 估计，直接指低估某人的能力或事物的价值。
example: Don't underestimate how much time this project will take.
不要低估这个项目需要花费的时间。

kaoyan_ex.text: But she underestimates the educational value of zoos.

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作v.；意为“低估”；常见搭配 of

leftover.def_en: To do less well than expected or needed.
leftover.mnemonic: underperform 中 under- 前缀意为低于，加上 perform（表现），指在考试或工作中表现不佳，未达预期水平。
example: The company's profits have been underperforming for the past three quarters.
过去三个季度，公司利润一直表现不佳。

kaoyan_ex.text: …protection laws constrain business owners from dismissing underperforming managers, those laws act as a constraint on firm productivity and…

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作v.；意为“表现不佳”；常见搭配 as；以 -ing 形式出现

leftover.def_en: in a way that makes sense given the situation
leftover.mnemonic: 由 understand（理解）加副词后缀 -ably 构成，表示在情理之中或可被理解的方式。
example: She was understandably upset after hearing the bad news.
听到这个坏消息后，她感到难过，这是可以理解的。

leftover.def_en: Something that is not used as much as it should be.
leftover.mnemonic: 前缀 under- 不足 加上 used 使用 形容资源或能力未被充分利用的状态
example: The local swimming pool is underused, and it's a shame because it's a great facility.
当地的游泳池使用率不高，这很可惜，因为设施很棒。

kaoyan_ex.text: The TSA cannot continue diverting resources into underused PreCheck lanes while most of the traveling public suffers in…

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作adj.；意为“未充分利用”；常见搭配 of；以 -ed 形式出现

leftover.def_en: in a surprising way that you did not think would happen
leftover.mnemonic: unexpectedly 由 un-（不）、expected（预期的）和 -ly（副词后缀）组成，含义演变为意外发生的方式。
example: The weather changed unexpectedly, so we had to cancel our picnic.
天气突然变了，所以我们不得不取消野餐。

leftover.def_en: Not looked into or traveled through by people. Not thoroughly examined or discussed.
leftover.mnemonic: 前缀 un- 表示否定，explore 探索，因此 unexplored 指未被探索的区域，如地球上的未知地带或科学新领域。
example: The unexplored jungle held secrets that were yet to be discovered.
未经探索的丛林隐藏着尚未被发现的秘密。

kaoyan_ex.text: …and modern periods had been bridged, leading to new and unexplored intellectual territories.

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作adj.；意为“未探索”；以 -ed 形式出现

leftover.def_en: not expected or planned for
leftover.mnemonic: unforeseen 由前缀 un-（否定）和 foresee（预见）构成，指意外发生的或未能提前预料的事件。
example: The trip was canceled due to unforeseen weather problems.
由于不可预见的天气问题，旅行被取消了。

leftover.def_en: not feeling or showing appreciation for what someone has done for you
leftover.mnemonic: 前缀 un- 表否定，加上 grateful 感恩的，意为不知感激或忘恩负义。
example: It's ungrateful of you to ignore all the help your friends have given you.
你忽视朋友们给予的所有帮助，真是不知感恩。

leftover.def_en: not useful or willing to help
leftover.mnemonic: 前缀 un- 表不，词根 help 帮助，后缀 -ful 充满的，整体指无益或无效的行为
example: The unhelpful assistant gave wrong directions.
那个不帮忙的助手指错了方向。

kaoyan_ex.text: These tools can help you win every argument—not in the unhelpful sense of beating your opponents but in the better sense of…

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作adj.；意为“无益的”；常见搭配 of

leftover.def_en: to suddenly release a strong force, emotion, or effect
leftover.mnemonic: unleash 拆解为 un- 表示释放或解除，加上 leash 意为束缚，合起来指释放力量或潜能，常用于激发行动。
example: The new policy will unleash a wave of innovation across the industry.
新政策将在整个行业释放一波创新浪潮。

leftover.def_en: in a way that shows no kindness or pity; extremely severely or harshly to an extreme or excessive degree
example: The coach criticized the team unmercifully after their poor performance.
教练在球队表现不佳后毫不留情地批评了他们。

leftover.def_en: Something that is very clear and cannot be confused with anything else.
leftover.mnemonic: unmistakable 拆解为前缀 un- 表示不，词根 mistake 错误，和后缀 -able 表示能够，整体意为不会错的或清晰可辨的。
example: The smell of fresh baked cookies was unmistakable.
新鲜烤饼干的味道是 unmistakable。

leftover.def_en: in a way that is not based on reality or practicality
leftover.mnemonic: 前缀 un- 表示否定，词根 real 来自拉丁语 realis 指真实，加后缀构成副词，形容不切实际的想法或行为。
example: He set his goals unrealistically high, which led to disappointment.
他把目标定得过高，不切实际，最终导致了失望。

leftover.def_en: Not thinking deeply about something; not showing much thought. Not shiny or smooth; does not reflect light.
leftover.mnemonic: unreflecting 拆解为 un-（否定前缀）和 reflecting（思考），源自拉丁语 reflectere，意为未加思索的，类似于反射缺失的心理状态。
example: He made an unreflecting decision without considering the consequences.
他未经深思熟虑就做出了决定，没有考虑后果。

leftover.def_en: To remove someone from a position of power or authority. To cause someone to fall off a horse, bicycle, or similar vehicle.
leftover.mnemonic: un- 作为前缀表示移除或否定，seat 意为座位，组合后指使某人从职位上下来，常用于描述罢免或取代。
example: The new candidate aims to unseat the current mayor in the upcoming election.
这位新候选人旨在即将到来的选举中击败现任市长。

leftover.def_en: Something that is expected or happens as a natural result.
leftover.mnemonic: unsurprisingly 由前缀 un-（不）和 surprisingly（惊讶地）构成，表示预期之中或不令人意外的结果。
example: Unsurprisingly, the movie received positive reviews after the talented cast's performance.
毫不意外，在才华横溢的演员阵容表演后，这部电影获得了正面评价。

leftover.def_en: too shocking or impossible to imagine
leftover.mnemonic: unthinkable 拆解为前缀 un-（不）加 thinkable（可思考的），源自 think，含义演变为不可想象的或超出认知范围的事物。
example: The idea of failing the test was unthinkable to the hardworking student.
对于这个勤奋的学生来说，考试不及格的想法是不可想象的。

leftover.def_en: to a greater degree than is normal or expected in a way that is not typical or common
leftover.mnemonic: 前缀 un- 否定，词根 usual 通常的，后缀 -ly 副词化，表示不寻常地或异常地。
example: She was unusually quiet at the party.
她在聚会上异常安静。

leftover.def_en: new and modern having the newest information
leftover.mnemonic: up to date 字面意思是达到当前日期，引申为信息或事物保持最新状态，词源上 date 来自拉丁语 data 表示给定时间。
example: Her phone is up to date with the latest features.
她的手机配备了最新的功能。

leftover.def_en: happening soon
leftover.mnemonic: upcoming 是 up 和 coming 的组合，字面意思为向上而来，引申为即将发生或临近的事件。
example: We are excited about the upcoming concert next week.
我们对下周即将举行的音乐会感到兴奋。

kaoyan_ex.text: Upcoming reforms might bring the price to a more reasonable level.

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作adj.；意为“即将”；以 -ing 形式出现

leftover.def_en: open and honest paid before any other charges
leftover.mnemonic: upfront 由 up 和 front 组合，字面意为在前方，引申为坦率直接或预先支付费用。
example: She was upfront about her feelings.
她对自己的感受直言不讳。

leftover.def_en: to cover furniture with padding and fabric
leftover.mnemonic: 与 uphold 支撑相关，指为家具添加软垫的工艺，在室内设计中常用于沙发或椅子装饰
example: I decided to upholster the old sofa to give it a new look.
我决定给旧沙发重新装面，让它焕然一新。

leftover.def_en: causing you to feel more positive and hopeful
leftover.mnemonic: uplifting 拆解为 up 表示向上和 lift 表示举起，整体意思是提升情绪或鼓舞人心的，常用于描述积极事件。
example: The movie was so uplifting, it made me feel like anything is possible.
这部电影太鼓舞人心了，让我觉得一切皆有可能。

leftover.def_en: A person who has recently gained a position of importance and acts arrogantly.
leftover.mnemonic: upstart 由 up（向上）和 start（开始）组成，指突然崛起的人或事物，常带贬义，描述社会中的暴发户现象。
example: The upstart CEO thought he knew everything and didn't listen to the experienced employees.
那位自大的新CEO以为自己什么都懂，不听取有经验员工的意见。

leftover.def_en: to use something for a specific purpose
leftover.mnemonic: utilize 源自拉丁语 uti，util 表示有用，ize 后缀，意思是指有效利用资源，在工程中强调优化使用。
example: We utilize solar panels to generate electricity for our home.
我们利用太阳能板为家里发电。

leftover.def_en: to disappear suddenly and completely to stop existing or being present
leftover.mnemonic: 源自古法语 vanir，根源于拉丁语 evanescere，词根 van- 表示空或无，描述突然消失或不见的现象。
example: The magician made the rabbit vanish from the box.
魔术师让兔子从盒子里消失了。

leftover.def_en: a container used to hold flowers or as decoration
leftover.mnemonic: 直接来自法语 vase，词源是拉丁语 vas 意为容器，特指用于插花的花瓶，常见于家居装饰。
example: She put fresh flowers in the vase on the table.
她把鲜花插在桌上的花瓶里。

leftover.def_en: to an extremely great extent or degree
leftover.mnemonic: 由 vast 加后缀 -ly 构成，vast 表示巨大的，-ly 使其成为副词，强调程度之大，如 vastly different 描述差异显著。
example: The new software has vastly improved our productivity.
新软件极大地提高了我们的生产力。

leftover.def_en: Something that is praised or talked about with great pride, even if it's not really that great.
leftover.mnemonic: vaunted 表示被吹嘘的，词根 vaunt 来自法语 vanter，意为自夸，ed 后缀形成形容词描述夸耀状态。
example: The company's vaunted new product turned out to be a disappointment.
该公司大肆吹嘘的新产品结果令人失望。

leftover.def_en: A soft, thick fabric with a smooth surface.
leftover.mnemonic: velvet 来自意大利语 velluto，指一种柔软光滑的织物，常用于服装和装饰。
example: She wore a beautiful velvet dress to the party.
她穿着一件漂亮的天鹅绒连衣裙去参加派对。

leftover.def_en: Taking action against someone because they did something bad to you, your family, or your friends.
leftover.mnemonic: vengeance 来自拉丁语 vindicare，原义为报复或伸张正义，经过法语演变后专指复仇，强调对不公的强烈回应。
example: He wanted vengeance on the people who treated his country badly.
他想报复那些虐待他国家的人。

kaoyan_ex.text: The threat of nationalisation may have been seen off for now, but it will return with a vengeance if the justified anger of…

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“复仇”；常见搭配 of

leftover.def_en: able to do many different things well having many different uses
leftover.mnemonic: 这个词源于拉丁语 versatilis，意思是转动的，表示能灵活适应多种角色或任务，就像多面手一样自如切换。
example: She is a versatile worker who can handle many tasks.
她是一名多面手，能处理许多任务。

leftover.def_en: a tube in the body that carries blood or in plants that carries liquid a large boat or ship a container for holding liquids like a bowl or cup
leftover.mnemonic: vessel 源于拉丁语 vascellum（小容器），演变到指代船、容器或血管，承载液体或物品，如 blood vessel（血管）。
example: The doctor said he might have a broken blood vessel.
医生说他可能有一根血管破裂了。

leftover.def_en: a person with a lot of experience in a specific job or activity a person who served in the military during a war
leftover.mnemonic: veteran 源于拉丁语 veteranus，意为老兵，引申为经验丰富的老手，常用于军事或专业领域。
example: The veteran teacher has been working at the school for over 30 years.
这位资深教师已经在这所学校工作了30多年。

kaoyan_ex.text: While veterans of previous expeditions had written at length about stunning sights, these vivid photographs were another thing…

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“老手”；常见搭配 of

leftover.def_en: a person hurt or killed by something bad like a crime, accident, or sickness a person tricked or cheated by someone a person or thing harmed by a bad situation or decision a person or animal killed as an offering to a god
leftover.mnemonic: victim 源于拉丁语 victima，原指祭祀牺牲品，后演变为受害者或遇难者的含义。
example: The victim of the car crash was taken to the hospital for treatment.
车祸的受害者被送往医院接受治疗。

leftover.def_en: in a way that relates to deep inward feelings rather than to the intellect in a way that relates to the viscera or internal organs
example: The film affected me viscerally, making my heart race.
这部电影让我内心深受触动，心跳加速。

leftover.def_en: to picture something in your mind to make something visible
leftover.mnemonic: 拆解 visual（视觉的），源自拉丁语 visus（看见），加 -ize 动词化，表示在脑中形成图像的可视化过程。
example: Visualize your success to help you achieve your goals.
想象你的成功，以帮助你实现目标。

leftover.def_en: A natural substance in food that helps your body grow and stay healthy.
leftover.mnemonic: vitamin 由 'vita'（生命）和 'amine'（一种化合物）组成，是维持生命必需的营养素，常见于健康饮食。
example: Eating fruits and vegetables gives your body important vitamins.
吃水果和蔬菜能为身体提供重要的维生素。

leftover.def_en: creating very clear images in your mind extremely bright and intense easily forming clear mental pictures
leftover.mnemonic: vivid 源自拉丁语 vivere，意为生活，描述事物生动逼真，如 vivid memories 生动的回忆，强调鲜活感和细节丰富性。
example: His vivid description of the sunset made me feel like I was there.
他对日落的生动描述让我感觉身临其境。

kaoyan_ex.text: …of the Yellowstone region in particular—came in the form of vivid photographs.

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作adj.；意为“生动”

leftover.def_en: A mountain that can erupt, sending out hot rock, ash, and gases.
leftover.mnemonic: volcano 得名于罗马神话中的火神 Vulcan，描述喷发岩浆的山体。
example: The volcano erupted, sending ash high into the sky.
火山喷发了，将火山灰喷向高空。

kaoyan_ex.text: At issue is the TMT’s planned location on Mauna Kea, a dormant volcano worshiped by some Hawaiians as the piko, that connects…

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“火山”；常见搭配 by

leftover.def_en: a train car that carries things a large cart pulled by animals to carry heavy things a small rolling cart for food or drinks
leftover.mnemonic: wagon 来自荷兰语 wagen，意为车辆，特指四轮运货车，历史上用于运输或迁徙。
example: The coal was loaded onto the wagon at the station.
煤在车站被装上了货车。

leftover.def_en: A person who fights in battles or wars A person who fights strongly for a cause, often in a way others dislike
leftover.mnemonic: 拆解为 war（战争）和 -rior（表示人），类似 soldier，指战士或斗士，源自古英语词汇。
example: The brave warrior fought to protect his people
勇敢的战士为保护他的人民而战。

leftover.def_en: a flying insect with black and yellow stripes that can sting
leftover.mnemonic: wasp 指黄蜂，词源可追溯至古英语 wæps，也缩写为 WASP 表示 White Anglo-Saxon Protestant，但这里主要指昆虫。
example: I saw a wasp flying near the flowers in the garden.
我看到一只黄蜂在花园的花丛附近飞舞。

leftover.def_en: Not letting water pass through or get damaged by water. Clothing that keeps water out. To make something keep water out.
leftover.mnemonic: waterproof 是 water 水和 proof 防的组合，proof 源自古英语表示抵抗，因此这个词意思是防水的，适合用于防水外套或设备。
example: This jacket is waterproof, so you won't get wet in the rain.
这件夹克是防水的，所以下雨时你不会淋湿。

leftover.def_en: a unit that measures electrical power
leftover.mnemonic: watt 是功率单位，以发明家 James Watt 命名，他在蒸汽机改进中扮演了关键角色，体现了科学史上的重要贡献。
example: This lamp uses a 60-watt bulb to provide bright light.
这款灯使用60瓦的灯泡来提供明亮的光线。

leftover.def_en: very strange or unusual strange and scary to make something strange or unusual to cause someone to feel uneasy or disturbed
leftover.mnemonic: weird 源于古英语 wyrd，原义为命运或超自然，后来演变为描述怪异事物，在流行文化中广泛使用。
example: That weird noise coming from the attic makes me nervous.
阁楼传来的奇怪噪音让我紧张。

leftover.def_en: known by many people
example: She is a well-known author in the literary world.
她是文学界一位著名的作家。

leftover.def_en: not at all; in any way
leftover.mnemonic: whatsoever 是 what、so 和 ever 的组合，用于否定句强调没有任何事物。
example: There is no evidence whatsoever to support that claim.
完全没有证据支持那个说法。

leftover.def_en: a grain plant used to make flour for bread and other foods
leftover.mnemonic: 这个词源自古英语 hwæte，指小麦这种谷物，其含义演变强调了它作为人类主食的重要角色，在农业中常被视为基础作物。
example: Farmers grow wheat to make flour for bread.
农民种植小麦来制作面包用的面粉。

leftover.def_en: Used to show which thing or person is important in making a choice. Used to say that the choice doesn't matter because the outcome will be the same.
leftover.mnemonic: whichever 是 which 和 ever 的组合词，which 指哪个，ever 强调任意性，表达无论哪一个的选择概念。
example: Whichever of you finishes first will get a reward.
你们中谁先完成谁就会得到奖励。

leftover.def_en: at the same time as something else used to show a difference between two things even though something is true
leftover.mnemonic: whilst 是 while 的变体，主要在英式英语中使用，意思是当...时。这种用法体现了语言的地域差异。
example: You should not eat whilst watching TV.
你不应该边看电视边吃东西。

leftover.def_en: A strong alcoholic drink made from grain such as barley or corn. A glass or serving of whiskey.
example: He ordered a glass of whiskey on the rocks.
他点了一杯加冰的威士忌。

leftover.def_en: A strong drink made from grain, often enjoyed with water or ice. A serving of whisky in a glass.
leftover.mnemonic: whisky 来自盖尔语 uisge beatha 意为生命之水，指蒸馏烈酒，与苏格兰和爱尔兰传统酿造文化紧密联系。
example: He poured a glass of whisky to relax after work.
他倒了一杯威士忌，下班后放松一下。

leftover.def_en: doing something with all your energy and enthusiasm
leftover.mnemonic: wholeheartedly 是 wholehearted 的副词形式，whole 意为整个，hearted 指有心的，后缀 -ly 表示方式，整体意思是全心全意地投入。
example: She wholeheartedly supported the new project and worked hard to make it successful.
她全心全意地支持这个新项目，并努力使其成功。

leftover.def_en: a woman whose husband has died and has not remarried to become a widow when your husband dies
leftover.mnemonic: widow 源自古英语 widewe，与拉丁语 vidua 相关，词根含义是分离，指丧偶的女性。
example: The widow received support from her community after her husband passed away.
这位寡妇在丈夫去世后得到了社区的支持。

leftover.def_en: A large natural area where people do not live or farm. A place that is not cared for or controlled. A time when someone is not important or active, especially in politics.
leftover.mnemonic: wilderness 由 wild 加 ness 后缀构成，wild 意为野生的，ness 表示状态，指未开发的荒野区域，常用于自然保护主题。
example: The vast wilderness of the Arctic is home to many animals.
北极广阔的荒野是许多动物的家园。

kaoyan_ex.text: Zoos save people trips to wilderness areas and thus contribute to wildlife conservation.

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“荒野”

leftover.def_en: Doing something on purpose, even when you know it's not right.
example: She wilfully damaged the property, fully aware of the legal implications.
她故意损坏了财产，完全清楚法律后果。

leftover.def_en: A surprise gift of money or a gain you didn't expect. Fruit that has fallen from a tree naturally, not picked.
leftover.mnemonic: windfall 拆解为 wind 风加上 fall 落下，原指风刮落的果实，引申为意外收获或财富
example: She got a windfall when she inherited a large sum from her uncle.
她从叔叔那里继承了一大笔钱，得到了一笔意外之财。

leftover.def_en: exposed to strong winds with little shelter having a messy or disheveled appearance from the wind
leftover.mnemonic: 复合词，wind 意为风，swept 是 sweep 的过去分词，形容被风吹扫过的空旷地方，如海岸或高原。
example: The windswept hilltop offered a stunning view of the valley below.
风吹过的山顶提供了下方山谷的壮丽景色。

leftover.def_en: The outer end of an aircraft's wing. A style of shoe with a pointed toe cap extending back along the sides.
example: The plane's wingtips were fitted with lights for visibility.
飞机的翼尖装有灯以提高可见度。

leftover.def_en: to quickly close and open one eye, often as a secret sign or joke to flash on and off quickly like a light the act of winking, usually as a signal
leftover.mnemonic: wink 词源可追溯至古英语 wincian，意为眨眼，常用于表示暗示或短暂闪烁，与视觉动作相关。
example: She gave a wink to show she was joking about the surprise.
她眨了眨眼，表示她关于那个惊喜是在开玩笑。

leftover.def_en: to take money out of a bank to move back or away from a place to stop taking part in an activity or group to stop giving or offering something to say that something you said before is not true to become quiet and spend less time with others
leftover.mnemonic: withdraw 由 with 和 draw 组合而成，字面意思是拉回或撤回，词源可追溯到中古英语，现在常用于金融取款或退出行为。
example: She went to the bank to withdraw cash.
她去银行取现金。

leftover.def_en: to not be harmed or broken by something strong or difficult
leftover.mnemonic: withstand 来自古英语 wiðstandan，其中 wið 表示对抗，standan 意为站立，整体指承受压力或抵抗外力而不屈服。
example: This material can withstand very high temperatures without melting.
这种材料能承受极高的温度而不熔化。

leftover.def_en: a wild dog-like animal that lives and hunts in groups to eat food very quickly
leftover.mnemonic: wolf 源于古英语 wulf，与原始印欧语词根 wlkwo 相关，意为狼，常用于比喻孤独或野性的形象，如 lone wolf。
example: The wolf howled at the moon in the dark forest.
狼在黑暗的森林里对着月亮嚎叫。

leftover.def_en: A woodcut is a type of art made by carving a design into a wooden block, then printing that design onto paper.
leftover.mnemonic: woodcut 由 wood 和 cut 两个简单词组成，直接表示在木头上进行雕刻的艺术形式，常用于版画制作。
example: The artist's woodcut of a forest scene was displayed in the gallery.
这位艺术家的森林场景木刻版画在画廊展出。

kaoyan_ex.text: …in monthly installments, as a backdrop for a series of woodcuts by the then-famous artist Robert Seymour, who had originated the idea for the story.

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“木刻”；常见搭配 by

leftover.def_en: causing worry or anxiety
leftover.mnemonic: 由 worry 担忧和后缀 -some 引起组成，整体表示令人担忧的状态。
example: The worrisome news about the economy left everyone feeling uneasy.
关于经济的令人担忧的消息让每个人都感到不安。

leftover.def_en: good enough to be worth the time, money, or effort you spend on it
leftover.mnemonic: worthwhile 组合了 worth（值得）和 while（时间），意思是有价值的，值得投入精力。
example: Learning a new language is worthwhile because it opens up many opportunities.
学习一门新语言是值得的，因为它能带来许多机会。

kaoyan_ex.text: Kennedy once said that a country’s GDP measures “everything except that which makes life worthwhile.” With Britain voting to…

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作adj.；意为“值得的”；常见搭配 with

leftover.def_en: a small line or fold in skin that appears with age an unwanted fold in fabric or paper to make skin form lines or folds to form messy folds or lines
leftover.mnemonic: wrinkle 可能源于古英语，指皮肤或物体表面的褶皱，常与老化相关，含义从物理皱折延伸到比喻性的小问题。
example: She has a few wrinkles on her forehead from smiling so much.
她因为经常笑，额头上有了几条皱纹。

leftover.def_en: once every year happening once every year for one year
leftover.mnemonic: yearly 来自 year 年，后缀 -ly 表示每年发生一次，强调时间上的规律性。
example: The company holds a yearly meeting to discuss progress.
公司每年举行一次会议讨论进展。

leftover.def_en: a young person or child
leftover.mnemonic: youngster 由 young（年轻的）和后缀 -ster（表示从事者）组成，指年轻人或青少年群体。
example: The park has a special playground for youngsters to play safely.
公园里有一个专为青少年安全玩耍的游乐场。

kaoyan_ex.text: …face a bleak economic future as qualified multilingual youngsters from other countries are proving to have a competitive advantage over their…

leftover.kaoyan_note: 作n.；意为“年轻人”；常见搭配 from

leftover.def_en: Used as the object of a verb or preposition when the people being addressed are the same as the subject of the verb. Used to emphasize the people being addressed.
leftover.mnemonic: yourselves 是 you 的反身形式，由 your 和 selves 构成，self 表示自身，用于强调或指代群体自己。
example: You should look after yourselves.
你们应该照顾好自己。
